```c
static struct hc_slot hc_slots[SLOTS];
static uint32_t hc_nslots;                      /* slots 1..hc_nslots carry reads */
static uint32_t hc_free;                        /* bit i: hc_slots[i] free */
static uint32_t hc_slot_buffer = SLOT_BUFFER_DEFAULT;
static uint32_t hc_lun_mask = 1;                /* the logical units reads may go to: LUN 0 */
static bool hc_usable;
static uint32_t hc_leave;                       /* ufs_native_leave=1 (a test): the list left in at the end, for the loader */
static volatile bool hc_in, hc_closed, hc_dead;
static uint32_t hc_is_in, hc_cnr_in;            /* IS and UTRLCNR when this kernel's list went in */
static uint64_t hc_requests, hc_errors, hc_bytes, hc_wait_us, hc_refused, hc_most_in_flight, hc_proofs;
static uint64_t hc_switch_in_count, hc_switch_out_count;
static uint32_t hc_in_flight;
/* where the time goes: doorbell reads while waiting, waits for a free slot, taking hc_lock, how many in flight */
static uint64_t hc_polls, hc_slot_waits, hc_slot_wait_ticks, hc_lock_ticks, hc_flight_hist[6];

static LCK_GRP_DECLARE(hc_lck_grp, "hakios-ufshc");
static LCK_MTX_DECLARE(hc_lock, &hc_lck_grp);

SYSCTL_DECL(_kern_hakios);
SYSCTL_QUAD(_kern_hakios, OID_AUTO, ufs_native_requests, CTLFLAG_RD | CTLFLAG_LOCKED, &hc_requests,
    "reads this kernel's own UFS driver has had answered");
SYSCTL_QUAD(_kern_hakios, OID_AUTO, ufs_native_errors, CTLFLAG_RD | CTLFLAG_LOCKED, &hc_errors,
    "reads of this kernel's own UFS driver that failed");
SYSCTL_QUAD(_kern_hakios, OID_AUTO, ufs_native_bytes, CTLFLAG_RD | CTLFLAG_LOCKED, &hc_bytes,
    "bytes this kernel's own UFS driver has read");
SYSCTL_QUAD(_kern_hakios, OID_AUTO, ufs_native_wait_us, CTLFLAG_RD | CTLFLAG_LOCKED, &hc_wait_us,
    "microseconds spent waiting for the controller, summed over the reads");
SYSCTL_QUAD(_kern_hakios, OID_AUTO, ufs_native_refused, CTLFLAG_RD | CTLFLAG_LOCKED, &hc_refused,
    "commands the whitelist refused (there should never be one)");
SYSCTL_QUAD(_kern_hakios, OID_AUTO, ufs_native_most_in_flight, CTLFLAG_RD | CTLFLAG_LOCKED, &hc_most_in_flight,
    "the most reads this kernel's own UFS driver has had in flight at once");

/*
 * What this file says goes to the kernel's log, and the last lines are kept: the start of a long
 * run's log does not come back to the loader (the buffer wraps), so they are said again at the
 * end, into the loader's log directly (hakios_ufs_quiesce; printf is not for that moment).
 */
extern void loader_log_putc(char c);
#define KEPT_LINES          64
static char hc_kept[KEPT_LINES][208];
static uint32_t hc_kept_count;

static void
hc_say(const char *format, ...) __printflike(1, 2);
static void
hc_say(const char *format, ...)
{
	char line[208];
	va_list list;

	va_start(list, format);
	vsnprintf(line, sizeof(line), format, list);
	va_end(list);
	printf("%s", line);
	strlcpy(hc_kept[hc_kept_count++ % KEPT_LINES], line, sizeof(hc_kept[0]));
}

/* the same, at the end: into the loader's log only */
static void
hc_say_late(const char *format, ...) __printflike(1, 2);
static void
hc_say_late(const char *format, ...)
{
	char line[208];
	va_list list;

	va_start(list, format);
	vsnprintf(line, sizeof(line), format, list);
	va_end(list);
	for (const char *c = line; *c != 0; c++) {
		loader_log_putc(*c);
	}
}

static inline uint32_t
hc_read(uint32_t reg)
{
	return *(volatile uint32_t *)(hc + reg);
}

static inline void
hc_write(uint32_t reg, uint32_t value)
{
	__asm__ volatile ("dsb sy" ::: "memory");
	*(volatile uint32_t *)(hc + reg) = value;
	__asm__ volatile ("dsb sy" ::: "memory");
}

static uint64_t
hc_us_since(uint64_t start)
{
	uint64_t ns;

	absolutetime_to_nanoseconds(mach_absolute_time() - start, &ns);
	return ns / 1000;
}

/* ---- the whitelist: the one check every command passes before it goes into a slot ---- */

static const char *
hc_refusal(const uint8_t *upiu, uint32_t dw0, uint32_t lun_mask, bool any_command_type)
{
	const uint8_t *cdb = upiu + 16;
	uint32_t dd = dw0 & UTRD_DD_MASK;
	uint64_t expected = (uint64_t)upiu[12] << 24 | (uint64_t)upiu[13] << 16 | (uint64_t)upiu[14] << 8 | upiu[15];
	uint8_t lun = upiu[2];

	/* the data direction: from the device, or none -- never to it */
	if (dd == UTRD_DD_OUT || dd == UTRD_DD_MASK) {
		return "data from host to device";
	}
	if (!any_command_type && (dw0 & UTRD_CT_MASK) != UTRD_CT_UFS) {
		return "not a UFS storage command type";
	}
	/* a SCSI command, and its flags: never W */
	if ((upiu[0] & 0x3f) != UPIU_COMMAND) {
		return "not a SCSI command (a query, task management, NOP, ...)";
	}
	if (upiu[1] & UPIU_FLAG_WRITE) {
		return "the W flag";
	}
	if (upiu[4] & 0x0f) {
		return "not the SCSI command set";
	}
	/* a normal logical unit, and one reads may go to now */
	if (lun & LUN_WELL_KNOWN) {
		return "a well-known logical unit";
	}
	if (lun >= 8 || (lun_mask & (1u << lun)) == 0) {
		return "a logical unit reads do not go to now";
	}
	/* the operation */
	switch (cdb[0]) {
	case 0x28:      /* READ(10) */
	case 0x88: {    /* READ(16) */
		uint64_t blocks = cdb[0] == 0x28 ? ((uint64_t)cdb[7] << 8 | cdb[8]) :
		    ((uint64_t)cdb[10] << 24 | (uint64_t)cdb[11] << 16 | (uint64_t)cdb[12] << 8 | cdb[13]);

		if (dd != UTRD_DD_IN || (upiu[1] & UPIU_FLAG_READ) == 0) {
			return "a read without data from the device";
		}
		if (blocks == 0 || expected != blocks * BLOCK) {
			return "a read whose length is not what the UPIU expects";
		}
		return NULL;
	}
	case 0x00:      /* TEST UNIT READY */
		return dd == UTRD_DD_NONE && expected == 0 && (upiu[1] & UPIU_FLAG_READ) == 0 ? NULL :
		       "TEST UNIT READY with data";
	case 0x03:      /* REQUEST SENSE */
	case 0x12:      /* INQUIRY */
	case 0x25:      /* READ CAPACITY(10) */
		return NULL;
	case 0x9e:      /* SERVICE ACTION IN(16): READ CAPACITY(16) only */
		return (cdb[1] & 0x1f) == 0x10 ? NULL : "a SERVICE ACTION IN other than READ CAPACITY(16)";
	default:
		return "a SCSI operation not on the list";
	}
}

static bool
ufshc_permitted(const uint8_t *upiu, uint32_t dw0)
{
	const char *why = hc_refusal(upiu, dw0, hc_lun_mask, false);

	if (why == NULL) {
		return true;
	}
	hc_refused++;
	hc_say("ufs: native: REFUSED (%s): UPIU %02x %02x %02x %02x, CDB %02x %02x %02x %02x %02x %02x %02x %02x %02x %02x, "
	    "descriptor %08x; it goes into no slot\n", why, upiu[0], upiu[1], upiu[2], upiu[3], upiu[16], upiu[17], upiu[18],
	    upiu[19], upiu[20], upiu[21], upiu[22], upiu[23], upiu[24], upiu[25], dw0);
	return false;
}

static void
hc_make_read(struct hc_cmd *c, uint8_t lun, uint8_t tag, uint32_t lba, uint32_t blocks)
{
	uint32_t bytes = blocks * BLOCK;

	bzero(c, sizeof(*c));
	c->upiu[0] = UPIU_COMMAND;
	c->upiu[1] = UPIU_FLAG_READ;            /* simple task attribute */
	c->upiu[2] = lun;
	c->upiu[3] = tag;
	c->upiu[12] = (uint8_t)(bytes >> 24);
	c->upiu[13] = (uint8_t)(bytes >> 16);
	c->upiu[14] = (uint8_t)(bytes >> 8);
	c->upiu[15] = (uint8_t)bytes;
	c->upiu[16] = 0x28;                     /* READ(10) */
	c->upiu[18] = (uint8_t)(lba >> 24);
	c->upiu[19] = (uint8_t)(lba >> 16);
	c->upiu[20] = (uint8_t)(lba >> 8);
	c->upiu[21] = (uint8_t)lba;
	c->upiu[23] = (uint8_t)(blocks >> 8);
	c->upiu[24] = (uint8_t)blocks;
	c->dw0 = UTRD_CT_UFS | UTRD_DD_IN;      /* no interrupt, no inline encryption */
}

static void
hc_make_tur(struct hc_cmd *c, uint8_t lun, uint8_t tag)
{
	bzero(c, sizeof(*c));
	c->upiu[0] = UPIU_COMMAND;
	c->upiu[2] = lun;
	c->upiu[3] = tag;
	c->upiu[16] = 0x00;                     /* TEST UNIT READY */
	c->dw0 = UTRD_CT_UFS | UTRD_DD_NONE;
}

/*
 * The whitelist tried on commands made up here and never sent: those that must be refused,
 * and those that must pass. Pure bytes; nothing touches the controller.
 */
static bool
hc_whitelist_selftest(void)
{
	static const struct {
		uint8_t type, flags, lun, op, cdb1;
		uint16_t blocks;                /* the CDB's length (READ(10)/(16)) */
		uint32_t expected;              /* the UPIU's */
		uint32_t dd;
		bool pass;
		const char *what;
	} cases[] = {
		{ UPIU_COMMAND, UPIU_FLAG_READ, 0, 0x28, 0, 1, 4096, UTRD_DD_IN, true, "READ(10) of LUN 0" },
		{ UPIU_COMMAND, UPIU_FLAG_READ, 0, 0x88, 0, 1, 4096, UTRD_DD_IN, true, "READ(16) of LUN 0" },
		{ UPIU_COMMAND, 0, 0, 0x00, 0, 0, 0, UTRD_DD_NONE, true, "TEST UNIT READY of LUN 0" },
		{ UPIU_COMMAND, UPIU_FLAG_READ, 0, 0x25, 0, 0, 8, UTRD_DD_IN, true, "READ CAPACITY(10)" },
		{ UPIU_COMMAND, UPIU_FLAG_WRITE, 0, 0x2a, 0, 1, 4096, UTRD_DD_OUT, false, "WRITE(10)" },
		{ UPIU_COMMAND, UPIU_FLAG_WRITE, 0, 0x8a, 0, 1, 4096, UTRD_DD_OUT, false, "WRITE(16)" },
		{ UPIU_COMMAND, UPIU_FLAG_READ, 0, 0x2a, 0, 1, 4096, UTRD_DD_IN, false, "WRITE(10) dressed as a read" },
		{ UPIU_COMMAND, 0, 0, 0x2a, 0, 0, 0, UTRD_DD_NONE, false, "WRITE(10) with no data" },
		{ UPIU_COMMAND, UPIU_FLAG_WRITE, 0, 0x42, 0, 0, 24, UTRD_DD_OUT, false, "UNMAP" },
		{ UPIU_COMMAND, 0, 0, 0x42, 0, 0, 0, UTRD_DD_NONE, false, "UNMAP with no data" },
		{ UPIU_COMMAND, UPIU_FLAG_READ, 0, 0x28, 0, 1, 4096, UTRD_DD_OUT, false, "READ(10) with data host to device" },
		{ UPIU_COMMAND, UPIU_FLAG_READ, 0, 0x28, 0, 1, 4096, UTRD_DD_MASK, false, "READ(10) with direction 3" },
		{ UPIU_COMMAND, UPIU_FLAG_READ | UPIU_FLAG_WRITE, 0, 0x28, 0, 1, 4096, UTRD_DD_IN, false, "READ(10) with the W flag" },
		{ UPIU_COMMAND, UPIU_FLAG_WRITE, 0, 0x28, 0, 1, 4096, UTRD_DD_IN, false, "READ(10) with only the W flag" },
		{ UPIU_COMMAND, UPIU_FLAG_READ, 0, 0x28, 0, 1, 8192, UTRD_DD_IN, false, "READ(10) of a length other than expected" },
		{ UPIU_COMMAND, UPIU_FLAG_READ, 0xc4, 0x28, 0, 1, 4096, UTRD_DD_IN, false, "READ(10) of the RPMB unit" },
		{ UPIU_COMMAND, UPIU_FLAG_READ, 0xb0, 0x28, 0, 1, 4096, UTRD_DD_IN, false, "READ(10) of the BOOT unit" },
		{ UPIU_COMMAND, UPIU_FLAG_READ, 0xd0, 0x28, 0, 1, 4096, UTRD_DD_IN, false, "READ(10) of the device unit" },
		{ UPIU_COMMAND, UPIU_FLAG_READ, 0x81, 0x28, 0, 1, 4096, UTRD_DD_IN, false, "READ(10) of REPORT LUNS" },
		{ UPIU_COMMAND, UPIU_FLAG_READ, 3, 0x28, 0, 1, 4096, UTRD_DD_IN, false, "READ(10) of LUN 3 (not allowed now)" },
		{ UPIU_COMMAND, 0, 0, 0x04, 0, 0, 0, UTRD_DD_NONE, false, "FORMAT UNIT" },
		{ UPIU_COMMAND, 0, 0, 0x1b, 0, 0, 0, UTRD_DD_NONE, false, "START STOP UNIT" },
		{ UPIU_COMMAND, 0, 0, 0x35, 0, 0, 0, UTRD_DD_NONE, false, "SYNCHRONIZE CACHE(10)" },
		{ UPIU_COMMAND, UPIU_FLAG_WRITE, 0, 0x3b, 0, 0, 4096, UTRD_DD_OUT, false, "WRITE BUFFER" },
		{ UPIU_COMMAND, UPIU_FLAG_WRITE, 0, 0xb5, 0, 0, 512, UTRD_DD_OUT, false, "SECURITY PROTOCOL OUT" },
		{ UPIU_COMMAND, UPIU_FLAG_READ, 0, 0xa2, 0, 0, 512, UTRD_DD_IN, false, "SECURITY PROTOCOL IN" },
		{ UPIU_COMMAND, UPIU_FLAG_WRITE, 0, 0x15, 0, 0, 24, UTRD_DD_OUT, false, "MODE SELECT" },
		{ UPIU_COMMAND, UPIU_FLAG_READ, 0, 0x9e, 0x11, 0, 32, UTRD_DD_IN, false, "SERVICE ACTION IN 0x11" },
		{ UPIU_COMMAND, 0, 0, 0x00, 0, 0, 0, UTRD_DD_IN, false, "TEST UNIT READY with data in" },
		{ 0x16, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, UTRD_DD_NONE, false, "a QUERY REQUEST" },
		{ 0x04, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, UTRD_DD_NONE, false, "TASK MANAGEMENT" },
		{ 0x00, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, UTRD_DD_NONE, false, "NOP OUT" },
	};
	bool right = true;

	for (unsigned i = 0; i < sizeof(cases) / sizeof(cases[0]); i++) {
		uint8_t upiu[32] = { 0 };
		bool passed;

		upiu[0] = cases[i].type;
		upiu[1] = cases[i].flags;
		upiu[2] = cases[i].lun;
		upiu[12] = (uint8_t)(cases[i].expected >> 24);
		upiu[13] = (uint8_t)(cases[i].expected >> 16);
		upiu[14] = (uint8_t)(cases[i].expected >> 8);
		upiu[15] = (uint8_t)cases[i].expected;
		upiu[16] = cases[i].op;
		upiu[17] = cases[i].cdb1;
		if (cases[i].op == 0x88) {
			upiu[16 + 12] = (uint8_t)(cases[i].blocks >> 8);
			upiu[16 + 13] = (uint8_t)cases[i].blocks;
		} else {
			upiu[16 + 7] = (uint8_t)(cases[i].blocks >> 8);
			upiu[16 + 8] = (uint8_t)cases[i].blocks;
		}
		passed = hc_refusal(upiu, UTRD_CT_UFS | cases[i].dd, 1u << 0, false) == NULL;
		if (passed != cases[i].pass) {
			hc_say("ufs: native: the whitelist %s %s\n", passed ? "LETS THROUGH" : "refuses", cases[i].what);
			right = false;
		}
	}
	/* and what this file makes */
	{
		struct hc_cmd c;

		hc_make_read(&c, 0, 1, 12345, 64);
		right &= hc_refusal(c.upiu, c.dw0, 1u << 0, false) == NULL;
		hc_make_read(&c, 2, 1, 12345, 64);
		right &= hc_refusal(c.upiu, c.dw0, 1u << 0, false) != NULL;
		hc_make_tur(&c, 0, 0);
		right &= hc_refusal(c.upiu, c.dw0, 1u << 0, false) == NULL;
	}
	hc_say("ufs: native: whitelist tried on %u commands made up and never sent -- READ(10/16), TEST UNIT READY, READ "
	    "CAPACITY of LUN 0 pass; WRITE(10/16), UNMAP, a READ with data host to device, a READ with the W flag, the "
	    "RPMB/BOOT/device/REPORT LUNS units, LUN 3, FORMAT, START STOP, SYNCHRONIZE CACHE, WRITE BUFFER, SECURITY "
	    "PROTOCOL, MODE SELECT, query, task management, NOP refused: %s\n",
	    (unsigned)(sizeof(cases) / sizeof(cases[0])) + 3, right ? "as it should" : "WRONG");
	return right;
}

/* ---- one command in one slot ---- */

static void
hc_put(volatile uint32_t *to, const void *from, uint32_t bytes)
{
	for (uint32_t i = 0; i < bytes / 4; i++) {
		uint32_t w;

		memcpy(&w, (const uint8_t *)from + 4 * i, 4);
		to[i] = w;
	}
}

/*
 * Into the slot: the command UPIU, an empty response, the PRD table for bytes of the slot's
 * buffer, the descriptor -- only a command the whitelist passes, and only if what the slot then
 * holds is the same and passes again.
 */
static int
hc_place(struct hc_slot *s, const struct hc_cmd *c, uint32_t bytes)
{
	uint32_t n = 0, back[8];

	if (!ufshc_permitted(c->upiu, c->dw0)) {
		return EPERM;
	}
	hc_put(s->ucd, c->upiu, sizeof(c->upiu));
	for (uint32_t i = sizeof(c->upiu) / 4; i < UCD_PRDT / 4; i++) {
		s->ucd[i] = 0;
	}
	for (uint32_t at = 0; at < bytes; at += PRD_MAX, n++) {
		volatile uint32_t *prd = s->ucd + (UCD_PRDT + 16 * n) / 4;
		uint64_t pa = s->data_pa + at;
		uint32_t len = bytes - at < PRD_MAX ? bytes - at : PRD_MAX;

		prd[0] = (uint32_t)pa;
		prd[1] = (uint32_t)(pa >> 32);
		prd[2] = 0;
		prd[3] = len - 1;
	}
	s->utrd[0] = c->dw0;
	s->utrd[1] = 0;
	s->utrd[2] = OCS_INVALID;
	s->utrd[3] = 0;
	s->utrd[4] = (uint32_t)s->ucd_pa;
	s->utrd[5] = (uint32_t)(s->ucd_pa >> 32);
	s->utrd[6] = ((UCD_RESPONSE / 4) << 16) | (UCD_RESPONSE / 4);   /* response: offset, length in dwords */
	s->utrd[7] = ((UCD_PRDT / 4) << 16) | n;                        /* PRD table: offset in dwords, entries */
	__asm__ volatile ("dsb sy" ::: "memory");
	for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
		back[i] = s->ucd[i];
	}
	if (memcmp(back, c->upiu, sizeof(back)) != 0 || s->utrd[0] != c->dw0 ||
	    !ufshc_permitted((const uint8_t *)back, s->utrd[0])) {
		hc_say("ufs: native: slot %u does not hold what was put in it: not rung\n", s->number);
		hc_refused++;
		return EPERM;
	}
	return 0;
}

/* The doorbell: only while this kernel's list is the one in, running, and the loader not taking it back */
static int
hc_ring(struct hc_slot *s)
{
	uint32_t bit = 1u << s->number;
	boolean_t istate;
	bool ok;

	lck_mtx_lock(&hc_lock);
	istate = ml_set_interrupts_enabled(FALSE);
	ok = hc_in && !hc_closed && !hc_dead && *hc_loader.take_back == 0 &&
	    hc_read(UFSHC_UTRLBA) == hc_list_lo && hc_read(UFSHC_UTRLBAU) == hc_list_hi &&
	    (hc_read(UFSHC_UTRLRSR) & 1) != 0 && (hc_read(UFSHC_UTRLDBR) & bit) == 0;
	if (ok) {
		hc_write(UFSHC_UTRLDBR, bit);
	}
	ml_set_interrupts_enabled(istate);
	lck_mtx_unlock(&hc_lock);
	return ok ? 0 : ENXIO;
}

/*
 * ufs_native_hang=N (a test of the loader's side): once N reads are done, the thread that has just
 * rung a doorbell stops the kernel -- every processor spinning with interrupts off, this one
 * included -- with reads in flight and this kernel's list in. The heartbeat stops, and the
 * loader (or the watchdog) must take it from there.
 */
extern unsigned int cpu_broadcast_xcall(uint32_t *synch, boolean_t self_xcall, void (*func)(void *), void *parm);
static uint32_t hc_hang_after;
static volatile uint32_t hc_hanging;

static void
hc_spin_forever(__unused void *parm)
{
	(void)ml_set_interrupts_enabled(FALSE);
	for (;;) {
		__builtin_arm_yield();
	}
}

static void
hc_hang(uint32_t slot)
{
	static int parm;

	/* (into the loader's log directly as well: a hung kernel's own log never comes back to it) */
	hc_say_late("ufs: native: ufs_native_hang=%u: the kernel stops HERE, every processor spinning with interrupts "
	    "off; slot %u just rung, doorbell %08x, %u reads in flight, this kernel's list in\n", hc_hang_after, slot,
	    hc_read(UFSHC_UTRLDBR), hc_in_flight);
	cpu_broadcast_xcall(NULL, TRUE, hc_spin_forever, &parm);
}

/* Nothing more is sent from here on; whoever waits for a slot is told. */
static void
hc_off(void)
{
	hc_dead = true;
	lck_mtx_lock(&hc_lock);
	wakeup(&hc_free);
	/* those who sleep on a slot's answer look at hc_dead now, not after their own 1 s tick */
	for (uint32_t i = 0; i < SLOTS; i++) {
		wakeup(&hc_slots[i]);
	}
	lck_mtx_unlock(&hc_lock);
}

/*
 * Waiting for the controller. Its interrupt stays off (UEFI's setting), so completions are seen
 * by reading UTRLDBR. A waiter looks at its own bit for a short while (hc_spin_us: a small read
 * is done by then), then sleeps; one poller thread looks for all who sleep and wakes each whose
 * slot is done. So the processors are not all taken by threads spinning on the doorbell, which
 * kept others -- one woken because the volume's lock came free, say -- from running.
 */
static volatile uint32_t hc_waiting;            /* slots whose waiters sleep (hc_lock) */
static uint32_t hc_done;                        /* slots the poller has seen done, not yet collected (hc_lock) */
static bool hc_poller_asleep;
static uint32_t hc_spin_us = 40;                /* boot-arg ufs_native_spin */
static uint64_t hc_sleeps, hc_poller_polls, hc_poller_rounds;

static void
hc_poller(__unused void *arg, __unused wait_result_t wr)
{
	for (;;) {
		uint32_t waiting, db, done;

		lck_mtx_lock(&hc_lock);
		while (hc_waiting == 0) {
			hc_poller_asleep = true;
			msleep((void *)&hc_waiting, &hc_lock, PRIBIO, "ufshc-poll", NULL);
		}
		hc_poller_asleep = false;
		waiting = hc_waiting;
		lck_mtx_unlock(&hc_lock);
		hc_poller_rounds++;
		/* until one of them is done, or another waiter comes */
		while (((db = hc_read(UFSHC_UTRLDBR)) & waiting) == waiting && hc_waiting == waiting) {
			hc_poller_polls++;
			__builtin_arm_yield();
		}
		done = waiting & ~db;
		if (done != 0) {
			lck_mtx_lock(&hc_lock);
			hc_done |= done;
			hc_waiting &= ~done;
			for (uint32_t m = done; m != 0; m &= m - 1) {
				wakeup(&hc_slots[__builtin_ctz(m)]);
			}
			lck_mtx_unlock(&hc_lock);
		}
	}
}

/* Until the controller is done with the slot's command; then whether it went well. */
static int
hc_complete(struct hc_slot *s, const char *what, bool tur)
{
	uint64_t started = mach_absolute_time(), us;
	volatile const uint8_t *r = (volatile const uint8_t *)s->ucd + UCD_RESPONSE;
	uint32_t ocs, bit = 1u << s->number;

	uint64_t polls = 1;

	while ((hc_read(UFSHC_UTRLDBR) & bit) && hc_us_since(started) < hc_spin_us) {
		polls++;
		__builtin_arm_yield();
	}
	if (hc_read(UFSHC_UTRLDBR) & bit) {
		struct timespec second = { 1, 0 };

		lck_mtx_lock(&hc_lock);
		hc_sleeps++;
		hc_waiting |= bit;
		if (hc_poller_asleep) {
			wakeup((void *)&hc_waiting);
		}
		while ((hc_done & bit) == 0) {
			/*
			 * The path went off while this one waited (another slot of the same read timed out):
			 * do not wait out a fresh 10 s per slot (31 slots would hold the read for 310 s).
			 * A slot whose doorbell bit is already clear did finish, so it is read as done.
			 */
			if (hc_dead) {
				hc_waiting &= ~bit;
				if ((hc_read(UFSHC_UTRLDBR) & bit) == 0) {
					break;
				}
				lck_mtx_unlock(&hc_lock);
				hc_say("ufs: native: slot %u (%s) not waited for: this path is already off\n", s->number, what);
				return ETIMEDOUT;
			}
			(void)msleep(s, &hc_lock, PRIBIO, "ufshc-io", &second);
			us = hc_us_since(started);
			if ((hc_done & bit) == 0 && us > TIMEOUT_MS * 1000ULL) {
				hc_waiting &= ~bit;
				lck_mtx_unlock(&hc_lock);
				hc_say("ufs: native: slot %u (%s) not done in %u s (doorbell %08x, IS %08x, HCS %08x): "
				    "this path is off from now on\n", s->number, what, TIMEOUT_MS / 1000, hc_read(UFSHC_UTRLDBR),
				    hc_read(UFSHC_IS), hc_read(UFSHC_HCS));
				hc_off();
				return ETIMEDOUT;
			}
		}
		hc_done &= ~bit;
		lck_mtx_unlock(&hc_lock);
	}
	__asm__ volatile ("dsb sy" ::: "memory");
	os_atomic_add(&hc_polls, polls, relaxed);
	if (!tur) {
		os_atomic_add(&hc_wait_us, hc_us_since(started), relaxed);
	}
	ocs = s->utrd[2] & 0xff;
	if (ocs != OCS_SUCCESS || (r[0] & 0x3f) != UPIU_RESPONSE || r[3] != s->number || r[6] != 0 ||
	    (r[7] != 0 && !(tur && r[7] == 0x02))) {
		/* sense data follows the 32 bytes of the header: its length (2), then the fixed format */
		hc_say("ufs: native: slot %u (%s): OCS %x, response %02x tag %02x, response %02x status %02x, "
		    "sense key %x asc %02x ascq %02x\n", s->number, what, ocs, r[0], r[3], r[6], r[7],
		    r[34 + 2] & 0x0f, r[34 + 12], r[34 + 13]);
		if (!tur) {
			os_atomic_inc(&hc_errors, relaxed);
		}
		return EIO;
	}
	return 0;
}

static struct hc_slot *
hc_take(bool wait)
{
	struct hc_slot *s = NULL;
	uint64_t t0 = mach_absolute_time();

	lck_mtx_lock(&hc_lock);
	hc_lock_ticks += mach_absolute_time() - t0;
	if (hc_free == 0 && wait && !hc_dead && hc_in) {
		uint64_t w0 = mach_absolute_time();

		hc_slot_waits++;
		while (hc_free == 0 && wait && !hc_dead && hc_in) {
			msleep(&hc_free, &hc_lock, PRIBIO, "ufshc", NULL);
		}
		hc_slot_wait_ticks += mach_absolute_time() - w0;
	}
	if (hc_free != 0 && hc_in && !hc_dead) {
		uint32_t i = (uint32_t)__builtin_ctz(hc_free), f;

		hc_free &= ~(1u << i);
		s = &hc_slots[i];
		f = ++hc_in_flight;
		if (f > hc_most_in_flight) {
			hc_most_in_flight = f;
		}
		hc_flight_hist[f <= 1 ? 0 : f <= 2 ? 1 : f <= 4 ? 2 : f <= 8 ? 3 : f <= 16 ? 4 : 5]++;
	}
	lck_mtx_unlock(&hc_lock);
	return s;
}

static void
hc_give(struct hc_slot *s)
{
	lck_mtx_lock(&hc_lock);
	hc_free |= 1u << (s - hc_slots);
	hc_in_flight--;
	wakeup(&hc_free);
	lck_mtx_unlock(&hc_lock);
}

/*
 * Bytes [offset, offset + len) of logical unit lun into dst: the blocks that cover them, a slot's
 * buffer at a time, with as many slots in flight at once as are free (at least one), the wanted
 * bytes copied out of each as it is done.
 */
int
ufshc_read(uint8_t lun, uint64_t offset, uint8_t *dst, uint64_t len)
{
	struct {
		struct hc_slot *slot;
		uint32_t lba, blocks, skip, take;
		uint8_t *to;
	} q[SLOTS];
	uint32_t head = 0, tail = 0, per = hc_slot_buffer / BLOCK;
	int error = 0;

	if (!hc_usable || !hc_in || hc_dead || hc_closed) {
		return ENXIO;
	}
	while ((len > 0 && error == 0) || head != tail) {
		/* as many more reads as there are free slots (and one, waiting for it, if none is in flight) */
		while (len > 0 && error == 0 && tail - head < SLOTS) {
			uint64_t first = offset / BLOCK, skip = offset % BLOCK;
			uint64_t blocks = (skip + len + BLOCK - 1) / BLOCK, take;
			struct hc_slot *s = hc_take(head == tail);
			struct hc_cmd c;
			int e;

			if (s == NULL) {
				if (head == tail) {
					error = ENXIO;                  /* the path went off while waiting */
				}
				break;
			}
			if (blocks > per) {
				blocks = per;
			}
			if (first + blocks > 0xffffffffULL) {
				hc_give(s);
				error = EINVAL;
				break;
			}
			take = blocks * BLOCK - skip;
			if (take > len) {
				take = len;
			}
			hc_make_read(&c, lun, (uint8_t)s->number, (uint32_t)first, (uint32_t)blocks);
			/* nothing of the buffer is left in a cache to be written back over what the controller writes */
			FlushPoC_DcacheRegion((vm_offset_t)s->data, (size_t)blocks * BLOCK);
			e = hc_place(s, &c, (uint32_t)blocks * BLOCK);
			if (e == 0) {
				e = hc_ring(s);
			}
			if (e == 0 && hc_hang_after != 0 && hc_requests >= hc_hang_after &&
			    os_atomic_cmpxchg(&hc_hanging, 0, 1, relaxed)) {
				hc_hang(s->number);
			}
			if (e != 0) {
				hc_give(s);
				error = e;
				break;
			}
			q[tail % SLOTS].slot = s;
			q[tail % SLOTS].lba = (uint32_t)first;
			q[tail % SLOTS].blocks = (uint32_t)blocks;
			q[tail % SLOTS].skip = (uint32_t)skip;
			q[tail % SLOTS].take = (uint32_t)take;
			q[tail % SLOTS].to = dst;
			tail++;
			offset += take;
			dst += take;
			len -= take;
		}
		/* the oldest one done, copied out, its slot free again */
		if (head != tail) {
			typeof(q[0]) *e = &q[head % SLOTS];
			char what[48];
			int r;

			snprintf(what, sizeof(what), "LUN %u, blocks %u..%u", lun, e->lba, e->lba + e->blocks - 1);
			r = hc_complete(e->slot, what, false);
			if (r == 0) {
				FlushPoC_DcacheRegion((vm_offset_t)e->slot->data, (size_t)e->blocks * BLOCK);
				os_atomic_inc(&hc_requests, relaxed);
				os_atomic_add(&hc_bytes, (uint64_t)e->blocks * BLOCK, relaxed);
				if (error == 0) {
					memcpy(e->to, e->slot->data + e->skip, e->take);
				}
			} else if (error == 0) {
				error = r;
			}
			if (r != ETIMEDOUT) {
				hc_give(e->slot);                       /* (a slot that never came back is not used again) */
			}
			head++;
		}
	}
	return error;
}

/* ---- the proof, and the switches ---- */

/* UEFI's slot 0 holds a read (what the controller would run were it to take no notice of this list) */
static const char *
hc_uefi_slot0(uint8_t *upiu, uint32_t *dw0)
{
	uint64_t ucd = (uint64_t)hc_uefi_list[5] << 32 | hc_uefi_list[4];
	volatile const uint8_t *u;

	*dw0 = hc_uefi_list[0];
	if (ucd < hc_uefi_map_pa || ucd + 32 > hc_uefi_map_pa + hc_uefi_map_size) {
		return "UEFI's command descriptor is not where it was";
	}
	u = (volatile const uint8_t *)(hc_uefi_map_va + (ucd - hc_uefi_map_pa));
	for (int i = 0; i < 32; i++) {
		upiu[i] = u[i];
	}
	return hc_refusal(upiu, *dw0, 0xff, true) == NULL ? NULL : "UEFI's slot 0 does not hold a read";
}

/* This kernel's slot 0: TEST UNIT READY rung, and its status must come back in this list */
static int
hc_prove(void)
{
	struct hc_slot *s = &hc_slots[SLOT_PROOF];
	struct hc_cmd c;
	uint32_t ocs;
	int e;

	hc_make_tur(&c, (uint8_t)__builtin_ctz(hc_lun_mask), SLOT_PROOF);
	e = hc_place(s, &c, 0);
	if (e == 0) {
		e = hc_ring(s);
	}
	if (e == 0) {
		e = hc_complete(s, "the proof's TEST UNIT READY", true);
	}
	ocs = s->utrd[2] & 0xff;
	hc_proofs++;
	if (e != 0 || ocs != OCS_SUCCESS) {
		hc_say("ufs: native: proof FAILED (%d): this list's slot 0 has OCS %x after its doorbell -- the controller "
		    "did not run it from this list\n", e, ocs);
		return e != 0 ? e : EIO;
	}
	hc_say("ufs: native: proof: TEST UNIT READY in this list's slot 0 came back here (OCS 0, response %02x, status %02x)\n",
	    ((volatile const uint8_t *)s->ucd)[UCD_RESPONSE + 6], ((volatile const uint8_t *)s->ucd)[UCD_RESPONSE + 7]);
	return 0;
}

struct hc_put_back_result {
	uint32_t db_before, db_after_clear, lo, hi, rsr, db, is, cnr, cnr_ours;
	bool cleared, ok;
};

/*
 * UEFI's list back into the controller: what is in flight waited for (1 s), cleared if it does
 * not finish (every slot of this list is this kernel's), the list stopped, UEFI's address
 * written, the list started, read back. Interrupts off, no locks, no printing (the quiesce).
 */
static void
hc_put_back(struct hc_put_back_result *r)
{
	uint64_t t;

	bzero(r, sizeof(*r));
	for (t = mach_absolute_time(); (r->db_before = hc_read(UFSHC_UTRLDBR)) != 0 && hc_us_since(t) < 1000000;) {
		__builtin_arm_yield();
	}
	if (r->db_before != 0 && hc_read(UFSHC_UTRLBA) == hc_list_lo && hc_read(UFSHC_UTRLBAU) == hc_list_hi) {
		r->cleared = true;
		hc_write(UFSHC_UTRLCLR, 0);
		for (t = mach_absolute_time(); (r->db_after_clear = hc_read(UFSHC_UTRLDBR)) != 0 && hc_us_since(t) < 1000000;) {
			__builtin_arm_yield();
		}
	}
	/* the completion notifications this kernel's requests left: exactly those bits, written with ones */
	r->cnr_ours = hc_read(UFSHC_UTRLCNR) & ~hc_cnr_in;
	if (r->cnr_ours != 0) {
		hc_write(UFSHC_UTRLCNR, r->cnr_ours);
	}
	hc_write(UFSHC_UTRLRSR, 0);
	for (t = mach_absolute_time(); (hc_read(UFSHC_UTRLRSR) & 1) && hc_us_since(t) < 5000;) {
		__builtin_arm_yield();
	}
	hc_write(UFSHC_UTRLBA, hc_loader.uefi_lo);
	hc_write(UFSHC_UTRLBAU, hc_loader.uefi_hi);
	hc_write(UFSHC_UTRLRSR, 1);
	r->lo = hc_read(UFSHC_UTRLBA);
	r->hi = hc_read(UFSHC_UTRLBAU);
	r->rsr = hc_read(UFSHC_UTRLRSR);
	r->db = hc_read(UFSHC_UTRLDBR);
	r->is = hc_read(UFSHC_IS);
	r->cnr = hc_read(UFSHC_UTRLCNR);
	r->ok = r->lo == hc_loader.uefi_lo && r->hi == hc_loader.uefi_hi && (r->rsr & 1);
	if (r->ok) {
		*hc_loader.list_in = 0;
		(*hc_loader.switched_out)++;
		hc_switch_out_count++;
	}
}

static void
hc_put_back_print(const char *why, const struct hc_put_back_result *r, bool late)
{
	void (*say)(const char *, ...) = late ? hc_say_late : hc_say;

	if (r->cleared) {
		say("ufs: native: %s: doorbell %08x did not clear in 1 s: this kernel's slots cleared (UTRLCLR), doorbell "
		    "then %08x\n", why, r->db_before, r->db_after_clear);
	}
	say("ufs: native: %s: transfer list %s UEFI's %08x:%08x (run %u, doorbell %08x; IS %08x, at the switch %08x; "
	    "completion %08x after clearing this kernel's %08x, at the switch %08x%s)\n", why, r->ok ? "back to" :
	    "NOT BACK TO", r->hi, r->lo, r->rsr, r->db, r->is, hc_is_in, r->cnr, r->cnr_ours, hc_cnr_in,
	    r->cnr == hc_cnr_in ? ", as it was" : ", NOT AS IT WAS");
}

/*
 * This kernel's list into the controller (the caller holds the loader's mailbox: nothing is asked
 * of UEFI meanwhile). prove: then slot 0's TEST UNIT READY, before anything is read.
 */
int
ufshc_switch_in(bool prove)
{
	uint32_t lo, hi, db, rsr, hcs, uefi_dw0 = 0;
	uint8_t uefi_upiu[32] = { 0 };
	const char *no = NULL;
	struct hc_put_back_result undo;
	boolean_t istate;
	bool undone = false;

	if (!hc_usable || hc_dead || hc_closed) {
		return ENXIO;
	}
	lck_mtx_lock(&hc_lock);
	if (hc_in) {
		lck_mtx_unlock(&hc_lock);
		return 0;
	}
	istate = ml_set_interrupts_enabled(FALSE);
	if (*hc_loader.take_back != 0) {
		no = "the loader has taken the controller back";
	} else {
		no = hc_uefi_slot0(uefi_upiu, &uefi_dw0);
	}
	lo = hc_read(UFSHC_UTRLBA);
	hi = hc_read(UFSHC_UTRLBAU);
	db = hc_read(UFSHC_UTRLDBR);
	rsr = hc_read(UFSHC_UTRLRSR);
	hcs = hc_read(UFSHC_HCS);
	if (no == NULL) {
		if (lo != hc_loader.uefi_lo || hi != hc_loader.uefi_hi) {
			no = "the controller's list is not UEFI's";
		} else if (db != 0) {
			no = "a request in flight";
		} else if ((rsr & 1) == 0 || (hcs & HCS_UTRLRDY) == 0) {
			no = "the list is not running, or not ready";
		}
	}
	if (no == NULL) {
		uint64_t t;

		hc_is_in = hc_read(UFSHC_IS);
		hc_cnr_in = hc_read(UFSHC_UTRLCNR);
		hc_write(UFSHC_UTRLRSR, 0);
		for (t = mach_absolute_time(); (hc_read(UFSHC_UTRLRSR) & 1) && hc_us_since(t) < 5000;) {
			__builtin_arm_yield();
		}
		if (hc_read(UFSHC_UTRLRSR) & 1) {
			no = "the list did not stop";
			hc_write(UFSHC_UTRLRSR, 1);     /* (UEFI's list, running, as it was) */
		} else {
			hc_write(UFSHC_UTRLBA, hc_list_lo);
			hc_write(UFSHC_UTRLBAU, hc_list_hi);
			hc_write(UFSHC_UTRLRSR, 1);
			lo = hc_read(UFSHC_UTRLBA);
			hi = hc_read(UFSHC_UTRLBAU);
			rsr = hc_read(UFSHC_UTRLRSR);
			if (lo != hc_list_lo || hi != hc_list_hi || (rsr & 1) == 0) {
				no = "the controller did not take this list";
				hc_put_back(&undo);
				undone = true;
			} else {
				hc_in = true;
				*hc_loader.cnr_at_switch = hc_cnr_in;
				*hc_loader.list_in = 1;
				(*hc_loader.switched_in)++;
				hc_switch_in_count++;
			}
		}
	}
	ml_set_interrupts_enabled(istate);
	lck_mtx_unlock(&hc_lock);
	if (undone) {
		hc_put_back_print("undoing", &undo, false);
	}
	if (no != NULL) {
		hc_say("ufs: native: this kernel's list not put in: %s (list %08x:%08x, doorbell %08x, run %08x, HCS %08x; UEFI's "
		    "slot 0 %08x, CDB %02x)\n", no, hi, lo, db, rsr, hcs, uefi_dw0, uefi_upiu[16]);
		return EIO;
	}
	hc_say("ufs: native: transfer list switched from UEFI's %08x:%08x to this kernel's %08x:%08x (doorbell 0, run %u; "
	    "IS %08x, completion %08x; UEFI's slot 0 holds a read: %08x, CDB %02x)\n", hc_loader.uefi_hi,
	    hc_loader.uefi_lo, hi, lo, rsr, hc_is_in, hc_cnr_in, uefi_dw0, uefi_upiu[16]);
	if (prove) {
		int e = hc_prove();

		if (e != 0) {
			ufshc_switch_out("after the failed proof");
			hc_off();
			return e;
		}
	}
	return 0;
}

/* UEFI's list back (the caller holds the loader's mailbox) */
int
ufshc_switch_out(const char *why)
{
	struct hc_put_back_result r;
	uint64_t started;
	boolean_t istate;

	lck_mtx_lock(&hc_lock);
	if (!hc_in) {
		lck_mtx_unlock(&hc_lock);
		return 0;
	}
	hc_in = false;                          /* nothing more is rung */
	wakeup(&hc_free);
	lck_mtx_unlock(&hc_lock);
	/* what is in flight finishes (whoever waits for it sees it done) */
	for (started = mach_absolute_time(); hc_read(UFSHC_UTRLDBR) != 0 && hc_us_since(started) < 2000000;) {
		IOSleep(1);
	}
	lck_mtx_lock(&hc_lock);
	istate = ml_set_interrupts_enabled(FALSE);
	hc_put_back(&r);
	ml_set_interrupts_enabled(istate);
	lck_mtx_unlock(&hc_lock);
	hc_put_back_print(why, &r, false);
	if (!r.ok) {
		hc_off();
		return EIO;
	}
	return 0;
}

bool
ufshc_list_in(void)
{
	return hc_in;
}

bool
ufshc_available(void)
{
	return hc_usable && !hc_dead && !hc_closed;
}

void
ufshc_set_luns(uint32_t mask)
{
	hc_lun_mask = mask & 0xff;
}

static void
hc_report(const char *when, bool late)
{
	(late ? hc_say_late : hc_say)("ufs: native: %s: %llu reads, %llu errors, %llu bytes, %llu ms waiting (summed over reads), at most %llu "
	    "in flight, %llu refused, list in %llu times and out %llu times, %llu proofs%s\n", when, hc_requests, hc_errors,
	    hc_bytes, hc_wait_us / 1000, hc_most_in_flight, hc_refused, hc_switch_in_count, hc_switch_out_count, hc_proofs,
	    hc_dead ? "; THE PATH IS OFF" : "");
	{
		uint64_t wait_ns, lock_ns;

		absolutetime_to_nanoseconds(hc_slot_wait_ticks, &wait_ns);
		absolutetime_to_nanoseconds(hc_lock_ticks, &lock_ns);
		(late ? hc_say_late : hc_say)("ufs: native: %s: %llu doorbell reads while waiting (%llu a read), %llu waits for a "
		    "free slot (%llu ms), %llu ms taking the slots' lock; reads put in with 1 in flight %llu, 2 %llu, 3-4 %llu, "
		    "5-8 %llu, 9-16 %llu, more %llu\n", when, hc_polls, hc_requests ? hc_polls / hc_requests : 0, hc_slot_waits,
		    wait_ns / 1000000, lock_ns / 1000000, hc_flight_hist[0], hc_flight_hist[1], hc_flight_hist[2],
		    hc_flight_hist[3], hc_flight_hist[4], hc_flight_hist[5]);
		(late ? hc_say_late : hc_say)("ufs: native: %s: waiters spin %u us, then sleep: %llu slept; the poller %llu "
		    "rounds, %llu doorbell reads\n", when, hc_spin_us, hc_sleeps, hc_poller_rounds, hc_poller_polls);
	}
}

void
ufshc_report(const char *when)
{
	if (hc_usable) {
		hc_report(when, false);
	}
}

/* ---- the probe ---- */

/*
 * What the controller looks like as UEFI left it, and whether this kernel may put a list of its
 * own in (only == true: say so and do not use it).
 */
bool
ufshc_probe(const struct ufshc_loader *loader, bool only)
{
	uint32_t cap, ver, hcs, hce, is, ie, iacr, ahit, base, baseu, db, rsr, cnr, tm_base, tm_baseu, tm_db, tm_rsr;
	uint32_t uefi_dw0 = 0, slots = 31;
	uint8_t uefi_upiu[32] = { 0 };
	uint64_t uefi_pa;
	const char *no = NULL;
	vm_offset_t area;

	if (!hc_whitelist_selftest()) {
		return false;
	}
	hc_loader = *loader;
	PE_parse_boot_argn("ufs_native_buffer", &hc_slot_buffer, sizeof(hc_slot_buffer));
	if (hc_slot_buffer < BLOCK || hc_slot_buffer > (4u << 20) || hc_slot_buffer % BLOCK) {
		hc_slot_buffer = SLOT_BUFFER_DEFAULT;
	}
	PE_parse_boot_argn("ufs_native_slots", &slots, sizeof(slots));
	if (slots < 1 || slots > SLOTS - 1) {
		slots = SLOTS - 1;
	}
	PE_parse_boot_argn("ufs_native_leave", &hc_leave, sizeof(hc_leave));
	PE_parse_boot_argn("ufs_native_hang", &hc_hang_after, sizeof(hc_hang_after));
	if (loader->hc_pa != UFSHC_PHYS || loader->area_pa == 0 || loader->slots != SLOTS || (loader->area_pa & 0x3ff) ||
	    loader->ucd_size < UCD_PRDT + 16 * (hc_slot_buffer / PRD_MAX + 1) || (loader->ucd_offset & 0x7f) ||
	    (loader->ucd_size & 0x7f) || loader->ucd_offset < SLOTS * 32 ||
	    loader->area_size < loader->ucd_offset + SLOTS * loader->ucd_size) {
		hc_say("ufs: native: not used: the loader offers no area for a list (or not one as expected: controller %llx, "
		    "area %llx of %u, command descriptors at %u of %u)\n", loader->hc_pa, loader->area_pa, loader->area_size,
		    loader->ucd_offset, loader->ucd_size);
		return false;
	}
	if (pmap_valid_address(loader->area_pa) || pmap_valid_address(loader->area_pa + loader->area_size - 1)) {
		hc_say("ufs: native: not used: the loader's area %llx is memory this kernel manages\n", loader->area_pa);
		return false;
	}
	hc = ml_io_map(UFSHC_PHYS, UFSHC_SIZE);
	cap = hc_read(UFSHC_CAP);
	ver = hc_read(UFSHC_VER);
	hcs = hc_read(UFSHC_HCS);
	hce = hc_read(UFSHC_HCE);
	is = hc_read(UFSHC_IS);
	ie = hc_read(UFSHC_IE);
	iacr = hc_read(UFSHC_UTRIACR);
	ahit = hc_read(UFSHC_AHIT);
	base = hc_read(UFSHC_UTRLBA);
	baseu = hc_read(UFSHC_UTRLBAU);
	db = hc_read(UFSHC_UTRLDBR);
	rsr = hc_read(UFSHC_UTRLRSR);
	cnr = hc_read(UFSHC_UTRLCNR);
	tm_base = hc_read(UFSHC_UTMRLBA);
	tm_baseu = hc_read(UFSHC_UTMRLBAU);
	tm_db = hc_read(UFSHC_UTMRLDBR);
	tm_rsr = hc_read(UFSHC_UTMRLRSR);
	hc_say("ufs: native: controller at %llx: CAP %08x (%u slots, 64-bit %s), VER %08x, HCDDID %08x, HCPMID %08x\n",
	    UFSHC_PHYS, cap, CAP_NUTRS(cap), (cap & CAP_64AS) ? "yes" : "no", ver, hc_read(UFSHC_HCDDID),
	    hc_read(UFSHC_HCPMID));
	hc_say("ufs: native: HCE %08x, HCS %08x, IS %08x, IE %08x, UTRIACR %08x, AHIT %08x\n", hce, hcs, is, ie, iacr, ahit);
	hc_say("ufs: native: transfer list %08x:%08x (the loader's note of UEFI's: %08x:%08x), doorbell %08x, run %08x, "
	    "completion %08x; task management list %08x:%08x, doorbell %08x, run %08x\n", baseu, base, loader->uefi_hi,
	    loader->uefi_lo, db, rsr, cnr, tm_baseu, tm_base, tm_db, tm_rsr);
	uefi_pa = (uint64_t)baseu << 32 | base;

	if ((hce & 1) == 0) {
		no = "the controller is not enabled";
	} else if ((hcs & (HCS_DP | HCS_UTRLRDY)) != (HCS_DP | HCS_UTRLRDY)) {
		no = "no device present or the transfer list not ready";
	} else if ((rsr & 1) == 0) {
		no = "the transfer list is not running";
	} else if (ver < 0x200 || ver >= 0x400) {
		no = "a controller version other than 2.x or 3.x";
	} else if (CAP_NUTRS(cap) < SLOTS) {
		no = "fewer than 32 slots";
	} else if ((cap & CAP_64AS) == 0) {
		no = "no 64-bit addressing";
	} else if (is & IS_FATAL) {
		no = "an error status";
	} else if (base != loader->uefi_lo || baseu != loader->uefi_hi) {
		no = "the transfer list is not the one the loader noted as UEFI's";
	} else if (db != 0) {
		no = "a request in flight";
	} else if (pmap_valid_address(uefi_pa)) {
		no = "UEFI's transfer list is in memory this kernel manages";
	}
	if (no == NULL) {
		/* UEFI's list and command descriptor (the page they are in), not cached here, only read */
		hc_uefi_map_pa = uefi_pa & ~(uint64_t)PAGE_MASK;
		hc_uefi_map_size = PAGE_SIZE;
		hc_uefi_map_va = ml_io_map_unmappable((vm_offset_t)hc_uefi_map_pa, PAGE_SIZE, VM_WIMG_WCOMB);
		hc_uefi_list = (volatile uint32_t *)(hc_uefi_map_va + (uefi_pa - hc_uefi_map_pa));
		hc_say("ufs: native: UEFI's slot 0: %08x %08x %08x %08x %08x %08x %08x %08x\n", hc_uefi_list[0], hc_uefi_list[1],
		    hc_uefi_list[2], hc_uefi_list[3], hc_uefi_list[4], hc_uefi_list[5], hc_uefi_list[6], hc_uefi_list[7]);
		no = hc_uefi_slot0(uefi_upiu, &uefi_dw0);
		hc_say("ufs: native: UEFI's last command: UPIU %02x %02x %02x %02x, CDB %02x %02x %02x %02x %02x %02x %02x %02x "
		    "%02x %02x\n", uefi_upiu[0], uefi_upiu[1], uefi_upiu[2], uefi_upiu[3], uefi_upiu[16], uefi_upiu[17],
		    uefi_upiu[18], uefi_upiu[19], uefi_upiu[20], uefi_upiu[21], uefi_upiu[22], uefi_upiu[23], uefi_upiu[24],
		    uefi_upiu[25]);
	}
	if (no != NULL) {
		hc_say("ufs: native: not used: %s; the storage is read through the loader\n", no);
		return false;
	}
	if (only) {
		hc_say("ufs: native: as expected; ufs_native=2 asks for no more than this look\n");
		return false;
	}

	/* this kernel's list and command descriptors, in the loader's area; every slot TEST UNIT READY to begin with */
	area = ml_io_map_unmappable((vm_offset_t)(loader->area_pa & ~(uint64_t)PAGE_MASK),
	    (vm_size_t)round_page((loader->area_pa & PAGE_MASK) + loader->area_size), VM_WIMG_WCOMB) +
	    (vm_offset_t)(loader->area_pa & PAGE_MASK);
	hc_list_lo = (uint32_t)loader->area_pa;
	hc_list_hi = (uint32_t)(loader->area_pa >> 32);
	for (uint32_t i = 0; i < SLOTS; i++) {
		struct hc_slot *s = &hc_slots[i];
		struct hc_cmd c;

		s->number = i;
		s->utrd = (volatile uint32_t *)(area + 32 * i);
		s->ucd = (volatile uint32_t *)(area + loader->ucd_offset + i * loader->ucd_size);
		s->ucd_pa = loader->area_pa + loader->ucd_offset + i * loader->ucd_size;
		if (i >= 1 && i <= slots) {
			vm_offset_t data = 0;

			if (kmem_alloc_contig(kernel_map, &data, round_page(hc_slot_buffer), PAGE_MASK, 0, 0,
			    KMA_KOBJECT | KMA_ZERO | KMA_DATA, VM_KERN_MEMORY_IOKIT) != KERN_SUCCESS) {
				hc_say("ufs: native: not used: no memory for the slots' buffers\n");
				return false;
			}
			s->data = (uint8_t *)data;
			s->data_pa = kvtophys(data);
			FlushPoC_DcacheRegion(data, hc_slot_buffer);
		}
		hc_make_tur(&c, 0, (uint8_t)i);
		if (hc_place(s, &c, 0) != 0) {
			hc_say("ufs: native: not used: slot %u would not take its TEST UNIT READY\n", i);
			return false;
		}
	}
	PE_parse_boot_argn("ufs_native_spin", &hc_spin_us, sizeof(hc_spin_us));
	if (hc_spin_us > 5000) {
		hc_spin_us = 5000;
	}
	{
		thread_t th;

		if (kernel_thread_start(hc_poller, NULL, &th) != KERN_SUCCESS) {
			hc_say("ufs: native: not used: no poller thread\n");
			return false;
		}
		thread_deallocate(th);
	}
	hc_nslots = slots;
	hc_free = (uint32_t)(((1ULL << (slots + 1)) - 1) & ~1ULL);       /* slots 1..n */
	hc_usable = true;
	hc_say("ufs: native: usable: a list of %u slots at %llx (the loader's), reads in %u of them, %u KB each (the logical units reads may go to are set by hakios.ufs.c)%s\n",
	    SLOTS, loader->area_pa, slots, hc_slot_buffer >> 10, hc_leave ? "; ufs_native_leave=1: the list is left in "
	    "at the end, for the loader to take back" : "");
	return true;
}

/*
 * Before the kernel gives the phone back to the loader (loader_return, the other processors
 * already stopped): nothing more is sent, what is in flight is waited for, UEFI's list put back.
 * No locks (a stopped processor may hold one).
 */
void
hakios_ufs_quiesce(void)
{
	struct hc_put_back_result r;

	if (hc_kept_count != 0) {
		hc_say_late("ufs: native: what happened in this run, again:\n");
		for (uint32_t i = hc_kept_count > KEPT_LINES ? hc_kept_count - KEPT_LINES : 0; i < hc_kept_count; i++) {
			const char *line = hc_kept[i % KEPT_LINES];

			hc_say_late("> %s%s", line, line[0] != 0 && line[strlen(line) - 1] == '\n' ? "" : "...\n");
		}
	}
	if (!hc_usable) {
		return;
	}
	hc_closed = true;
	__asm__ volatile ("dsb sy" ::: "memory");
	hc_say_late("ufs: native: at the end: entered with doorbell %08x, %u reads of this kernel's in flight, its list %s\n",
	    hc_read(UFSHC_UTRLDBR), hc_in_flight, hc_in ? "in" : "out");
	if (!hc_in && hc_read(UFSHC_UTRLBA) == hc_loader.uefi_lo && hc_read(UFSHC_UTRLBAU) == hc_loader.uefi_hi &&
	    (hc_read(UFSHC_UTRLRSR) & 1)) {
		hc_say_late("ufs: native: at the end: UEFI's list is in (doorbell %08x)\n", hc_read(UFSHC_UTRLDBR));
		hc_report("at the end", true);
		return;
	}
	hc_in = false;
	if (hc_leave) {
		hc_say_late("ufs: native: at the end: this kernel's list LEFT IN for the loader to take back "
		    "(ufs_native_leave=1; doorbell %08x)\n", hc_read(UFSHC_UTRLDBR));
		hc_report("at the end", true);
		return;
	}
	hc_put_back(&r);
	hc_put_back_print("at the end", &r, true);
	hc_report("at the end", true);
}

```

```h
#ifndef _HAKIOS_UFSHC_H_
```

`drivers/storage/hakios.virtio_blk.c`:

```c
/*
 * A virtio block device, so that a disk image on the host can be a block device in the
 * guest (/dev/rvblk0).  Only with boot-arg virtio_blk=1: the bus address is QEMU's and
 * means nothing on the phone.
 *
 * This exists for the APFS driver.  The volume in darwin165/rootfs.dmg is 5.6 GB, which is
 * too much to hold in guest memory as a RAM disk the way this port's own images are held, and the
 * point of reading APFS is to read a real image rather than one cut down to fit.  QEMU
 * serves it straight off the host's disk:
 *
 *   -drive file=rootfs.apfs,format=raw,if=none,id=d,readonly=on
 *   -device virtio-blk-device,drive=d
 *
 * Under QEMU's "virt" machine the transport is virtio-mmio and must be the current one,
 * not "legacy" (-global virtio-mmio.force-legacy=false).
 *
 * No interrupt is used and only one request is outstanding at a time: a request is put on
 * the queue, the device is notified, and the used ring is watched until it comes back.
 * That is slow in principle and entirely adequate here -- reads come from the APFS
 * driver's own block cache misses, and the host is serving them out of its page cache.
 *
 * Read only, unless the boot-arg is virtio_blk=2: then it writes too, for trying a file system that writes (HFS Plus,
 * the data volume) on a disk image before it is let near the phone's flash.  With 1 a write request is refused, which
 * is one less way to damage an image that is only to be read.
 */

#include <kern/clock.h>
#include <kern/locks.h>
#include <libkern/libkern.h>
#include <mach/mach_types.h>
#include <mach/vm_param.h>
#include <miscfs/devfs/devfs.h>
#include <pexpert/pexpert.h>
#include <sys/buf.h>
#include <sys/conf.h>
#include <sys/disk.h>
#include <sys/errno.h>
#include <sys/systm.h>
#include <sys/hakios.virtio_blk.h>
#include <vm/vm_kern.h>

extern vm_offset_t ml_io_map(vm_offset_t phys_addr, vm_size_t size);
extern uint64_t kvtophys(vm_offset_t va);

#define VIRTIO_BUS              0x0a000000UL    /* QEMU virt: 32 transports of 0x200 bytes */
#define VIRTIO_SLOTS            32
#define VIRTIO_SLOT_SIZE        0x200

#define VIRTIO_MAGIC            0x000           /* "virt" */
#define VIRTIO_VERSION          0x004
#define VIRTIO_DEVICE_ID        0x008
#define VIRTIO_DRIVER_FEATURES  0x020
#define VIRTIO_DRIVER_FEATURES_SEL 0x024
#define VIRTIO_QUEUE_SEL        0x030
#define VIRTIO_QUEUE_NUM_MAX    0x034
#define VIRTIO_QUEUE_NUM        0x038
#define VIRTIO_QUEUE_READY      0x044
#define VIRTIO_QUEUE_NOTIFY     0x050
#define VIRTIO_INTERRUPT_ACK    0x064
#define VIRTIO_STATUS           0x070
#define VIRTIO_QUEUE_DESC       0x080
#define VIRTIO_QUEUE_DRIVER     0x090
#define VIRTIO_QUEUE_DEVICE     0x0a0
#define VIRTIO_CONFIG           0x100           /* the device's own configuration */

#define VIRTIO_ID_BLOCK         2
#define STATUS_ACKNOWLEDGE      1
#define STATUS_DRIVER           2
#define STATUS_DRIVER_OK        4
#define STATUS_FEATURES_OK      8

#define QUEUE_SIZE              64
#define DESC_F_NEXT             1
#define DESC_F_WRITE            2
#define AVAIL_F_NO_INTERRUPT    1

/* the request types we use */
#define VIRTIO_BLK_T_IN         0
#define VIRTIO_BLK_T_OUT        1
#define VIRTIO_BLK_S_OK         0

#define VIRTIO_BLK_SECTOR       512             /* virtio-blk counts in these, always */

/*
 * The most one request may carry.  A request needs one descriptor for its header, one for
 * its status byte and one per page of the data, so this bounds the chain well inside the
 * queue.
 */
#define BLK_MAX_XFER            (64 * 1024)
#define BLK_MAX_DATA_DESC       (BLK_MAX_XFER / PAGE_SIZE + 1)

struct vq_desc {
	uint64_t addr;
	uint32_t len;
	uint16_t flags;
	uint16_t next;
};
struct vq_avail {
	uint16_t flags;
	uint16_t idx;
	uint16_t ring[QUEUE_SIZE];
};
struct vq_used {
	uint16_t flags;
	uint16_t idx;
	struct {
		uint32_t id;
		uint32_t len;
	} ring[QUEUE_SIZE];
};
struct blk_req_hdr {
	uint32_t type;
	uint32_t reserved;
	uint64_t sector;
};

/* the ring and the small request pieces share one page */
#define OFFSET_DESC             0x0000
#define OFFSET_AVAIL            0x0400
#define OFFSET_USED             0x0800
#define OFFSET_HDR              0x0c00
#define OFFSET_STATUS           0x0c40

struct blk_device {
	vm_offset_t          regs;
	vm_offset_t          page;
	uint64_t             page_phys;
	struct vq_desc      *desc;
	struct vq_avail     *avail;
	struct vq_used      *used;
	struct blk_req_hdr  *hdr;
	volatile uint8_t    *status;
	uint16_t             seen;      /* how far the used ring has been read */
	vm_offset_t          bounce;    /* BLK_MAX_XFER of wired memory the device reads and writes */
	uint64_t             bounce_phys[BLK_MAX_XFER / PAGE_MIN_SIZE];
	uint64_t             capacity;  /* in 512-byte sectors */
	lck_mtx_t            lock;
};

static LCK_GRP_DECLARE(blk_lck_grp, "hakios-virtio-blk");
static struct blk_device blk_dev;
static bool blk_ready;
static bool blk_writable;               /* virtio_blk=2 */
static int blk_bmajor = -1, blk_cmajor = -1;

/* One of this driver's devices: every request is a trip through the hypervisor */
bool
hakios_virtio_blk_dev(dev_t dev)
{
	return (blk_bmajor >= 0 && major(dev) == blk_bmajor) ||
	       (blk_cmajor >= 0 && major(dev) == blk_cmajor);
}

static inline uint32_t
reg_read(struct blk_device *d, uint32_t reg)
{
	return *(volatile uint32_t *)(d->regs + reg);
}

static inline void
reg_write(struct blk_device *d, uint32_t reg, uint32_t value)
{
	*(volatile uint32_t *)(d->regs + reg) = value;
}

static inline void
reg_write64(struct blk_device *d, uint32_t reg, uint64_t value)
{
	reg_write(d, reg, (uint32_t)value);
	reg_write(d, reg + 4, (uint32_t)(value >> 32));
}

/*
 * One read, or one write.  The device works on the driver's own wired pages (d->bounce), and `data` is copied in or
 * out: a file system's buffer is not always memory whose physical address kvtophys() can give (a write after a
 * remount had QEMU refuse the descriptor), and a copy of 64 KB costs nothing next to the trip to the host.
 */
static int
blk_io(struct blk_device *d, bool write, uint64_t offset, void *data, size_t len)
{
	uint16_t idx = 0;
	size_t done = 0;
	uint64_t deadline;
	int error = 0;

	if (len == 0 || len > BLK_MAX_XFER) {
		return EINVAL;
	}
	if ((offset % VIRTIO_BLK_SECTOR) != 0) {
		return EINVAL;
	}
	if (offset / VIRTIO_BLK_SECTOR >= d->capacity ||
	    (offset + len) / VIRTIO_BLK_SECTOR > d->capacity) {
		return EINVAL;
	}

	lck_mtx_lock(&d->lock);
	/* a request that waited for the lock while an earlier one timed out must not start on a queue left in that state */
	if (!blk_ready) {
		lck_mtx_unlock(&d->lock);
		return ENXIO;
	}

	d->hdr->type = write ? VIRTIO_BLK_T_OUT : VIRTIO_BLK_T_IN;
	d->hdr->reserved = 0;
	d->hdr->sector = offset / VIRTIO_BLK_SECTOR;
	*d->status = 0xff;

	/* descriptor 0: the header, which the device reads */
	d->desc[0].addr = d->page_phys + OFFSET_HDR;
	d->desc[0].len = sizeof(struct blk_req_hdr);
	d->desc[0].flags = DESC_F_NEXT;
	d->desc[0].next = 1;
	idx = 1;

	/* then the data, one descriptor per page of the bounce buffer */
	if (write) {
		bcopy(data, (void *)d->bounce, len);
	}
	while (done < len) {
		size_t chunk = MIN(PAGE_SIZE, len - done);

		d->desc[idx].addr = d->bounce_phys[done / PAGE_SIZE];
		d->desc[idx].len = (uint32_t)chunk;
		d->desc[idx].flags = (write ? 0 : DESC_F_WRITE) | DESC_F_NEXT;
		d->desc[idx].next = (uint16_t)(idx + 1);
		idx++;
		done += chunk;
	}

	/* last: the status byte, which the device writes */
	d->desc[idx].addr = d->page_phys + OFFSET_STATUS;
	d->desc[idx].len = 1;
	d->desc[idx].flags = DESC_F_WRITE;
	d->desc[idx].next = 0;

	d->avail->flags = AVAIL_F_NO_INTERRUPT;
	d->avail->ring[d->avail->idx % QUEUE_SIZE] = 0;         /* the chain starts at 0 */
	__builtin_arm_dmb(0xb);
	d->avail->idx++;
	__builtin_arm_dmb(0xb);
	reg_write(d, VIRTIO_QUEUE_NOTIFY, 0);

	/* wait for it to come back; a read off the host's disk should take microseconds */
	clock_interval_to_deadline(10, NSEC_PER_SEC, &deadline);
	for (;;) {
		__builtin_arm_dmb(0xb);
		if (d->used->idx != d->seen) {
			d->seen = d->used->idx;
			break;
		}
		if (mach_absolute_time() > deadline) {
			printf("virtio-blk: a %s of %lu bytes at %llu went unanswered\n",
			    write ? "write" : "read", (unsigned long)len, offset);
			/*
			 * The request stays published on the queue and the caller may reuse its buffer: a late
			 * answer would land in it, and the next request would take this stale completion as
			 * its own. So the device is off from now on.
			 */
			blk_ready = false;
			lck_mtx_unlock(&d->lock);
			return EIO;
		}
		delay(10);
	}
	reg_write(d, VIRTIO_INTERRUPT_ACK, reg_read(d, 0x060));  /* keep the device quiet */

	if (*d->status != VIRTIO_BLK_S_OK) {
		printf("virtio-blk: a %s of %lu bytes at %llu failed with status %u\n",
		    write ? "write" : "read", (unsigned long)len, offset, *d->status);
		error = EIO;
	} else if (!write) {
		bcopy((void *)d->bounce, data, len);
	}
	lck_mtx_unlock(&d->lock);
	return error;
}

/* ---- the block device ---- */

static int
blk_dev_open(__unused dev_t dev, int flags, __unused int devtype, __unused proc_t p)
{
	if (!blk_ready) {
		return ENXIO;
	}
	if ((flags & FWRITE) && !blk_writable) {
		return EROFS;
	}
	return 0;
}

static int
blk_dev_close(__unused dev_t dev, __unused int flags, __unused int devtype,
    __unused proc_t p)
{
	return 0;
}

static void
blk_dev_strategy(buf_t bp)
{
	struct blk_device *d = &blk_dev;
	uint64_t offset;
	size_t len;
	int error;

	if (!blk_ready) {
		buf_seterror(bp, ENXIO);
		buf_biodone(bp);
		return;
	}
	if (!(buf_flags(bp) & B_READ) && !blk_writable) {
		buf_seterror(bp, EROFS);         /* this device writes only with virtio_blk=2 */
		buf_biodone(bp);
		return;
	}
	offset = (uint64_t)buf_blkno(bp) * VIRTIO_BLK_SECTOR;
	len = buf_count(bp);

	/* trim a request that runs off the end, and refuse one that starts past it */
	if (offset >= d->capacity * VIRTIO_BLK_SECTOR) {
		buf_seterror(bp, offset == d->capacity * VIRTIO_BLK_SECTOR ? 0 : EINVAL);
		buf_setresid(bp, buf_count(bp));
		buf_biodone(bp);
		return;
	}
	if (offset + len > d->capacity * VIRTIO_BLK_SECTOR) {
		len = (size_t)(d->capacity * VIRTIO_BLK_SECTOR - offset);
	}

	/*
	 * A file system's cluster I/O (HFS Plus's) hands over a buffer of pages that has no kernel address yet:
	 * buf_dataptr() of it is an offset, and buf_map() is what gives it one.
	 */
	caddr_t mapped;
	if ((error = buf_map(bp, &mapped)) != 0) {
		buf_seterror(bp, error);
		buf_biodone(bp);
		return;
	}
	{
		uint8_t *dst = (uint8_t *)mapped;
		size_t done = 0;

		while (done < len && error == 0) {
			size_t chunk = len - done;

			if (chunk > BLK_MAX_XFER) {
				chunk = BLK_MAX_XFER;
			}
			error = blk_io(d, !(buf_flags(bp) & B_READ), offset + done, dst + done, chunk);
			done += chunk;
		}
		buf_setresid(bp, (uint32_t)(buf_count(bp) - (error ? 0 : done)));
	}
	buf_unmap(bp);
	if (error) {
		buf_seterror(bp, error);
	}
	buf_biodone(bp);
}

static int
blk_dev_ioctl(__unused dev_t dev, u_long cmd, caddr_t data, __unused int fflag,
    __unused proc_t p)
{
	struct blk_device *d = &blk_dev;

	if (!blk_ready) {
		return ENXIO;
	}
	switch (cmd) {
	case DKIOCGETBLOCKSIZE:
		*(uint32_t *)data = VIRTIO_BLK_SECTOR;
		return 0;
	case DKIOCSETBLOCKSIZE:
		/*
		 * spec_open() sets the block size to 512 to count the device in 512-byte
		 * blocks and then sets it back, and treats a refusal of either as the device
		 * being broken (ENXIO).  virtio-blk counts in 512-byte sectors and nothing
		 * else, so that is the only size to agree to.
		 */
		if (*(uint32_t *)data != VIRTIO_BLK_SECTOR) {
			return EINVAL;
		}
		return 0;
	case DKIOCGETBLOCKCOUNT:
		*(uint64_t *)data = d->capacity;
		return 0;
	case DKIOCISWRITABLE:
		*(uint32_t *)data = blk_writable;
		return 0;
	case DKIOCGETMAXBLOCKCOUNTREAD:
	case DKIOCGETMAXBLOCKCOUNTWRITE:
		*(uint64_t *)data = BLK_MAX_XFER / VIRTIO_BLK_SECTOR;
		return 0;
	case DKIOCSYNCHRONIZE:
	case DKIOCSYNCHRONIZECACHE:
		/* no VIRTIO_BLK_F_FLUSH is taken, so the device writes through: a write that came back is on the disk */
		return 0;
	default:
		return ENOTTY;
	}
}

static int
blk_dev_size(dev_t dev)
{
	(void)dev;
	return blk_ready ? VIRTIO_BLK_SECTOR : -1;
}

static int
blk_dev_read(__unused dev_t dev, struct uio *uio, __unused int ioflag)
{
	/* the character device is here so that tools can see the disk; reads go by buffer */
	return physio(blk_dev_strategy, NULL, dev, B_READ, (u_int (*)(buf_t))blk_dev_size,
	    uio, VIRTIO_BLK_SECTOR);
}

static int
blk_dev_write(__unused dev_t dev, struct uio *uio, __unused int ioflag)
{
	return physio(blk_dev_strategy, NULL, dev, B_WRITE, (u_int (*)(buf_t))blk_dev_size,
	    uio, VIRTIO_BLK_SECTOR);
}

static const struct bdevsw blk_bdevsw = {
	.d_open     = blk_dev_open,
	.d_close    = blk_dev_close,
	.d_strategy = blk_dev_strategy,
	.d_ioctl    = blk_dev_ioctl,
	.d_dump     = eno_dump,
	.d_psize    = blk_dev_size,
	.d_type     = D_DISK,
};

static const struct cdevsw blk_cdevsw = {
	.d_open       = blk_dev_open,
	.d_close      = blk_dev_close,
	.d_read       = blk_dev_read,
	.d_write      = blk_dev_write,
	.d_ioctl      = blk_dev_ioctl,
	.d_stop       = eno_stop,
	.d_reset      = eno_reset,
	.d_ttys       = NULL,
	.d_select     = eno_select,
	.d_mmap       = eno_mmap,
	.d_strategy   = eno_strat,
	.d_reserved_1 = eno_getc,
	.d_reserved_2 = eno_putc,
	.d_type       = D_DISK,
};

/* ---- bringing it up ---- */

static bool
blk_attach(struct blk_device *d, int slot)
{
	uint32_t cap_lo, cap_hi;

	if (kmem_alloc(kernel_map, &d->page, PAGE_SIZE,
	    KMA_KOBJECT | KMA_ZERO | KMA_DATA, VM_KERN_MEMORY_IOKIT) != KERN_SUCCESS) {
		return false;
	}
	d->page_phys = kvtophys(d->page);
	d->desc = (struct vq_desc *)(d->page + OFFSET_DESC);
	d->avail = (struct vq_avail *)(d->page + OFFSET_AVAIL);
	d->used = (struct vq_used *)(d->page + OFFSET_USED);
	d->hdr = (struct blk_req_hdr *)(d->page + OFFSET_HDR);
	d->status = (volatile uint8_t *)(d->page + OFFSET_STATUS);
	if (kmem_alloc(kernel_map, &d->bounce, BLK_MAX_XFER,
	    KMA_KOBJECT | KMA_ZERO | KMA_DATA, VM_KERN_MEMORY_IOKIT) != KERN_SUCCESS) {
		return false;
	}
	for (int i = 0; i < BLK_MAX_XFER / PAGE_SIZE; i++) {
		d->bounce_phys[i] = kvtophys(d->bounce + (vm_offset_t)i * PAGE_SIZE);
	}

	reg_write(d, VIRTIO_STATUS, 0);         /* reset */
	reg_write(d, VIRTIO_STATUS, STATUS_ACKNOWLEDGE);
	reg_write(d, VIRTIO_STATUS, STATUS_ACKNOWLEDGE | STATUS_DRIVER);
	/* nothing in the low half is wanted; bit 32 is VIRTIO_F_VERSION_1 */
	reg_write(d, VIRTIO_DRIVER_FEATURES_SEL, 0);
	reg_write(d, VIRTIO_DRIVER_FEATURES, 0);
	reg_write(d, VIRTIO_DRIVER_FEATURES_SEL, 1);
	reg_write(d, VIRTIO_DRIVER_FEATURES, 1);
	reg_write(d, VIRTIO_STATUS, STATUS_ACKNOWLEDGE | STATUS_DRIVER | STATUS_FEATURES_OK);
	if (!(reg_read(d, VIRTIO_STATUS) & STATUS_FEATURES_OK)) {
		printf("virtio-blk: slot %d: features refused\n", slot);
		return false;
	}

	cap_lo = reg_read(d, VIRTIO_CONFIG);
	cap_hi = reg_read(d, VIRTIO_CONFIG + 4);
	d->capacity = ((uint64_t)cap_hi << 32) | cap_lo;
	if (d->capacity == 0) {
		printf("virtio-blk: slot %d: the disk is empty\n", slot);
		return false;
	}

	reg_write(d, VIRTIO_QUEUE_SEL, 0);
	if (reg_read(d, VIRTIO_QUEUE_NUM_MAX) < QUEUE_SIZE) {
		printf("virtio-blk: slot %d: request queue of %u\n", slot,
		    reg_read(d, VIRTIO_QUEUE_NUM_MAX));
		return false;
	}
	reg_write(d, VIRTIO_QUEUE_NUM, QUEUE_SIZE);
	reg_write64(d, VIRTIO_QUEUE_DESC, d->page_phys + OFFSET_DESC);
	reg_write64(d, VIRTIO_QUEUE_DRIVER, d->page_phys + OFFSET_AVAIL);
	reg_write64(d, VIRTIO_QUEUE_DEVICE, d->page_phys + OFFSET_USED);
	__builtin_arm_dmb(0xb);
	reg_write(d, VIRTIO_QUEUE_READY, 1);
	reg_write(d, VIRTIO_STATUS,
	    STATUS_ACKNOWLEDGE | STATUS_DRIVER | STATUS_FEATURES_OK | STATUS_DRIVER_OK);
	return true;
}

void
hakios_virtio_blk_init(void)
{
	uint32_t enabled = 0;
	vm_offset_t bus;
	struct blk_device *d = &blk_dev;
	int slot;

	if (!PE_parse_boot_argn("virtio_blk", &enabled, sizeof(enabled)) || !enabled) {
		return;
	}
	blk_writable = enabled == 2;
	bus = ml_io_map(VIRTIO_BUS, VIRTIO_SLOTS * VIRTIO_SLOT_SIZE);
	for (slot = 0; slot < VIRTIO_SLOTS; slot++) {
		d->regs = bus + (vm_offset_t)slot * VIRTIO_SLOT_SIZE;
		if (reg_read(d, VIRTIO_MAGIC) != 0x74726976 ||
		    reg_read(d, VIRTIO_DEVICE_ID) != VIRTIO_ID_BLOCK) {
			continue;
		}
		if (reg_read(d, VIRTIO_VERSION) != 2) {
			printf("virtio-blk: slot %d is a legacy transport; start QEMU with "
			    "-global virtio-mmio.force-legacy=false\n", slot);
			continue;
		}
		lck_mtx_init(&d->lock, &blk_lck_grp, LCK_ATTR_NULL);
		if (!blk_attach(d, slot)) {
			lck_mtx_destroy(&d->lock, &blk_lck_grp);
			continue;
		}
		blk_bmajor = bdevsw_add(-1, &blk_bdevsw);
		if (blk_bmajor < 0) {
			printf("virtio-blk: bdevsw_add failed\n");
			return;
		}
		blk_cmajor = cdevsw_add_with_bdev(-1, &blk_cdevsw, blk_bmajor);
		if (blk_cmajor < 0) {
			printf("virtio-blk: cdevsw_add failed\n");
			return;
		}
		if (devfs_make_node(makedev(blk_bmajor, 0), DEVFS_BLOCK, UID_ROOT,
		    GID_OPERATOR, 0600, "rvblk0") == NULL ||
		    devfs_make_node(makedev(blk_cmajor, 0), DEVFS_CHAR, UID_ROOT,
		    GID_OPERATOR, 0600, "rrvblk0") == NULL) {
			printf("virtio-blk: devfs_make_node failed\n");
			return;
		}
		blk_ready = true;
		printf("virtio-blk: /dev/rvblk0 in slot %d, %llu sectors of %u (%llu MB)%s\n",
		    slot, d->capacity, VIRTIO_BLK_SECTOR,
		    d->capacity * VIRTIO_BLK_SECTOR / (1024 * 1024), blk_writable ? ", writable" : "");
		return;
	}
	printf("virtio-blk: no block device on the bus\n");
}
```

`drivers/wifi/hakios.apple80211.c`:

```c
/*
 * Darwin-on-hakios: Apple80211, answered in the kernel.
 *
 * Darwin's Wi-Fi side -- wifid, and through it Settings and the status bar -- talks to a Wi-Fi
 * driver in requests that were once ioctls and are, where the driver offers no user client,
 * ioctls still: SIOCGA80211 and SIOCSA80211 on any socket, with a struct apple80211req that
 * names the interface, a request type, a value, and a buffer in the caller's memory
 * (IO80211.framework: Apple80211Get/Set and their kin all end there). XNU hands an interface
 * ioctl it does not know to the interface, so they arrive in drivers/net/hakios.net.c, which
 * passes them here when its link is a radio.
 *
 * What is asked is answered from the station boundary (sys/hakios.sta.h): the radio's power,
 * its channels, a scan and what it heard, the network joined. What happens there by itself is
 * told to Darwin the way a driver tells it: kernel events of class 6 (IEEE 802.11), subclass 1,
 * whose code is Apple80211's own event number and whose data begins with the interface's name
 * in 16 bytes (IO80211.framework reads them from a PF_SYSTEM socket and compares the name).
 *
 * Every request is still written to the log -- who asks, get or set, the type, the value, the
 * length -- because which of them wifid needs is found that way. Never what a request carries:
 * a network's name or its key may be in there.
 *
 * The request types and the layouts are Apple's. The old ones are as the headers of its open
 * IO80211 sources once described them (apple80211_ioctl.h, apple80211_var.h); where Darwin userland 16.5
 * differs the layout was read out of IO80211.framework of 16.5, which fills and reads the same
 * structures on the other side (Apple80211GetWithIOCTL, _getScanData, _addScanResultToList,
 * _performAssociation, _dispatchAsyncAssocEvent, _dispatchLinkChangedEvent).
 *
 * A join: ASSOCIATE (20) carries the network's name, perhaps its access point, and the
 * passphrase as typed (the framework does not make the key of it), and is answered at once;
 * when the station has joined or failed, event 9 says so, and ASSOCIATE_RESULT (21) gives the
 * outcome as one of Apple80211's result numbers, which the framework turns into its errors:
 * 1 success, 21 "invalid PMK" (a wrong passphrase), 9 a timeout, 2 anything else.
 */
#include <kern/kalloc.h>
#include <kern/locks.h>
#include <libkern/libkern.h>
#include <sys/errno.h>
#include <sys/kern_event.h>
#include <sys/kernel.h>
#include <sys/proc.h>
#include <sys/hakios.input.h>
#include <sys/hakios.net.h>
#include <sys/hakios.sta.h>
#include <sys/sockio.h>
#include <sys/systm.h>

#define SIOCSA80211             0x802869c8u     /* _IOW('i', 200, struct apple80211req) */
#define SIOCGA80211             0xc02869c9u     /* _IOWR('i', 201, struct apple80211req) */

struct apple80211req {
	char req_if_name[16];
	int32_t req_type;
	int32_t req_val;
	uint32_t req_len;
	user_addr_t req_data __attribute__((aligned(8)));
};

/* (as far as they have come by: the names help reading the log) */
static const char *
type_name(int32_t type)
{
	static const struct {
		int32_t type;
		const char *name;
	} names[] = {
		{ 1, "SSID" }, { 2, "AUTH_TYPE" }, { 3, "CIPHER_KEY" }, { 4, "CHANNEL" }, { 5, "POWERSAVE" }, { 6, "PROTMODE" },
		{ 7, "TXPOWER" }, { 8, "RATE" }, { 9, "BSSID" }, { 10, "SCAN_REQ" }, { 11, "SCAN_RESULT" }, { 12, "CARD_CAPABILITIES" },
		{ 13, "STATE" }, { 14, "PHY_MODE" }, { 15, "OP_MODE" }, { 16, "RSSI" }, { 17, "NOISE" }, { 18, "INT_MIT" }, { 19, "POWER" },
		{ 20, "ASSOCIATE" }, { 21, "ASSOCIATE_RESULT" }, { 22, "DISASSOCIATE" }, { 23, "STATUS_DEV_NAME" }, { 24, "IBSS_MODE" },
		{ 25, "HOST_AP_MODE" }, { 26, "AP_MODE" }, { 27, "SUPPORTED_CHANNELS" }, { 28, "LOCALE" }, { 29, "DEAUTH" },
		{ 30, "COUNTERMEASURES" }, { 32, "RATE_SET" }, { 42, "STATION_LIST" }, { 43, "DRIVER_VERSION" },
		{ 44, "HARDWARE_VERSION" }, { 46, "RSN_IE" }, { 47, "BACKGROUND_SCAN" }, { 48, "AP_IE_LIST" }, { 49, "STATS" },
		{ 50, "ASSOCIATION_STATUS" }, { 51, "COUNTRY_CODE" }, { 54, "RADIO_INFO" }, { 57, "MCS" }, { 66, "MCS_INDEX_SET" },
		{ 79, "STA_STATS" }, { 80, "ROAM_THRESH" }, { 85, "IE" }, { 86, "SCAN_REQ_MULTIPLE" }, { 87, "BTCOEX_MODE" },
		{ 90, "SCANCACHE_CLEAR" }, { 94, "VIRTUAL_IF_CREATE" }, { 95, "VIRTUAL_IF_DELETE" }, { 103, "CURRENT_NETWORK" },
		{ 106, "RSSI_BOUNDS" }, { 107, "ROAM" }, { 207, "CHANNELS_INFO" }, { 254, "HW_SUPPORTED_CHANNELS" },
	};

	for (unsigned i = 0; i < sizeof(names) / sizeof(names[0]); i++) {
		if (names[i].type == type) {
			return names[i].name;
		}
	}
	return "?";
}

/* ---- the layouts ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ */

#define CHANNEL_20MHZ           0x2u
#define CHANNEL_2GHZ            0x8u
#define CHANNEL_5GHZ            0x10u
#define CHANNEL_ACTIVE          0x80u           /* the radio may send there */
#define CHANNEL_DFS             0x100u

struct apple80211_channel {
	uint32_t version, channel, flags;
};

/* SUPPORTED_CHANNELS (27) and HW_SUPPORTED_CHANNELS (254): 4824 bytes */
struct apple80211_channels {
	uint32_t version, count;
	struct apple80211_channel channels[401];
	uint32_t unused;
};

/* CHANNELS_INFO (207): 10016 bytes; of each channel a byte in each of several rows, and a word of flags */
struct apple80211_channels_info {
	uint8_t unknown_0[12];
	uint16_t count;
	uint8_t unknown_1[800];
	uint8_t number[400], indoor[400], dfs[400], passive[400], wide_40[400], wide_80[400];
	uint8_t unknown_2[1602];
	uint32_t flags[400];
	uint8_t unknown_3[3600];
} __attribute__((packed));

/* SCAN_REQ (10): 5456 bytes */
struct apple80211_scan_request {
	uint32_t version, bss_type;
	uint8_t bssid[6], unused_0[2];
	uint32_t ssid_length;
	uint8_t ssid[32];
	uint32_t scan_type;                     /* 1: asking, 2: listening only */
	uint32_t phy_mode;
	uint16_t dwell_ms, unused_1;
	uint32_t rest_ms;
	uint32_t channel_count;
	struct apple80211_channel channels[400];
	uint64_t flags;
	uint32_t unused_2;
	uint32_t name_count;                    /* networks asked for by name, each in 56 bytes */
	uint8_t names[10][56];
	uint32_t short_ssid, unused_3;
};

/* SCAN_RESULT (11) and CURRENT_NETWORK (103): 1164 bytes */
struct apple80211_scan_result {
	uint32_t version;
	struct apple80211_channel channel;
	uint16_t noise_known;
	int16_t noise, snr, rssi;
	uint16_t beacon_interval, capability;
	uint8_t bssid[6];
	uint8_t rate_count, unused_0;
	uint32_t rates[15];                     /* Mbit/s */
	uint8_t ssid_length, ssid[32], unused_1[3];
	uint32_t age_ms;
	uint8_t flags, unused_2;
	uint16_t elements_length;               /* comes in as the room there is */
	uint8_t elements[1024];
};

/* ASSOCIATE (20): 592 bytes; of what follows the key (the RSN element wifid built, flags) nothing is used */
struct apple80211_assoc {
	uint32_t version;
	uint16_t mode, auth_lower, auth_upper, unused_0;
	uint32_t ssid_length;
	uint8_t ssid[32];
	uint8_t bssid[6], unused_1[2];
	uint32_t key_version, key_length, key_cipher;   /* cipher 10: a passphrase as typed; 6: the key (from 64 hex digits) */
	uint16_t key_flags, key_index;
	uint8_t key[64];
	uint8_t rest[0x250 - 0x88];
};

#define CIPHER_PMK              6
#define CIPHER_PASSPHRASE       10

/* the link event's data (at least 32 bytes, or the framework drops the event) */
struct apple80211_link_changed {
	uint8_t down, unused_0[3];
	int32_t rssi;
	uint16_t snr, noise;
	uint8_t unused_1[4];
	uint8_t involuntary, unused_2[3];
	uint32_t reason, subreason;
	uint8_t unused_3[4];
};

_Static_assert(sizeof(struct apple80211_assoc) == 592 && offsetof(struct apple80211_assoc, key) == 0x48,
    "the association request as Darwin userland 16.5 has it");
_Static_assert(sizeof(struct apple80211_link_changed) == 32 && offsetof(struct apple80211_link_changed, reason) == 0x14,
    "the link event as Darwin userland 16.5 reads it");
_Static_assert(sizeof(struct apple80211_channels) == 4824, "the channel list as Darwin userland 16.5 has it");
_Static_assert(sizeof(struct apple80211_channels_info) == 10016 && offsetof(struct apple80211_channels_info, number) == 0x32e &&
    offsetof(struct apple80211_channels_info, flags) == 0x12d0, "the channels' description as Darwin userland 16.5 has it");
_Static_assert(sizeof(struct apple80211_scan_request) == 5456 && offsetof(struct apple80211_scan_request, channels) == 0x48 &&
    offsetof(struct apple80211_scan_request, flags) == 0x1308 && offsetof(struct apple80211_scan_request, names) == 0x1318,
    "the scan request as Darwin userland 16.5 has it");
_Static_assert(sizeof(struct apple80211_scan_result) == 1164 && offsetof(struct apple80211_scan_result, ssid_length) == 0x60 &&
    offsetof(struct apple80211_scan_result, age_ms) == 0x84 && offsetof(struct apple80211_scan_result, elements) == 0x8c,
    "a scan's result as Darwin userland 16.5 has it");

/* Apple80211's events (APPLE80211_M_...) */
enum { EVENT_POWER_CHANGED = 1, EVENT_SSID_CHANGED = 2, EVENT_BSSID_CHANGED = 3, EVENT_LINK_CHANGED = 4, EVENT_ASSOC_DONE = 9,
       EVENT_SCAN_DONE = 10 };

static const char interface_name[16] = "en0";   /* (drivers/net/hakios.net.c makes one interface, and that is its name) */

static LCK_GRP_DECLARE(apple80211_lock_group, "hakios-apple80211");
static LCK_MTX_DECLARE(apple80211_lock, &apple80211_lock_group);
static unsigned result_next;                    /* which of what the last scan heard a SCAN_RESULT request gets next */
static uint32_t join_result;                    /* of the last join asked for: 0 while it runs, then Apple80211's number */

/* ---- channels ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

static unsigned
channel_number(unsigned frequency)
{
	return frequency == 2484 ? 14 : frequency < 4000 ? (frequency - 2407) / 5 : (frequency - 5000) / 5;
}

static unsigned
channel_frequency(const struct apple80211_channel *channel)
{
	bool low = channel->flags & CHANNEL_2GHZ ? true : channel->flags & CHANNEL_5GHZ ? false : channel->channel <= 14;

	if (channel->channel == 0 || channel->channel > 196 || (channel->flags & 0x2000)) {     /* (0x2000: 6 GHz) */
		return 0;
	}
	return low ? (channel->channel == 14 ? 2484 : 2407 + 5 * channel->channel) : 5000 + 5 * channel->channel;
}

static void
channel_fill(struct apple80211_channel *channel, unsigned frequency, unsigned flags)
{
	channel->version = 1;
	channel->channel = channel_number(frequency);
	channel->flags = CHANNEL_20MHZ | (frequency < 4000 ? CHANNEL_2GHZ : CHANNEL_5GHZ) | (flags & HAKIOS_STA_CHANNEL_PASSIVE ?
	    0 : CHANNEL_ACTIVE) | (flags & HAKIOS_STA_CHANNEL_RADAR ? CHANNEL_DFS : 0);
}

/* ---- what the caller is given back ------------------------------------------------------------------- */

/* At most as many bytes as it has room for. */
static int
give(const struct apple80211req *request, const void *data, size_t length)
{
	return request->req_data == USER_ADDR_NULL ? 0 : copyout(data, request->req_data, length < request->req_len ? length :
	       request->req_len);
}

/* An access point in the form a scan's result has; the caller has said how much room for elements there is. */
static int
give_network(const struct apple80211req *request, const struct hakios_sta_bss *bss)
{
	struct apple80211_scan_result *result = kalloc_data(sizeof(*result), Z_WAITOK | Z_ZERO);
	unsigned room = sizeof(result->elements);
	int error;

	if (result == NULL) {
		return ENOMEM;
	}
	if (request->req_len >= sizeof(*result) && copyin(request->req_data, result, offsetof(struct apple80211_scan_result,
	    elements)) == 0 && result->elements_length < room) {
		room = result->elements_length;
	}
	bzero(result, sizeof(*result));
	result->version = 1;
	channel_fill(&result->channel, bss->frequency, 0);
	result->rssi = bss->rssi;
	result->beacon_interval = bss->beacon_interval;
	result->capability = bss->capability;
	memcpy(result->bssid, bss->bssid, sizeof(result->bssid));
	result->ssid_length = bss->ssid_length;
	memcpy(result->ssid, bss->ssid, bss->ssid_length);
	result->age_ms = bss->age_ms;
	result->elements_length = (uint16_t)(bss->elements_length <= room ? bss->elements_length : 0);
	memcpy(result->elements, bss->elements, result->elements_length);
	/* the rates it says it has (elements 1 and 50: units of 500 kbit/s, the top bit marks the ones everybody must have) */
	for (unsigned at = 0; at + 2 <= bss->elements_length && at + 2 + bss->elements[at + 1] <= bss->elements_length;
	    at += 2 + bss->elements[at + 1]) {
		for (unsigned i = 0; (bss->elements[at] == 1 || bss->elements[at] == 50) && i < bss->elements[at + 1]; i++) {
			unsigned rate = (bss->elements[at + 2 + i] & 0x7f) / 2;

			if (rate != 0 && rate <= 54 && result->rate_count < 15) {
				result->rates[result->rate_count++] = rate;
			}
		}
	}
	error = give(request, result, sizeof(*result));
	kfree_data(result, sizeof(*result));
	return error;
}

/* ---- get ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

static int
get(struct apple80211req *request)
{
	struct hakios_sta_state *state;
	int error = 0;

	switch (request->req_type) {
	case 43:
	case 44: {                              /* the driver's and the hardware's name: the text alone, in 256 bytes */
		static const char name[256] = "hakios: ath11k for the WCN6750";

		return give(request, name, sizeof(name));
	}
	case 12: {
		/*
		 * What the card can do, a bit each (apple80211_var.h: APPLE80211_CAP_*): the 13 bytes are the
		 * bits alone, from the first (the framework hands in a buffer that begins after the old
		 * header's version word). AES, AES-CCM, power management, short slot and preamble, WPA2, WME,
		 * short guard interval at 20 MHz. Read wrong, the framework sees no WPA2 and builds no join
		 * for a WPA2 network ("Unable to join").
		 */
		uint8_t bits[13] = { 0 };
		static const uint8_t has[] = { 2, 3, 6, 9, 10, 14, 17, 19 };

		for (unsigned i = 0; i < sizeof(has); i++) {
			bits[has[i] / 8] |= (uint8_t)(1u << (has[i] % 8));
		}
		return give(request, bits, sizeof(bits));
	}
	case 19: {                              /* the radio's power: one radio. Until the driver is up it counts as on: it */
		struct {                        /* is being brought up, and Darwin asks this once, early */
			uint32_t version, radios, state[4];
		} answer = { .version = 1, .radios = 1, .state = { !hakios_sta_present() || hakios_sta_powered() } };

		return give(request, &answer, sizeof(answer));
	}
	case 15:                                /* the mode: a station (APPLE80211_M_STA) */
		request->req_val = 1;
		return 0;
	case 27:
	case 254: {                             /* the channels the radio may tune to */
		struct apple80211_channels *answer;
		struct hakios_sta_channel channels[96];
		unsigned count = hakios_sta_channels(channels, 96);

		if (count == 0 || (answer = kalloc_data(sizeof(*answer), Z_WAITOK | Z_ZERO)) == NULL) {
			return count == 0 ? ENXIO : ENOMEM;
		}
		answer->version = 1;
		answer->count = count;
		for (unsigned i = 0; i < count; i++) {
			channel_fill(&answer->channels[i], channels[i].frequency, channels[i].flags);
		}
		error = give(request, answer, sizeof(*answer));
		kfree_data(answer, sizeof(*answer));
		return error;
	}
	case 207: {                             /* ... and more of each */
		struct apple80211_channels_info *answer;
		struct hakios_sta_channel channels[96];
		unsigned count = hakios_sta_channels(channels, 96);

		if (count == 0 || (answer = kalloc_data(sizeof(*answer), Z_WAITOK | Z_ZERO)) == NULL) {
			return count == 0 ? ENXIO : ENOMEM;
		}
		answer->count = (uint16_t)count;
		for (unsigned i = 0; i < count; i++) {
			struct apple80211_channel channel;

			channel_fill(&channel, channels[i].frequency, channels[i].flags);
			answer->number[i] = (uint8_t)channel.channel;
			answer->dfs[i] = (channels[i].flags & HAKIOS_STA_CHANNEL_RADAR) != 0;
			answer->passive[i] = (channels[i].flags & HAKIOS_STA_CHANNEL_PASSIVE) != 0;
			answer->flags[i] = channel.flags;
		}
		error = give(request, answer, sizeof(*answer));
		kfree_data(answer, sizeof(*answer));
		return error;
	}
	case 21:                                /* how the last join went (0: not over yet) */
		lck_mtx_lock(&apple80211_lock);
		request->req_val = (int32_t)join_result;
		lck_mtx_unlock(&apple80211_lock);
		return 0;
	case 11: {                              /* what the last scan heard, one access point a request; EIO: that was all */
		struct hakios_sta_bss *bss = kalloc_data(sizeof(*bss), Z_WAITOK);
		unsigned index;
		bool there;

		if (bss == NULL) {
			return ENOMEM;
		}
		lck_mtx_lock(&apple80211_lock);
		index = result_next++;
		lck_mtx_unlock(&apple80211_lock);
		there = hakios_sta_heard(index, bss);
		error = there ? give_network(request, bss) : EIO;
		kfree_data(bss, sizeof(*bss));
		return error;
	}
	default:
		break;
	}

	/* the rest is about the network joined, and there is none unless the station says so */
	if ((state = kalloc_data(sizeof(*state), Z_WAITOK)) == NULL) {
		return ENOMEM;
	}
	hakios_sta_state(state);
	switch (request->req_type) {
	case 13:                                /* the state: APPLE80211_S_INIT 0, _SCAN 1, _AUTH 2, _ASSOC 3, _RUN 4 */
		request->req_val = state->phase == HAKIOS_STA_JOINED ? 4 : state->phase == HAKIOS_STA_JOINING ? 2 :
		    state->phase == HAKIOS_STA_SCANNING ? 1 : 0;
		break;
	case 1:                                 /* its name; the length goes back in the request */
		if (state->phase != HAKIOS_STA_JOINED) {
			error = ENXIO;
		} else if ((error = give(request, state->bss.ssid, state->bss.ssid_length)) == 0) {
			request->req_len = state->bss.ssid_length;
		}
		break;
	case 9:                                 /* its access point's address */
		error = state->phase != HAKIOS_STA_JOINED ? ENXIO : give(request, state->bss.bssid, 6);
		break;
	case 4: {                               /* its channel */
		struct {
			uint32_t version;
			struct apple80211_channel channel;
		} answer = { .version = 1 };

		if (state->phase != HAKIOS_STA_JOINED) {
			error = ENXIO;
		} else {
			channel_fill(&answer.channel, state->bss.frequency, 0);
			error = give(request, &answer, sizeof(answer));
		}
		break;
	}
	case 16: {                              /* how strongly it is heard: dBm, per radio and all together, twice over */
		struct {
			uint32_t version, radios, unit;
			int32_t each[4], all, each_ext[4], all_ext;
		} answer = { .version = 1, .radios = 1, .each = { state->bss.rssi }, .all = state->bss.rssi,
			     .each_ext = { state->bss.rssi }, .all_ext = state->bss.rssi };

		error = state->phase != HAKIOS_STA_JOINED ? ENXIO : give(request, &answer, sizeof(answer));
		break;
	}
	case 103:                               /* all of it, as a scan's result */
```
