```cpp
    syncOne(cb); return cb->cb->passSysmemWhy(i); }

int hakios_metal_cb_pass_attachments(hakios_metal_cb* cb, unsigned i, unsigned* attached, unsigned* touched) {
    syncOne(cb);
    const std::vector<CommandBuffer::PassTime> t = cb->cb->passTimes();
    if (i >= t.size()) return -1;
    *attached = t[i].attached;
    *touched = t[i].touched;
    return 0;
}

int hakios_metal_cb_pass_tiles(hakios_metal_cb* cb, unsigned i) {
    syncOne(cb);
    const std::vector<CommandBuffer::PassTime> t = cb->cb->passTimes();
    return i < t.size() ? int(t[i].tiles) : -1;
}

int hakios_metal_cb_refuse(hakios_metal_cb* cb, const char* why) {
    if (deferring(cb)) {
        std::string w = why != nullptr ? why : "refused";
        cb->deferrer->post(&cb->pending, [cb, w] { cb->cb->refuseWork(w); });
        return -1;
    }
    cb->cb->refuseWork(why != nullptr ? why : "refused");
    return -1;
}

unsigned hakios_metal_cb_skipped(hakios_metal_cb* cb, const char** last) {
    syncOne(cb);
    if (last != nullptr) *last = cb->cb->lastSkipped().c_str();
    return cb->cb->skipped();
}

int hakios_metal_cb_generate_mipmaps(hakios_metal_cb* cb, hakios_metal_texture* t) {
    syncAll(cb);
    if (!cb->cb->generateMipmaps(*t->texture)) {
        failed(cb->cb->error().empty() ? cb->cb->lastSkipped() : cb->cb->error());
        return -1;
    }
    cb->cb->keepAlive(t->texture);
    return 0;
}

namespace {
// the dispatches' shared half: the bindings from the C tables, the dispatch itself (DO), and what has to live until
// the GPU is done with it
int dispatchWith(hakios_metal_cb* cb, hakios_metal_kernel* k, hakios_metal_buffer* const* buffers, const uint64_t* offsets, unsigned count,
                 hakios_metal_texture* const* textures, unsigned textureCount, hakios_metal_sampler* const* samplers, unsigned samplerCount,
                 const std::function<bool(const Bindings&)>& dispatch) {
    Bindings b;
    b.buffers.resize(count);
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        if (buffers[i] != nullptr) {
            b.buffers[i] = Binding{buffers[i]->buffer.get(), offsets != nullptr ? offsets[i] : 0};
        }
    }
    b.textures.resize(textureCount, nullptr);
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < textureCount; i++) {
        if (textures[i] != nullptr) b.textures[i] = textures[i]->texture.get();
    }
    b.samplers.resize(samplerCount, nullptr);
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < samplerCount; i++) {
        if (samplers[i] != nullptr) b.samplers[i] = &samplers[i]->sampler;
    }
    // the kernel's own constexpr samplers at the indices the front end gave them (past the API's)
    for (const auto& [index, sampler] : k->kernel->inlineSamplers) {
        if (b.samplers.size() <= index) b.samplers.resize(index + 1, nullptr);
        b.samplers[index] = &sampler;
    }
    // the encoder's threadgroup memory goes past the kernel's static arrays, where the front end put the argument
    if (k->kernel->hasThreadgroupArg) b.sharedBytes = k->kernel->threadgroupArgBase + cb->threadgroupLength;
    // the members of its argument buffers, from what the sets hold, at the indices the front end gave them
    std::vector<std::shared_ptr<const void>> members;
    std::string whyMembers;
    if (!bindArgumentBuffers(k->kernel->resources, &b, &members, &whyMembers)) {
        failed(whyMembers);
        cb->cb->refuse(whyMembers);
        return -1;
    }
    for (auto& m : members) cb->cb->keepAlive(std::move(m));
    if (!dispatch(b)) {
        failed(cb->cb->error().empty() ? cb->cb->lastSkipped() : cb->cb->error());
        return -1;
    }
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        if (buffers[i] != nullptr) cb->cb->keep(buffers[i]->buffer);
    }
    // the textures' memory as the buffers': kept until the GPU is done, whatever the caller frees meanwhile (the
    // dispatch keeps the Buffer already; the Texture object itself is kept so that a freed handle leaves nothing dangling)
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < textureCount; i++) {
        if (textures[i] != nullptr) {
            cb->cb->keep(textures[i]->texture->buffer());
            cb->cb->keepAlive(textures[i]->texture);
        }
    }
    cb->cb->keepAlive(k->kernel);   // the words the dispatch names live until the GPU is done with them
    return 0;
}
}  // namespace

int hakios_metal_cb_dispatch2(hakios_metal_cb* cb, hakios_metal_kernel* k, const unsigned groups[3], const unsigned threads[3],
                              hakios_metal_buffer* const* buffers, const uint64_t* offsets, unsigned count,
                              hakios_metal_texture* const* textures, unsigned textureCount,
                              hakios_metal_sampler* const* samplers, unsigned samplerCount) {
    syncAll(cb);
    const uint32_t g[3] = {groups[0], groups[1], groups[2]}, t[3] = {threads[0], threads[1], threads[2]};
    return dispatchWith(cb, k, buffers, offsets, count, textures, textureCount, samplers, samplerCount,
                        [&](const Bindings& b) { return cb->cb->dispatch(k->kernel->kernel, g, t, b); });
}

int hakios_metal_cb_dispatch_indirect(hakios_metal_cb* cb, hakios_metal_kernel* k, hakios_metal_buffer* args, uint64_t argsOffset, const unsigned threads[3],
                                      hakios_metal_buffer* const* buffers, const uint64_t* offsets, unsigned count,
                                      hakios_metal_texture* const* textures, unsigned textureCount,
                                      hakios_metal_sampler* const* samplers, unsigned samplerCount) {
    syncAll(cb);
    const uint32_t t[3] = {threads[0], threads[1], threads[2]};
    const int r = dispatchWith(cb, k, buffers, offsets, count, textures, textureCount, samplers, samplerCount,
                               [&](const Bindings& b) { return cb->cb->dispatchIndirect(k->kernel->kernel, *args->buffer, argsOffset, t, b); });
    if (r == 0) cb->cb->keep(args->buffer);   // the GPU reads the counts out of it as it runs
    return r;
}

void hakios_metal_cb_set_threadgroup_length(hakios_metal_cb* cb, unsigned length) {
    if (deferring(cb)) return cb->deferrer->post(&cb->pending, [cb, length] { cb->threadgroupLength = length; });
    cb->threadgroupLength = length;
}

int hakios_metal_cb_append(hakios_metal_cb* cb, hakios_metal_cb* other) {
    syncAll(cb);
    if (!cb->cb->append(*other->cb)) {
        failed(cb->cb->error().empty() ? cb->cb->lastSkipped() : cb->cb->error());
        return -1;
    }
    return 0;
}

void hakios_metal_cb_set_indirect(hakios_metal_cb* cb, hakios_metal_buffer* args, uint64_t offset) {
    if (deferring(cb)) {
        std::shared_ptr<Buffer> b = args != nullptr ? args->buffer : nullptr;
        return cb->deferrer->post(&cb->pending, [cb, b, offset] { cb->indirect = b; cb->indirectOffset = offset; });
    }
    cb->indirect = args != nullptr ? args->buffer : nullptr;
    cb->indirectOffset = offset;
}

int hakios_metal_cb_dispatch(hakios_metal_cb* cb, hakios_metal_kernel* k, const unsigned groups[3], const unsigned threads[3],
                             hakios_metal_buffer* const* buffers, const uint64_t* offsets, unsigned count) {
    return hakios_metal_cb_dispatch2(cb, k, groups, threads, buffers, offsets, count, nullptr, 0, nullptr, 0);
}

// --- the render path: a program of two stages, and one draw of it -------------------------------------------------------

static hakios_metal_program* programOf(std::shared_ptr<CompiledStage> vs, std::shared_ptr<CompiledStage> fs, unsigned colorPixelFormat) {
    std::string why;
    std::unique_ptr<CompiledProgram> p = linkProgram(std::move(vs), std::move(fs), PixelFormat(colorPixelFormat), &why);
    if (p == nullptr) {
        failed(why);
        return nullptr;
    }
    auto* r = new hakios_metal_program;
    r->program = std::move(p);
    r->color = colorPixelFormat;
    return r;
}

hakios_metal_program* hakios_metal_program_new_bitcode(const void* vsBitcode, size_t vsSize, const void* fsBitcode, size_t fsSize, unsigned colorPixelFormat) {
    return hakios_metal_program_new_bitcode_constants(vsBitcode, vsSize, nullptr, 0, fsBitcode, fsSize, nullptr, 0, colorPixelFormat);
}

hakios_metal_program* hakios_metal_program_new_bitcode_constants(const void* vsBitcode, size_t vsSize, const hakios_metal_constant* vsConstants, unsigned vsCount,
                                                                 const void* fsBitcode, size_t fsSize, const hakios_metal_constant* fsConstants, unsigned fsCount,
                                                                 unsigned colorPixelFormat) {
    std::string why;
    std::unique_ptr<CompiledStage> vs = compileStage(vsBitcode, vsSize, &why, constantsOf(vsConstants, vsCount));
    if (vs == nullptr) {
        failed(why);
        return nullptr;
    }
    // no fragment bitcode: a pipeline with no fragment function (a depth-only one), which runs null_fs -- a fragment
    // function of our own that writes nothing (tools/kernels/null_fs.ll), compiled as any other so that it links
    if (fsBitcode == nullptr || fsSize == 0) {
        fsBitcode = kernels::null_fs_bc;
        fsSize = sizeof kernels::null_fs_bc;
        fsConstants = nullptr;
        fsCount = 0;
    }
    // the FS's device buffers past the VS's in the one IBO table the two share
    std::unique_ptr<CompiledStage> fs = compileStage(fsBitcode, fsSize, &why, constantsOf(fsConstants, fsCount), vs->stage.k.numSsbos);
    if (fs == nullptr) {
        failed(why);
        return nullptr;
    }
    return programOf(std::move(vs), std::move(fs), colorPixelFormat);
}

hakios_metal_program* hakios_metal_program_specialize(hakios_metal_program* base, const void* fsBitcode, size_t fsSize, const hakios_metal_constant* fsConstants,
                                                     unsigned fsCount, unsigned binding, const void* bytes, size_t length) {
    if (base == nullptr || fsBitcode == nullptr || fsSize == 0 || bytes == nullptr) {
        failed("a specialisation needs the program, its fragment function's bitcode and the buffer's bytes");
        return nullptr;
    }
    std::string why;
    KnownBuffer known;
    known.binding = binding;
    known.bytes.assign(static_cast<const uint8_t*>(bytes), static_cast<const uint8_t*>(bytes) + length);
    const Program& was = base->program->program;
    std::unique_ptr<CompiledStage> fs = compileStage(fsBitcode, fsSize, &why, constantsOf(fsConstants, fsCount), was.fsIboBase, &known);
    if (fs == nullptr) {
        failed(why);
        return nullptr;
    }
    std::unique_ptr<CompiledProgram> p = linkProgram(base->program->vs, std::move(fs), PixelFormat(base->color), &why);
    if (p == nullptr) {
        failed(why);
        return nullptr;
    }
    // the pipeline's own state, which the base was given after it was linked
    p->program.vertexDescriptor = was.vertexDescriptor;
    p->program.blend = was.blend;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i + 1 < kMaxColorOutputs; i++) p->program.moreBlend[i] = was.moreBlend[i];
    p->program.samples = was.samples;
    auto* r = new hakios_metal_program;
    r->program = std::move(p);
    r->color = base->color;
    return r;
}

unsigned hakios_metal_program_stage_words(hakios_metal_program* p, unsigned stage) {
    if (p == nullptr || stage > 1) return 0;
    return (stage == 0 ? p->program->program.vs : p->program->program.fs).k.numWords;
}

// FUNCTION of LIBRARY as WANT (a vertex or a fragment function): its bitcode, or nullptr with the reason left
static bool functionBitcode(hakios_metal_library* l, const char* function, MetalFunction::Type want, const uint8_t** bytes, uint64_t* length) {
    const MetalFunction* f = l->lib.find(function != nullptr ? function : "");
    if (f == nullptr || !l->lib.bitcode(*f, bytes, length)) {
        failed(std::string("no function ") + (function ? function : "(null)") + " in the library's " + std::to_string(l->lib.functions().size()));
        return false;
    }
    if (f->type != want) {
        failed(std::string(function) + " is not a " + (want == MetalFunction::kVertex ? "vertex" : "fragment") + " function (TYPE " + std::to_string(f->type) + ")");
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

hakios_metal_program* hakios_metal_program_new(hakios_metal_library* vsLibrary, const char* vs, hakios_metal_library* fsLibrary, const char* fs,
                                               unsigned colorPixelFormat) {
    const uint8_t* vsBytes = nullptr;
    const uint8_t* fsBytes = nullptr;
    uint64_t vsLength = 0, fsLength = 0;
    if (!functionBitcode(vsLibrary, vs, MetalFunction::kVertex, &vsBytes, &vsLength) || !functionBitcode(fsLibrary, fs, MetalFunction::kFragment, &fsBytes, &fsLength)) {
        return nullptr;
    }
    return hakios_metal_program_new_bitcode(vsBytes, size_t(vsLength), fsBytes, size_t(fsLength), colorPixelFormat);
}

void hakios_metal_program_free(hakios_metal_program* p) { delete p; }
const char* hakios_metal_program_name(hakios_metal_program* p) { return p->program->name.c_str(); }

// STAGE 0 is the vertex stage, 1 the fragment stage; another number has no resources
static const CompiledStage* stageOf(hakios_metal_program* p, unsigned stage) {
    return stage == 0 ? p->program->vs.get() : stage == 1 ? p->program->fs.get() : nullptr;
}

unsigned hakios_metal_program_resource_count(hakios_metal_program* p, unsigned stage) {
    const CompiledStage* s = stageOf(p, stage);
    return s != nullptr ? unsigned(s->resources.size()) : 0;
}

int hakios_metal_program_resource(hakios_metal_program* p, unsigned stage, unsigned i, unsigned* kind, unsigned* index, unsigned* sizeBytes) {
    const CompiledStage* s = stageOf(p, stage);
    if (s == nullptr || i >= s->resources.size()) return -1;
    const Resource& r = s->resources[i];
    if (kind) *kind = unsigned(r.kind);
    if (index) *index = r.index;
    if (sizeBytes) *sizeBytes = r.sizeBytes;
    return 0;
}

int hakios_metal_program_set_vertex_attribute(hakios_metal_program* p, unsigned index, unsigned format, unsigned offset, unsigned bufferIndex) {
    if (index >= kMaxVertexAttributes) {
        failed("vertex attribute " + std::to_string(index) + ": MTLVertexDescriptor's attributes are 0 to 30");
        return -1;
    }
    p->program->program.vertexDescriptor.attributes[index] = VertexAttribute{VertexFormat(format), offset, bufferIndex};
    return 0;
}

int hakios_metal_program_set_vertex_layout(hakios_metal_program* p, unsigned bufferIndex, unsigned stride, unsigned stepFunction, unsigned stepRate) {
    if (bufferIndex >= kMaxVertexBuffers) {
        failed("vertex layout " + std::to_string(bufferIndex) + ": MTLVertexDescriptor's layouts are 0 to 30");
        return -1;
    }
    p->program->program.vertexDescriptor.layouts[bufferIndex] = VertexLayout{stride, VertexStep(stepFunction), stepRate};
    return 0;
}

void hakios_metal_program_set_blend(hakios_metal_program* p, int enabled, unsigned rgbOp, unsigned alphaOp, unsigned srcRgb, unsigned dstRgb,
                                    unsigned srcAlpha, unsigned dstAlpha, unsigned writeMask) {
    hakios_metal_program_set_blend_at(p, 0, enabled, rgbOp, alphaOp, srcRgb, dstRgb, srcAlpha, dstAlpha, writeMask);
}

int hakios_metal_program_set_samples(hakios_metal_program* p, unsigned samples) {
    if (samples != 1 && samples != 2 && samples != 4) {
        failed("rasterSampleCount " + std::to_string(samples) + ": 1, 2 or 4 are served");
        return -1;
    }
    p->program->program.samples = samples;
    return 0;
}

int hakios_metal_program_set_blend_at(hakios_metal_program* p, unsigned index, int enabled, unsigned rgbOp, unsigned alphaOp, unsigned srcRgb,
                                      unsigned dstRgb, unsigned srcAlpha, unsigned dstAlpha, unsigned writeMask) {
    if (index >= kMaxColorOutputs) {
        failed("blend of colour attachment " + std::to_string(index) + ": there are 8, 0 to 7");
        return -1;
    }
    const ColorBlend b{enabled != 0, rgbOp, alphaOp, srcRgb, dstRgb, srcAlpha, dstAlpha, writeMask};
    (index == 0 ? p->program->program.blend : p->program->program.moreBlend[index - 1]) = b;
    return 0;
}

// the C interface's pass as the core's: attachment 0, 1 to 7, the depth attachment and their actions
static RenderPass passOf(const struct hakios_metal_render_pass* pass) {
    RenderPass rp;
    if (pass == nullptr) return rp;
    rp.color0 = pass->color0 != nullptr ? pass->color0->texture.get() : nullptr;
    rp.level = pass->color0_level;
    rp.slice = pass->color0_slice;
    rp.load = LoadAction(pass->load_action);
    rp.store = StoreAction(pass->store_action);
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) rp.clearColor[i] = pass->clear_color[i];
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < kMaxColorOutputs - 1; i++) {
        const auto& m = pass->more[i];
        rp.more[i].texture = m.texture != nullptr ? m.texture->texture.get() : nullptr;
        rp.more[i].level = m.level;
        rp.more[i].slice = m.slice;
        rp.more[i].load = LoadAction(m.load_action);
        rp.more[i].store = StoreAction(m.store_action);
        for (int c = 0; c < 4; c++) rp.more[i].clearColor[c] = m.clear_color[c];
    }
    rp.depth = pass->depth != nullptr ? pass->depth->texture.get() : nullptr;
    rp.depthLevel = pass->depth_level;
    rp.depthSlice = pass->depth_slice;
    rp.depthLoad = LoadAction(pass->depth_load_action);
    rp.depthStore = StoreAction(pass->depth_store_action);
    rp.clearDepth = pass->clear_depth;
    rp.stencil = pass->stencil != nullptr ? pass->stencil->texture.get() : nullptr;
    rp.stencilLoad = LoadAction(pass->stencil_load_action);
    rp.stencilStore = StoreAction(pass->stencil_store_action);
    rp.clearStencil = pass->clear_stencil;
    return rp;
}

// the pass's texture objects, alive until the GPU is done with them, whatever the caller frees meanwhile
static void keepPassAlive(hakios_metal_cb* cb, const struct hakios_metal_render_pass* pass) {
    if (pass->color0 != nullptr) cb->cb->keepAlive(pass->color0->texture);
    for (const auto& m : pass->more) {
        if (m.texture != nullptr) cb->cb->keepAlive(m.texture->texture);
    }
    if (pass->depth != nullptr) cb->cb->keepAlive(pass->depth->texture);
    if (pass->visibility != nullptr) cb->cb->keep(pass->visibility->buffer);   // the result words the draws write
}

int hakios_metal_cb_draw(hakios_metal_cb* cb, hakios_metal_program* p, const struct hakios_metal_render_pass* pass,
                         const struct hakios_metal_viewport* viewport, const struct hakios_metal_scissor* scissor, unsigned primitive,
                         unsigned vertexStart, unsigned vertexCount, unsigned instanceCount, hakios_metal_buffer* const* vsBuffers,
                         const uint64_t* vsOffsets, unsigned vsCount, hakios_metal_buffer* const* fsBuffers, const uint64_t* fsOffsets, unsigned fsCount) {
    return hakios_metal_cb_draw2(cb, p, pass, viewport, scissor, primitive, vertexStart, vertexCount, instanceCount, vsBuffers, vsOffsets, vsCount, fsBuffers,
                                 fsOffsets, fsCount, nullptr, 0, nullptr, 0);
}

namespace {
// the draws of the C interface in one: INDEX_BUFFER non-NULL is an indexed draw
int drawCommon(hakios_metal_cb* cb, hakios_metal_program* p, const struct hakios_metal_render_pass* pass, const struct hakios_metal_viewport* viewport,
               const struct hakios_metal_scissor* scissor, unsigned primitive, unsigned vertexStart, unsigned vertexCount, unsigned instanceCount,
               hakios_metal_buffer* indexBuffer, unsigned indexType, uint64_t indexOffset, int baseVertex, unsigned baseInstance,
               hakios_metal_buffer* const* vsBuffers, const uint64_t* vsOffsets, unsigned vsCount, hakios_metal_buffer* const* fsBuffers,
               const uint64_t* fsOffsets, unsigned fsCount, hakios_metal_texture* const* fsTextures, unsigned fsTextureCount,
               hakios_metal_sampler* const* fsSamplers, unsigned fsSamplerCount) {
    // an indirect draw's words in place of the counts (hakios_metal_cb_set_indirect): taken first, so that this draw
    // alone has them whether it is drawn or refused
    std::shared_ptr<Buffer> indirect = std::move(cb->indirect);
    cb->indirect = nullptr;
    // the two [[buffer(n)]] tables by Metal's index (setVertexBuffer / setFragmentBuffer); render::encode reads what each
    // stage's pushed ranges name and refuses a range with nothing bound by name
    auto table = [](hakios_metal_buffer* const* buffers, const uint64_t* offsets, unsigned count) {
        Bindings b;
        b.buffers.resize(count);
        for (unsigned i = 0; i < count; i++) {
            if (buffers != nullptr && buffers[i] != nullptr) b.buffers[i] = Binding{buffers[i]->buffer.get(), offsets != nullptr ? offsets[i] : 0};
        }
        return b;
    };
    Bindings vsb = table(vsBuffers, vsOffsets, vsCount);
    // the vertex stage's textures and samplers, as hakios_metal_cb_set_vertex_textures left them, and its own constexpr
    // samplers past them, as the fragment stage's below
    for (const auto& t : cb->vsTextures) vsb.textures.push_back(t.get());
    for (const auto& m : cb->vsSamplers) vsb.samplers.push_back(m ? &*m : nullptr);
    for (const auto& [index, sampler] : p->program->vs->inlineSamplers) {
        if (vsb.samplers.size() <= index) vsb.samplers.resize(index + 1, nullptr);
        vsb.samplers[index] = &sampler;
    }
    Bindings fsb = table(fsBuffers, fsOffsets, fsCount);
    // the fragment stage's [[texture(n)]] and [[sampler(n)]] by Metal's index (setFragmentTexture / setFragmentSamplerState)
    fsb.textures.resize(fsTextureCount, nullptr);
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < fsTextureCount; i++) {
        if (fsTextures != nullptr && fsTextures[i] != nullptr) fsb.textures[i] = fsTextures[i]->texture.get();
    }
    fsb.samplers.resize(fsSamplerCount, nullptr);
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < fsSamplerCount; i++) {
        if (fsSamplers != nullptr && fsSamplers[i] != nullptr) fsb.samplers[i] = &fsSamplers[i]->sampler;
    }
    // the fragment function's own constexpr samplers at the indices the front end gave them (past the API's)
    for (const auto& [index, sampler] : p->program->fs->inlineSamplers) {
        if (fsb.samplers.size() <= index) fsb.samplers.resize(index + 1, nullptr);
        fsb.samplers[index] = &sampler;
    }
    // both stages' argument-buffer members, from what the sets hold, at the indices the front end gave them
    std::vector<std::shared_ptr<const void>> members;
    std::string whyMembers;
    if (!bindArgumentBuffers(p->program->vs->resources, &vsb, &members, &whyMembers) ||
        !bindArgumentBuffers(p->program->fs->resources, &fsb, &members, &whyMembers)) {
        failed(whyMembers);
        cb->cb->refuse(whyMembers);
        return -1;
    }
    for (auto& m : members) cb->cb->keepAlive(std::move(m));
    const RenderPass rp = passOf(pass);
    // what MTLRenderCommandEncoder's default viewport covers: the first attachment the pass has, colour before depth
    // (a depth-only pass's is the depth texture)
    const Texture* target = rp.color0;
    uint32_t targetLevel = rp.level;
    for (unsigned i = 0; target == nullptr && i < kMaxColorOutputs - 1; i++) {
        target = rp.more[i].texture;
        targetLevel = rp.more[i].level;
    }
    if (target == nullptr) {
        target = rp.depth;
        targetLevel = rp.depthLevel;
    }
    Draw d;
    d.primitive = Primitive(primitive);
    d.vertexStart = vertexStart;
    d.vertexCount = vertexCount;
    d.instanceCount = instanceCount;
    d.indexBuffer = indexBuffer != nullptr ? indexBuffer->buffer.get() : nullptr;
    d.indexType = indexType;
    d.indexOffset = indexOffset;
    d.baseVertex = baseVertex;
    d.baseInstance = baseInstance;
    d.indirect = indirect.get();
    d.indirectOffset = cb->indirectOffset;
    // MTLRenderCommandEncoder's defaults: a viewport over the whole attachment with depth 0..1, no scissor (the whole attachment)
    if (viewport != nullptr) {
        d.viewport = Viewport{viewport->x, viewport->y, viewport->width, viewport->height, viewport->znear, viewport->zfar};
    } else {
        // (the level drawn into: a pass into mip level 1 of a 512 x 512 texture covers 256 x 256)
        d.viewport = Viewport{0, 0, target != nullptr ? double(target->level(targetLevel).width) : 1.0,
                              target != nullptr ? double(target->level(targetLevel).height) : 1.0, 0, 1};
    }
    if (scissor != nullptr) {
        d.scissor = Scissor{scissor->x, scissor->y, scissor->width, scissor->height};
    }
    if (pass != nullptr) {
        for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) d.blendColor[i] = pass->blend_color[i];
        if (pass->depth_state_set) d.depth = DepthState{pass->depth_compare, pass->depth_write != 0};
        d.cullMode = pass->cull_mode;
        d.winding = pass->winding;
        if (pass->stencil_state_set) {
            auto face = [](const hakios_metal_render_pass::hakios_metal_stencil_face& f) {
                return StencilFace{f.compare, f.stencil_fail, f.depth_fail, f.pass, f.read_mask, f.write_mask};
            };
            d.stencil.enabled = true;
            d.stencil.front = face(pass->stencil_front);
            d.stencil.back = face(pass->stencil_back);
            d.stencil.frontReference = pass->stencil_front_reference;
            d.stencil.backReference = pass->stencil_back_reference;
        }
        if (pass->visibility_mode != 0) {
            d.visibility = pass->visibility != nullptr ? pass->visibility->buffer.get() : nullptr;
            d.visibilityMode = pass->visibility_mode;
            d.visibilityOffset = pass->visibility_offset;
            d.visibilityReset = pass->visibility_reset != 0;
        }
    }
    if (!cb->cb->draw(p->program->program, rp, d, vsb, fsb)) {
        failed(cb->cb->error().empty() ? cb->cb->lastSkipped() : cb->cb->error());
        return -1;
    }
    // the bound buffers live until the GPU has read them, whatever the caller frees meanwhile
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < vsCount; i++) if (vsBuffers != nullptr && vsBuffers[i] != nullptr) cb->cb->keep(vsBuffers[i]->buffer);
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < fsCount; i++) if (fsBuffers != nullptr && fsBuffers[i] != nullptr) cb->cb->keep(fsBuffers[i]->buffer);
    // the target's memory and object, and the program's words, live until the GPU is done, whatever the caller frees meanwhile
    if (target != nullptr) cb->cb->keep(target->buffer());
    keepPassAlive(cb, pass);
    cb->cb->keepAlive(p->program);
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < fsTextureCount; i++) {
        if (fsTextures != nullptr && fsTextures[i] != nullptr) cb->cb->keepAlive(fsTextures[i]->texture);   // the draw keeps the memory already
    }
    for (const auto& t : cb->vsTextures) {
        if (t != nullptr) cb->cb->keepAlive(t);
    }
    if (indirect != nullptr) cb->cb->keep(indirect);   // the CP reads the draw's words out of it as it runs
    return 0;
}
}  // namespace

void hakios_metal_cb_set_vertex_textures(hakios_metal_cb* cb, hakios_metal_texture* const* textures, unsigned textureCount,
                                         hakios_metal_sampler* const* samplers, unsigned samplerCount) {
    if (deferring(cb)) {
        auto t = std::make_shared<Handles<hakios_metal_texture>>();
        auto m = std::make_shared<Handles<hakios_metal_sampler>>();
        t->take(textures, textureCount);
        m->take(samplers, samplerCount);
        return cb->deferrer->post(&cb->pending, [cb, t, m, textureCount, samplerCount] {
            hakios_metal_cb_set_vertex_textures(cb, t->get(), textureCount, m->get(), samplerCount);
        });
    }
    cb->vsTextures.assign(textureCount, nullptr);
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < textureCount; i++) {
        if (textures != nullptr && textures[i] != nullptr) cb->vsTextures[i] = textures[i]->texture;
    }
    cb->vsSamplers.assign(samplerCount, std::nullopt);
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < samplerCount; i++) {
        if (samplers != nullptr && samplers[i] != nullptr) cb->vsSamplers[i] = samplers[i]->sampler;
    }
}

namespace {
// a draw's arguments as the C interface takes them, copied (deferred recording)
struct DrawCopy {
    hakios_metal_program program;
    PassCopy pass;
    std::optional<hakios_metal_viewport> viewport;
    std::optional<hakios_metal_scissor> scissor;
    Handles<hakios_metal_buffer> vs, fs;
    std::vector<uint64_t> vsOffsets, fsOffsets;
    const uint64_t *vsOffsetsGiven = nullptr, *fsOffsetsGiven = nullptr;
    Handles<hakios_metal_texture> fsTextures;
    Handles<hakios_metal_sampler> fsSamplers;
    hakios_metal_buffer index;
    void take(hakios_metal_program* p, const struct hakios_metal_render_pass* rp, const struct hakios_metal_viewport* v,
              const struct hakios_metal_scissor* sc, hakios_metal_buffer* const* vsb, const uint64_t* vso, unsigned vsn,
              hakios_metal_buffer* const* fsb, const uint64_t* fso, unsigned fsn, hakios_metal_texture* const* fst, unsigned fstn,
              hakios_metal_sampler* const* fss, unsigned fssn) {
        program = *p;
        pass.take(rp);
        if (v != nullptr) viewport = *v;
        if (sc != nullptr) scissor = *sc;
        vs.take(vsb, vsn);
        fs.take(fsb, fsn);
        vsOffsets = copyOf(vso, vsn);
        fsOffsets = copyOf(fso, fsn);
        vsOffsetsGiven = vso;
        fsOffsetsGiven = fso;
        fsTextures.take(fst, fstn);
        fsSamplers.take(fss, fssn);
    }
    const hakios_metal_viewport* vp() const { return viewport ? &*viewport : nullptr; }
    const hakios_metal_scissor* sc() const { return scissor ? &*scissor : nullptr; }
    const uint64_t* vso() const { return ptrOf(vsOffsets, vsOffsetsGiven); }
    const uint64_t* fso() const { return ptrOf(fsOffsets, fsOffsetsGiven); }
};
}  // namespace

int hakios_metal_cb_draw2(hakios_metal_cb* cb, hakios_metal_program* p, const struct hakios_metal_render_pass* pass,
                          const struct hakios_metal_viewport* viewport, const struct hakios_metal_scissor* scissor, unsigned primitive,
                          unsigned vertexStart, unsigned vertexCount, unsigned instanceCount, hakios_metal_buffer* const* vsBuffers,
                          const uint64_t* vsOffsets, unsigned vsCount, hakios_metal_buffer* const* fsBuffers, const uint64_t* fsOffsets, unsigned fsCount,
                          hakios_metal_texture* const* fsTextures, unsigned fsTextureCount, hakios_metal_sampler* const* fsSamplers,
                          unsigned fsSamplerCount) {
    if (deferring(cb)) {
        auto c = std::make_shared<DrawCopy>();
        c->take(p, pass, viewport, scissor, vsBuffers, vsOffsets, vsCount, fsBuffers, fsOffsets, fsCount, fsTextures, fsTextureCount, fsSamplers, fsSamplerCount);
        cb->deferrer->post(&cb->pending, [=] {
            refusedThere(cb, hakios_metal_cb_draw2(cb, &c->program, c->pass.get(), c->vp(), c->sc(), primitive, vertexStart, vertexCount, instanceCount,
                                                   c->vs.get(), c->vso(), vsCount, c->fs.get(), c->fso(), fsCount, c->fsTextures.get(), fsTextureCount,
                                                   c->fsSamplers.get(), fsSamplerCount));
        });
        return 0;
    }
    return drawCommon(cb, p, pass, viewport, scissor, primitive, vertexStart, vertexCount, instanceCount, nullptr, 0, 0, 0, 0, vsBuffers, vsOffsets, vsCount,
                      fsBuffers, fsOffsets, fsCount, fsTextures, fsTextureCount, fsSamplers, fsSamplerCount);
}

int hakios_metal_cb_draw3(hakios_metal_cb* cb, hakios_metal_program* p, const struct hakios_metal_render_pass* pass,
                          const struct hakios_metal_viewport* viewport, const struct hakios_metal_scissor* scissor, unsigned primitive,
                          unsigned vertexStart, unsigned vertexCount, unsigned instanceCount, unsigned baseInstance, hakios_metal_buffer* const* vsBuffers,
                          const uint64_t* vsOffsets, unsigned vsCount, hakios_metal_buffer* const* fsBuffers, const uint64_t* fsOffsets, unsigned fsCount,
                          hakios_metal_texture* const* fsTextures, unsigned fsTextureCount, hakios_metal_sampler* const* fsSamplers,
                          unsigned fsSamplerCount) {
    if (deferring(cb)) {
        auto c = std::make_shared<DrawCopy>();
        c->take(p, pass, viewport, scissor, vsBuffers, vsOffsets, vsCount, fsBuffers, fsOffsets, fsCount, fsTextures, fsTextureCount, fsSamplers, fsSamplerCount);
        cb->deferrer->post(&cb->pending, [=] {
            refusedThere(cb, hakios_metal_cb_draw3(cb, &c->program, c->pass.get(), c->vp(), c->sc(), primitive, vertexStart, vertexCount, instanceCount,
                                                   baseInstance, c->vs.get(), c->vso(), vsCount, c->fs.get(), c->fso(), fsCount, c->fsTextures.get(),
                                                   fsTextureCount, c->fsSamplers.get(), fsSamplerCount));
        });
        return 0;
    }
    return drawCommon(cb, p, pass, viewport, scissor, primitive, vertexStart, vertexCount, instanceCount, nullptr, 0, 0, 0, baseInstance, vsBuffers, vsOffsets,
                      vsCount, fsBuffers, fsOffsets, fsCount, fsTextures, fsTextureCount, fsSamplers, fsSamplerCount);
}

int hakios_metal_cb_draw_indexed(hakios_metal_cb* cb, hakios_metal_program* p, const struct hakios_metal_render_pass* pass,
                                 const struct hakios_metal_viewport* viewport, const struct hakios_metal_scissor* scissor, unsigned primitive,
                                 unsigned indexCount, unsigned indexType, hakios_metal_buffer* indexBuffer, uint64_t indexOffset, unsigned instanceCount,
                                 int baseVertex, unsigned baseInstance, hakios_metal_buffer* const* vsBuffers, const uint64_t* vsOffsets, unsigned vsCount,
                                 hakios_metal_buffer* const* fsBuffers, const uint64_t* fsOffsets, unsigned fsCount, hakios_metal_texture* const* fsTextures,
                                 unsigned fsTextureCount, hakios_metal_sampler* const* fsSamplers, unsigned fsSamplerCount) {
    if (deferring(cb) && indexBuffer != nullptr) {
        auto c = std::make_shared<DrawCopy>();
        c->take(p, pass, viewport, scissor, vsBuffers, vsOffsets, vsCount, fsBuffers, fsOffsets, fsCount, fsTextures, fsTextureCount, fsSamplers, fsSamplerCount);
        c->index = *indexBuffer;
        cb->deferrer->post(&cb->pending, [=] {
            refusedThere(cb, hakios_metal_cb_draw_indexed(cb, &c->program, c->pass.get(), c->vp(), c->sc(), primitive, indexCount, indexType, &c->index,
                                                          indexOffset, instanceCount, baseVertex, baseInstance, c->vs.get(), c->vso(), vsCount,
                                                          c->fs.get(), c->fso(), fsCount, c->fsTextures.get(), fsTextureCount, c->fsSamplers.get(),
                                                          fsSamplerCount));
        });
        return 0;
    }
    if (indexBuffer == nullptr) {
        failed("an indexed draw with no index buffer");
        cb->cb->refuse("an indexed draw with no index buffer");
        return -1;
    }
    int r = drawCommon(cb, p, pass, viewport, scissor, primitive, 0, indexCount, instanceCount, indexBuffer, indexType, indexOffset, baseVertex, baseInstance,
                       vsBuffers, vsOffsets, vsCount, fsBuffers, fsOffsets, fsCount, fsTextures, fsTextureCount, fsSamplers, fsSamplerCount);
    if (r == 0) cb->cb->keep(indexBuffer->buffer);   // the indices live until the GPU has read them, whatever the caller frees
    return r;
}

int hakios_metal_cb_clear(hakios_metal_cb* cb, const struct hakios_metal_render_pass* pass) {
    if (deferring(cb) && pass != nullptr) {
        auto c = std::make_shared<PassCopy>();
        c->take(pass);
        cb->deferrer->post(&cb->pending, [cb, c] { refusedThere(cb, hakios_metal_cb_clear(cb, c->get())); });
        return 0;
    }
    if (!cb->cb->clear(passOf(pass))) {
        failed(cb->cb->error().empty() ? cb->cb->lastSkipped() : cb->cb->error());
        return -1;
    }
    keepPassAlive(cb, pass);
    return 0;
}

void hakios_metal_cb_fail(hakios_metal_cb* cb, const char* why) {
    if (deferring(cb)) {
        std::string w = why != nullptr ? why : "refused";
        return cb->deferrer->post(&cb->pending, [cb, w] { cb->cb->refuse(w); });
    }
    cb->cb->refuse(why != nullptr ? why : "refused");
}

void hakios_metal_cb_commit(hakios_metal_cb* cb, void (*callback)(hakios_metal_cb*, void*), void* context) {
    if (deferring(cb)) return cb->deferrer->post(&cb->pending, [cb, callback, context] { hakios_metal_cb_commit(cb, callback, context); });
    if (callback != nullptr) {
        cb->cb->addCompletedHandler([cb, callback, context](CommandBuffer&) { callback(cb, context); });
    }
    cb->cb->commit();
}

void hakios_metal_cb_wait(hakios_metal_cb* cb) {
    syncOne(cb);
    cb->cb->waitUntilCompleted();
}

enum hakios_metal_status hakios_metal_cb_status(hakios_metal_cb* cb) {
    syncOne(cb);
    return static_cast<enum hakios_metal_status>(cb->cb->status());
}

const char* hakios_metal_cb_error(hakios_metal_cb* cb) {
    syncOne(cb);
    return cb->cb->error().c_str();
}
int64_t hakios_metal_cb_gpu_nanoseconds(hakios_metal_cb* cb) {
    syncOne(cb);
    return cb->cb->gpuNanoseconds();
}

}  // extern "C"

```

`hakios-metal/src/command.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "hakios-metal/command.hpp"
#include "hakios-metal/texture.hpp"

#include <algorithm>
#include <atomic>
#include <cerrno>
#include <map>
#include <mutex>
#include <cstring>

namespace hakios::metal {

namespace {
constexpr size_t kCommandBo = 64 * 1024;           // one command buffer's packets, at most (grown when needed)
constexpr int64_t kPatienceNs = 5000000000;        // a fence not passed in 5 s: the GPU is hung, the buffer is an error
constexpr uint32_t kFillHead = 64;                 // words written by CP_MEM_WRITE before the copies double them
// The most one CP_MEMCPY moves. On the phone (27 October) 125 000 words in one packet took 4.2 ms, and 4 Mi words (16 MB)
// in one packet hung the GPU ("no answer" from the kernel's driver, and the system after it). Cut into packets of this
// size, each waited for before the next, the same copy is a row of small ones.
constexpr uint32_t kMemcpyMax = 64 * 1024;
}  // namespace

void appendStream(pm4::Stream& to, const pm4::Stream& from);   // render.cpp's: a pass of its own onto the buffer's stream

namespace {
std::mutex gAddressLock;
std::map<uint64_t, std::weak_ptr<Buffer>> gByAddress;   // by gpuAddress, every Buffer newBuffer made and still alive

std::shared_ptr<Buffer> addressed(Buffer* raw) {
    const uint64_t at = raw->gpuAddress();
    std::shared_ptr<Buffer> b(raw, [at](Buffer* x) {
        {
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> g(gAddressLock);
            auto it = gByAddress.find(at);
            if (it != gByAddress.end() && it->second.expired()) gByAddress.erase(it);
        }
        delete x;
    });
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> g(gAddressLock);
    gByAddress[at] = b;
    return b;
}
}  // namespace

std::shared_ptr<Buffer> bufferAt(uint64_t address, uint64_t* offset) {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> g(gAddressLock);
    auto it = gByAddress.upper_bound(address);
    if (it == gByAddress.begin()) return nullptr;
    --it;
    std::shared_ptr<Buffer> b = it->second.lock();
    if (b == nullptr || address - it->first >= b->length()) return nullptr;
    *offset = address - it->first;
    return b;
}

std::atomic<uint32_t> gBuffersMade{0}, gBuffersReused{0};
std::atomic<uint64_t> gBytesMade{0};

std::shared_ptr<Buffer> newBuffer(Gpu& gpu, uint64_t length, std::string* why) {
    gBuffersMade++;
    gBytesMade += length;
    int error = 0;
    std::unique_ptr<Bo> bo = gpu.newBo(length, kBoWriteCombined, &error);
    if (bo == nullptr) {
        *why = "the driver gave no buffer of " + std::to_string(length) + " bytes: " + strerror(error);
        return nullptr;
    }
    return addressed(new Buffer(std::move(bo), length));
}

namespace {
// One slab is 32 draw tables. Pieces are cut at 256 bytes, which is more than anything in them wants (128 for a
// program's preload and the border colour, 64 for a texture descriptor), and a piece of a page or more starts on a
// page, so that a table lies in memory as it did in a buffer of its own.
constexpr uint64_t kSlabBytes = 256 * 1024;
constexpr uint64_t kPieceAlign = 256;
constexpr uint64_t kPageAlign = 4096;
}  // namespace

bool CommandBuffer::piece(uint64_t bytes, Piece* out, std::string* why) {
    bytes = (std::max<uint64_t>(bytes, 1) + kPieceAlign - 1) & ~(kPieceAlign - 1);
    const uint64_t align = bytes >= kPageAlign ? kPageAlign : kPieceAlign;
    if (slab_ != nullptr) {
        slabUsed_ = std::min(kSlabBytes, (slabUsed_ + align - 1) & ~(align - 1));
    }
    if (bytes > kSlabBytes / 4) {
        // (a piece this large in a slab would leave most of the slab unused when the next one did not fit)
        out->buffer = queue_.takeBuffer(bytes, why);
        out->offset = 0;
        if (out->buffer != nullptr) slabs_.push_back(out->buffer);
    } else {
        if (slab_ == nullptr || kSlabBytes - slabUsed_ < bytes) {
            slab_ = queue_.takeSlab(kSlabBytes, why);
            slabUsed_ = 0;
            if (slab_ != nullptr) slabs_.push_back(slab_);
        }
        out->buffer = slab_;
        out->offset = slabUsed_;
        if (slab_ != nullptr) {
            slabUsed_ += bytes;
        }
    }
    if (out->buffer == nullptr) {
        return false;
    }
    if (out->offset == 0) {
        use(*out->buffer, true);
        keep(out->buffer);
    }
    return true;
}

uint64_t CommandBuffer::programAddress(const Kernel& k, std::string* why) {
    const uint32_t n = std::max<uint32_t>(k.numWords, 1);
    auto same = [&](const Uploaded& u) {
        if (u.words.size() != k.numWords) return false;
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < k.numWords; i += 64) {
            if (u.words[i] != k.words[i]) return false;
        }
        return k.numWords == 0 || u.words.back() == k.words[k.numWords - 1];
    };
    const auto [first, last] = uploaded_.equal_range(k.words);
    for (auto it = first; it != last; ++it) {
        if (same(it->second)) return it->second.gpuAddress;
    }
    (void)n;
    std::shared_ptr<Buffer> b = queue_.programBuffer(k, why);
    if (b == nullptr) return 0;
    use(*b, false);
    keep(b);
    uploaded_.emplace(k.words, Uploaded{std::vector<uint32_t>(k.words, k.words + k.numWords), b->gpuAddress()});
    return b->gpuAddress();
}

namespace {
uint64_t sizeClass(uint64_t bytes) {
    uint64_t c = 4096;
    while (c < bytes) c <<= 1;
    return c;
}
}  // namespace

std::shared_ptr<Buffer> CommandQueue::takeBuffer(uint64_t bytes, std::string* why) {
    const uint64_t size = sizeClass(bytes);
    std::shared_ptr<Buffer> b;
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> g(poolLock_);
        auto it = freeBuffers_.find(size);
        if (it != freeBuffers_.end() && !it->second.empty()) {
            b = std::move(it->second.back());
            it->second.pop_back();
            freeBytes_ -= size;
        }
    }
    if (b == nullptr) return newBuffer(gpu_, size, why);
    gBuffersReused++;
    memset(b->contents(), 0, size);   // (as a new one comes from the kernel)
    return b;
}

void CommandQueue::giveBuffer(std::shared_ptr<Buffer> b) {
    // (only one no one else holds, of a size takeBuffer makes: a piece's buffer kept elsewhere is still someone's)
    if (b == nullptr || b.use_count() != 1 || b->contents() == nullptr || b->length() != sizeClass(b->length())) return;
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> g(poolLock_);
    if (freeBytes_ + b->length() > (32ull << 20)) return;
    freeBytes_ += b->length();
    freeBuffers_[b->length()].push_back(std::move(b));
}

std::shared_ptr<Buffer> CommandQueue::takeSlab(uint64_t bytes, std::string* why) { return takeBuffer(bytes, why); }

void CommandQueue::giveSlabs(std::vector<std::shared_ptr<Buffer>>* slabs) {
    for (auto& b : *slabs) giveBuffer(std::move(b));
    slabs->clear();
}

std::shared_ptr<Buffer> CommandQueue::programBuffer(const Kernel& k, std::string* why) {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> g(lock_);
    const auto [first, last] = resident_.equal_range(k.words);
    for (auto it = first; it != last;) {
        const Resident& r = it->second;
        if (r.words.size() == k.numWords && std::memcmp(r.words.data(), k.words, 4ull * k.numWords) == 0) return r.buffer;
        residentBytes_ -= 4ull * r.words.size();
        it = resident_.erase(it);   // (the pointer's words have changed: a freed program's)
    }
    // (past 64 MB of programs, the ones kept are let go: a command buffer in flight keeps its own)
    if (residentBytes_ > (64ull << 20)) {
        resident_.clear();
        residentBytes_ = 0;
    }
    std::shared_ptr<Buffer> b = newBuffer(gpu_, 4ull * std::max<uint32_t>(k.numWords, 1), why);
    if (b == nullptr || b->contents() == nullptr) return nullptr;
    memcpy(b->contents(), k.words, 4ull * k.numWords);
    resident_.emplace(k.words, Resident{std::vector<uint32_t>(k.words, k.words + k.numWords), b});
    residentBytes_ += 4ull * k.numWords;
    return b;
}

namespace {
// the live surface buffers, by (GPU, kernel handle): the kernel gives this client one handle per surface, so two
// Buffers over it would close it twice. The deleter takes the lock too, so that a handle the kernel hands out again
// cannot be met by a Buffer still being destroyed.
std::mutex gSurfaceLock;
std::map<std::pair<const Gpu*, uint32_t>, std::weak_ptr<Buffer>> gSurfaceBuffers;
}  // namespace

std::shared_ptr<Buffer> surfaceBuffer(Gpu& gpu, uint32_t surfaceId, SurfaceInfo* info, std::string* why) {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> g(gSurfaceLock);
    int error = 0;
    std::unique_ptr<Bo> bo = gpu.surfaceBo(surfaceId, info, &error);
    if (bo == nullptr) {
        *why = "IOSurface " + std::to_string(surfaceId) + ": the driver gave no buffer for it: " +
               (error == ENOENT ? std::string("no such surface") : error == ENOTSUP ? std::string("a surface around a program's own memory is not one the GPU takes") : strerror(error));
        return nullptr;
    }
    const auto key = std::make_pair(static_cast<const Gpu*>(&gpu), bo->handle());
    auto live = gSurfaceBuffers.find(key);
    if (live != gSurfaceBuffers.end()) {
        if (std::shared_ptr<Buffer> b = live->second.lock()) {
            gpu.disown(std::move(bo));   // the same handle as the live Buffer's Bo: closed once, by that Bo
            return b;
        }
    }
    const uint64_t length = bo->size();
    std::shared_ptr<Buffer> b(new Buffer(std::move(bo), length), [key](Buffer* x) {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> g(gSurfaceLock);
        auto it = gSurfaceBuffers.find(key);
        if (it != gSurfaceBuffers.end() && it->second.expired()) gSurfaceBuffers.erase(it);
        delete x;
    });
    gSurfaceBuffers[key] = b;
    return b;
}

// --- CommandBuffer ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

bool CommandBuffer::fail(const std::string& why) {
    if (error_.empty()) {
        error_ = why;
    }
    return false;
}

void CommandBuffer::stamp(uint32_t slot) {
    if (profileStamps_ == nullptr) {
        std::string why;
        profileStamps_ = queue_.takeBuffer(16 * kMaxProfiled, &why);
        if (profileStamps_ == nullptr) {
            profile_ = tuning_ = false;
            return;
        }
        memset(profileStamps_->contents(), 0, 16 * kMaxProfiled);
        keep(profileStamps_);
    }
    const uint64_t at = profileStamps_->gpuAddress() + 8ull * slot;
    const uint32_t w[3] = {a6xx::CP_REG_TO_MEM_0_REG(0x0980) | a6xx::CP_REG_TO_MEM_0_CNT(2) | a6xx::CP_REG_TO_MEM_0_64B, uint32_t(at),
                           uint32_t(at >> 32)};
    stream_.packet(a6xx::CP_REG_TO_MEM, w, 3);
    use(*profileStamps_, true);
}

std::shared_ptr<Buffer> CommandQueue::vscBuffer(std::string* why) {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> g(lock_);
    if (vsc_ == nullptr) vsc_ = newBuffer(gpu_, render::vscBytes(), why);
    return vsc_;
}

void CommandQueue::checkVsc() {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> g(lock_);
    if (vsc_ == nullptr || vsc_->contents() == nullptr) return;
    const uint32_t word = *reinterpret_cast<const volatile uint32_t*>(static_cast<const uint8_t*>(vsc_->contents()) + 32ull * render::kVscDrawPitch + render::kVscOverflowAt);
    if (word != 0) vscOverflowed_ = true;
}

bool CommandQueue::preferGmem(uint64_t key) {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> g(lock_);
    Tune& t = tune_[key];
    t.passes++;
    // (sysmem first: a kind of pass seen once may not come again, and an untried GMEM pass is the dearer gamble -- 5 ms
    // against 0.13 for a light one)
    if (t.runs[0] == 0) return false;
    if (t.runs[1] == 0) return true;
    const bool better = t.us[1] < t.us[0];
    // (the other mode again now and then, what a pass costs drifting: every 16th pass, or every 64th when the one is
    // dearer by half -- a light pass of CoreAnimation took 5 ms in GMEM against 0.13 in sysmem)
    const double ratio = better ? t.us[0] / t.us[1] : t.us[1] / t.us[0];
    return t.passes % (ratio > 1.5 ? 64 : 16) == 0 ? !better : better;
}

namespace {
uint64_t kindKey(uint64_t kind, uint32_t ordinal) { return kind * 0x100000001b3ull ^ ordinal; }
}  // namespace

uint32_t CommandQueue::lastDraws(uint64_t kind, uint32_t ordinal) {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> g(lock_);
    auto it = lastDraws_.find(kindKey(kind, ordinal));
    return it == lastDraws_.end() ? 0 : it->second;
}

void CommandQueue::noteDraws(uint64_t kind, uint32_t ordinal, uint32_t draws) {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> g(lock_);
    lastDraws_[kindKey(kind, ordinal)] = draws;
    Peak& p = peakDraws_[kindKey(kind, ordinal)];
    if (draws >= p.draws || ++p.below >= 16) p.draws = draws, p.below = 0;
}

uint32_t CommandQueue::peakDraws(uint64_t kind, uint32_t ordinal) {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> g(lock_);
    auto it = peakDraws_.find(kindKey(kind, ordinal));
    return it == peakDraws_.end() ? 0 : it->second.draws;
}

void CommandQueue::tuned(uint64_t key, bool gmem, double us) {
    if (!(us > 0)) return;
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> g(lock_);
    Tune& t = tune_[key];
    double& avg = t.us[gmem ? 1 : 0];
    avg = t.runs[gmem ? 1 : 0]++ == 0 ? us : 0.75 * avg + 0.25 * us;
}

void CommandBuffer::stampStart(PassKind kind, uint32_t width, uint32_t height) {
    if (!(profile_ || tuning_) || profiled_.size() >= kMaxProfiled) return;
    { PassTime t{}; t.kind = kind, t.width = width, t.height = height; profiled_.push_back(std::move(t)); }
    stamp(uint32_t(2 * (profiled_.size() - 1)));
}

void CommandBuffer::stampEnd() {
    if (!(profile_ || tuning_) || profiled_.empty()) return;
    stamp(uint32_t(2 * (profiled_.size() - 1) + 1));
}

void CommandBuffer::drawStamp(uint32_t slot) {
    if (drawStamps_ == nullptr) {
        std::string why;
        drawStamps_ = queue_.takeBuffer(16 * kMaxProfiledDraws, &why);
        if (drawStamps_ == nullptr) {
            profileDraws_ = false;
            return;
        }
        memset(drawStamps_->contents(), 0, 16 * kMaxProfiledDraws);
        keep(drawStamps_);
    }
    const uint64_t at = drawStamps_->gpuAddress() + 8ull * slot;
    stream_.waitForIdle();
    const uint32_t w[3] = {a6xx::CP_REG_TO_MEM_0_REG(0x0980) | a6xx::CP_REG_TO_MEM_0_CNT(2) | a6xx::CP_REG_TO_MEM_0_64B, uint32_t(at),
                           uint32_t(at >> 32)};
    stream_.packet(a6xx::CP_REG_TO_MEM, w, 3);
    use(*drawStamps_, true);
}

std::vector<CommandBuffer::DrawTime> CommandBuffer::drawTimes() const {
    std::vector<DrawTime> out = drawsProfiled_;
    if (drawStamps_ == nullptr) return {};
    const auto* t = static_cast<const uint64_t*>(drawStamps_->contents());
    for (size_t i = 0; i < out.size(); i++) {
        out[i].us = t[2 * i + 1] > t[2 * i] ? double(t[2 * i + 1] - t[2 * i]) / 19.2 : 0.0;
    }
    return out;
}

std::vector<CommandBuffer::PassTime> CommandBuffer::passTimes() const {
    std::vector<PassTime> out = profiled_;
    if (profileStamps_ == nullptr) return {};
    const auto* t = static_cast<const uint64_t*>(profileStamps_->contents());
    for (size_t i = 0; i < out.size(); i++) {
        out[i].us = t[2 * i + 1] > t[2 * i] ? double(t[2 * i + 1] - t[2 * i]) / 19.2 : 0.0;
    }
    return out;
}

bool CommandBuffer::refuseWork(const std::string& why) {
    if (!skipRefused_) {
        return fail(why);
    }
    skipped_++;
    lastSkipped_ = why;
    return false;
}

void CommandBuffer::addCompletedHandler(std::function<void(CommandBuffer&)> handler) {
    if (status_ <= kEnqueued) {
        handlers_.push_back(std::move(handler));
    }
}

void CommandBuffer::enqueue() {
    Status expected = kNotEnqueued;
    status_.compare_exchange_strong(expected, kEnqueued);
}

void CommandBuffer::commit() {
    if (status_ > kEnqueued) {
        return;  // Metal asserts here; committing twice does nothing at all in this driver
    }
    queue_.submit(shared_from_this());
}

void CommandBuffer::waitUntilCompleted() {
    std::unique_lock<std::mutex> g(lock_);
    // (a buffer never committed is not waited for: Metal would wait forever, which helps nobody)
    done_.wait(g, [this] { return finished_ || status_ <= kEnqueued; });
}

CommandBuffer::~CommandBuffer() {
    // (a buffer never completed may be destroyed with the GPU still on it -- an error -- and its stamps are then not
    // given back; one that completed has had its readers)
    if (finished_) {
        queue_.giveBuffer(std::move(profileStamps_));
        queue_.giveBuffer(std::move(drawStamps_));
    }
}

void CommandBuffer::finish(Status s) {
    status_ = s;
    if (s == kCompleted && counts_.binnedPasses != 0) queue_.checkVsc();
    if (s == kCompleted && tuning_) {
        for (const PassTime& t : passTimes()) {
            if (t.tuneKey != 0) queue_.tuned(t.tuneKey, t.tiles != 0, t.us);
        }
    }
    for (auto& h : handlers_) {
        h(*this);
    }
    handlers_.clear();
    kept_.clear();
    slab_.reset();
    queue_.giveSlabs(&slabs_);   // (done with: the GPU has finished with this buffer, or never had it)
    keptAny_.clear();
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> g(lock_);
        finished_ = true;
    }
    done_.notify_all();
}

bool CommandBuffer::copy(const Buffer& from, uint64_t fromOffset, const Buffer& to, uint64_t toOffset, uint64_t length) {
    closePass();
    if (status_ > kEnqueued) {
        return fail("copy after commit");
    }
    if (fromOffset > from.length() || length > from.length() - fromOffset || toOffset > to.length() ||
        length > to.length() - toOffset) {
        return fail("copy outside a buffer");
    }
    if (length == 0) {
        return true;
    }
    if (fromOffset % 4 || toOffset % 4 || length % 4) {
        // the command processor moves words; a copy of bytes goes through the 2D engine instead (a pass of its own).
        // MapKit's snapshot service copies rows of 2 bytes into its textures.
        std::string why;
        Piece table;
        if (!piece(render::kTableBytes, &table, &why)) {
            return fail(std::string("no memory for the copy's table: ") + why);
        }
        pm4::Stream added;
        render::encodeBytes(added, from.gpuAddress() + fromOffset, to.gpuAddress() + toOffset, length, table.gpuAddress(), table.contents());
        appendStream(stream_, added);
        use(from, false);
        use(to, true);
        return true;
    }
    uint64_t words = length / 4, done = 0;
    while (done < words) {
        uint32_t n = uint32_t(std::min<uint64_t>(words - done, kMemcpyMax));
        stream_.memcpy(to.gpuAddress() + toOffset + 4 * done, from.gpuAddress() + fromOffset + 4 * done, n);
        // what comes after may read what this wrote: the copy lands before the next packet is taken
        stream_.waitMemWrites();
        stream_.waitForMe();
        done += n;
    }
    use(from, false);
    use(to, true);
    return true;
}

bool CommandBuffer::fill(const Buffer& b, uint64_t offset, uint64_t length, uint8_t value) {
    closePass();
    if (status_ > kEnqueued) {
        return fail("fill after commit");
    }
    if (offset % 4 || length % 4) {
        return fail("fill of " + std::to_string(length) + " bytes at " + std::to_string(offset) +
                    ": the command processor writes words, so both must be multiples of 4");
    }
    if (offset > b.length() || length > b.length() - offset) {
        return fail("fill outside the buffer");
    }
    if (length == 0) {
        return true;
    }
    uint32_t word = uint32_t(value) * 0x01010101u;
    uint64_t words = length / 4, base = b.gpuAddress() + offset;
    // the first words written as they are, ...
    uint32_t head = uint32_t(std::min<uint64_t>(words, kFillHead));
    std::vector<uint32_t> pattern(head, word);
    stream_.memWrite(base, pattern.data(), head);
    stream_.waitMemWrites();
    stream_.waitForMe();
    // ... and the rest copied from what is already filled, twice as much each time
    uint64_t have = head;
    while (have < words) {
        uint32_t n = uint32_t(std::min<uint64_t>(std::min<uint64_t>(have, words - have), kMemcpyMax));
        stream_.memcpy(base + 4 * have, base, n);
        stream_.waitMemWrites();
        stream_.waitForMe();
        have += n;
    }
    use(b, true);
    return true;
}

// --- CommandQueue -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

std::unique_ptr<CommandQueue> CommandQueue::make(Gpu& gpu, std::string* why) {
    uint32_t id = 0;
    int e = gpu.newQueue(0, &id);
    if (e != 0) {
        *why = std::string("the driver gave no submission queue: ") + strerror(e);
        return nullptr;
    }
    std::unique_ptr<CommandQueue> q(new CommandQueue(gpu, id));
    q->thread_ = std::thread([p = q.get()] { p->waiter(); });
    return q;
}

CommandQueue::~CommandQueue() {
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> g(lock_);
        quit_ = true;
    }
    changed_.notify_all();
    if (thread_.joinable()) {
        thread_.join();
    }
    idle_.clear();
    gpu_.closeQueue(id_);
}

std::shared_ptr<CommandBuffer> CommandQueue::commandBuffer() {
    return std::shared_ptr<CommandBuffer>(new CommandBuffer(*this));
}

std::shared_ptr<Texture> CommandQueue::nullTexture(std::string* why) {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> g(lock_);
    if (null_ == nullptr) {
        TextureDesc d;
        d.format = PixelFormat::kRGBA8Unorm;
        std::shared_ptr<Texture> t = Texture::make(gpu_, d, why);
        // (written, not taken as the kernel's fresh zeros: the zero is the claim, so it is put there in so many words)
        const uint32_t zero = 0;
        if (t == nullptr || !t->replace(0, 0, 1, 1, &zero, 4, why)) return nullptr;
        null_ = std::move(t);
    }
    return null_;
}

namespace {
// the A635's SP cores and fibers an SP (freedreno_devices.py, the 7c+ Gen 3 entry: num_ccu 2, fibers_per_sp 128 * 2 * 16)
constexpr uint32_t kSpCores = 2;
constexpr uint32_t kFibersPerSp = 128 * 2 * 16;
}  // namespace

std::shared_ptr<Buffer> CommandQueue::privateMemory(uint32_t bytes, bool perWave, PrivateMemory* out, std::string* why) {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> g(lock_);
    const int l = perWave ? 1 : 0;
    if (privatePerFiber_[l] < bytes) {
        uint32_t perFiber = 512;
        while (perFiber < bytes) perFiber *= 2;
        const uint64_t perSp = (uint64_t(perFiber) * kFibersPerSp + 4095) & ~uint64_t(4095);
        std::shared_ptr<Buffer> b = newBuffer(gpu_, perSp * kSpCores, why);
        if (b == nullptr) return nullptr;
        private_[l].push_back(std::move(b));
        privatePerFiber_[l] = perFiber;
    }
    const uint32_t perFiber = privatePerFiber_[l];
    out->address = private_[l].back()->gpuAddress();
    out->perFiber = perFiber;
    out->perSp = uint32_t((uint64_t(perFiber) * kFibersPerSp + 4095) & ~uint64_t(4095));
    out->perWave = perWave;
    return private_[l].back();
}

size_t CommandQueue::idleCommandBuffers() {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> g(lock_);
    return idle_.size();
}

std::unique_ptr<Bo> CommandQueue::takeCommandBo(size_t bytes, int* error) {
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> g(lock_);
        for (auto it = idle_.begin(); it != idle_.end(); ++it) {
            if ((*it)->size() >= bytes) {
                std::unique_ptr<Bo> bo = std::move(*it);
                idle_.erase(it);
                return bo;
            }
        }
    }
    return gpu_.newBo(std::max(bytes, kCommandBo), kBoGpuReadOnly | kBoWriteCombined, error);
}

void CommandQueue::submit(std::shared_ptr<CommandBuffer> cb) {
    cb->committedAt_ = gpu_.transport().nowNs();
    if (!cb->error_.empty()) {
        cb->finish(CommandBuffer::kError);   // a blit that was refused: nothing of it reaches the GPU
        return;
    }
    cb->closePass();   // the last pass's tail
    // every command buffer ends with the GPU idle: what Metal's completion promises, that the work is done
    cb->stream_.waitMemWrites();
    cb->stream_.waitForIdle();
    const std::vector<uint32_t>& w = cb->stream_.words();
    int error = 0;
    cb->commands_ = takeCommandBo(4 * w.size(), &error);
    if (cb->commands_ == nullptr) {
        cb->error_ = std::string("no memory for the command stream: ") + strerror(error);
        cb->finish(CommandBuffer::kError);
        return;
    }
    // the stream is written in order, as write-combined memory wants it, and read back by nobody
    memcpy(cb->commands_->cpu(), w.data(), 4 * w.size());
    std::unique_lock<std::mutex> g(lock_);  // the fences of one queue are handed out in commit order
    cb->status_ = CommandBuffer::kCommitted;
    cb->faultsAtCommit_ = gpu_.faults();
    int e = gpu_.submit(id_, *cb->commands_, 0, uint32_t(w.size()), cb->uses_, &cb->fence_);
    if (e != 0) {
        cb->error_ = std::string("the driver refused the submission: ") + strerror(e);
        idle_.push_back(std::move(cb->commands_));
        g.unlock();                         // (the handlers may commit more: not under the queue's lock)
        cb->finish(CommandBuffer::kError);
        return;
    }
    cb->status_ = CommandBuffer::kScheduled;
    inFlight_.push_back(std::move(cb));
    changed_.notify_all();
}

void CommandQueue::waiter() {
    std::unique_lock<std::mutex> g(lock_);
    for (;;) {
        changed_.wait(g, [this] { return quit_ || !inFlight_.empty(); });
        if (inFlight_.empty()) {
            return;  // quitting, and nothing left in flight
        }
        std::shared_ptr<CommandBuffer> cb = inFlight_.front();
        g.unlock();
        int e = gpu_.wait(id_, cb->fence_, kPatienceNs);
        cb->completedAt_ = gpu_.transport().nowNs();
        // A fence that passed is not yet a submission that ran. When the kernel resets a hung GPU (gpu_recover=1) it
        // gives up everything the GPU had been given, the hung submission and those behind it in the ring, by setting
        // the fence word to the last submission's number -- so their waits end as if they had run (hakios_gpu_recover:
        // "submissions up to N are given up as done"). FAULTS counts the resets; one more since the commit says so.
        uint64_t faults = gpu_.faults();
        bool givenUp = faults > cb->faultsAtCommit_;
        if (e == 0 && givenUp) {
            cb->error_ = "given up by a reset of the GPU (it hung on this submission or on one before it): not run";
            e = EIO;
        } else if (e == ETIMEDOUT) {
            cb->error_ = givenUp ? "the GPU did not finish it in 5 s: it hung, and the kernel has reset it (reset " +
                                       std::to_string(faults) + " of this run)"
                                 : "the GPU did not finish it in 5 s and is not answering; without gpu_recover=1 the "
                                   "kernel waits for nothing again in this run";
        } else if (e != 0) {
            cb->error_ = std::string("waiting for it failed: ") + strerror(e);
        }
        cb->finish(e == 0 ? CommandBuffer::kCompleted : CommandBuffer::kError);
        g.lock();
        inFlight_.pop_front();
        if (cb->commands_ != nullptr) {
            idle_.push_back(std::move(cb->commands_));
        }
    }
}

}  // namespace hakios::metal
```

```cpp
namespace {

std::mutex gCompilerLock;   // ir3 keeps state in the compiler object; one compilation at a time

// one compiler for the chip, as the kernel names it: Mesa's table resolves 0x06030500 to the Adreno 7c+ Gen 3 row
ir3_compiler* theCompiler() {
    static ir3_compiler* compiler = [] {
        fd_dev_id id{};
        id.gpu_id = 0;
        id.chip_id = a6xx::kChipId;
        // A framebuffer fetch (nir_texop_txf_ms_fb) through the FS's own texture table, at the slot after its last
        // texture, as turnip has it (tu_device.cc: -1): the zero default would make it a bindless read of descriptor
        // set 0, which this driver never binds
        ir3_compiler_options options{};
        options.bindless_fb_read_descriptor = -1;
        // the GLSL type cache, which ir3 uses for the driver UBOs' types (get_driver_ubo_type: a module's constant table
        // is read through one); held for the life of the process, as the compiler is
        glsl_type_singleton_init_or_ref();
        return ir3_compiler_create(nullptr, &id, fd_dev_info_raw(&id), &options);
    }();
    return compiler;
}

bool refuse(std::string* why, const std::string& text) {
    *why = text;
    return false;
}

// KernelTextureDim from the NIR's sampler dimension; false, with the dimension's name, for the ones no Texture can be
// made of yet (a buffer texture, a rectangle, a multisampled or subpass image): the dispatch would otherwise bind a 2D
// texture to a txf_ms and read numbers neither right nor obviously wrong
bool textureDim(glsl_sampler_dim dim, uint8_t* out, const char** name) {
    switch (dim) {
    case GLSL_SAMPLER_DIM_1D: *out = kTexDim1D; return true;
    case GLSL_SAMPLER_DIM_2D: *out = kTexDim2D; return true;
    case GLSL_SAMPLER_DIM_3D: *out = kTexDim3D; return true;
    case GLSL_SAMPLER_DIM_CUBE: *out = kTexDimCube; return true;
    case GLSL_SAMPLER_DIM_RECT: *name = "a rectangle"; return false;
    case GLSL_SAMPLER_DIM_BUF: *name = "a texture buffer"; return false;
    case GLSL_SAMPLER_DIM_MS: *out = kTexDimMS; return true;   // texture2d_ms.read(coord, sample): a txf_ms, the sample in its own source
    default: *name = "of a dimension no texture here has"; return false;
    }
}

// The element class Apple DECLARED for a texture argument, read off air.arg_type_name ("texture2d<half, write>",
// "texture2d<uint, read>", "texture2d_array<ushort, sample>" ...): the scalar type between the first '<' and the next ','
// or '>'. False when the name has no such type (a sampler, a buffer, an unknown spelling).
bool declaredElement(const std::string& typeName, uint8_t* element) {
    size_t lt = typeName.find('<');
    if (lt == std::string::npos) return false;
    size_t b = lt + 1;
    while (b < typeName.size() && typeName[b] == ' ') b++;
    size_t e = b;
    while (e < typeName.size() && typeName[e] != ',' && typeName[e] != '>' && typeName[e] != ' ') e++;
    std::string t = typeName.substr(b, e - b);
    if (t == "half" || t == "float" || t == "bfloat") *element = kElemFloat;
    else if (t == "uint" || t == "ushort" || t == "uchar") *element = kElemUint;
    else if (t == "int" || t == "short" || t == "char") *element = kElemInt;
    else return false;
    return true;
}

uint8_t elementOf(nir_alu_type t) {
    switch (nir_alu_type_get_base_type(t)) {
    case nir_type_uint: return kElemUint;
    case nir_type_int: return kElemInt;
    default: return kElemFloat;
    }
}

// What the kernel's instructions do with each Metal texture and sampler index, read off the NIR the front end produced,
// before ir3 lowers and consumes it (ir3 clones it: ir3_context.c:68). This is the source of Kernel::textures,
// numTextureSlots and samplerMask (kernel.hpp says why ir3's own num_samp cannot be): a nir_tex_instr addresses
// texture_index through the texture table (Metal's [[texture(n)]], air_intrinsics.c:2536) and, for the ops that
// sample, sampler_index through the sampler table ([[sampler(m)]], :2537; a txf names 0 and reads no sampler:
// nir_tex_instr_need_sampler); an image intrinsic addresses src[0], a constant the front end wrote from the binding
// (air_intrinsics.c:2306-2347), through IBO slot numSsbos + index (ir3_image.c:50-52). The front end emits no deref,
// no handle and no texture_offset, so a non-constant index is refused by name rather than guessed at.
bool walkTextures(nir_shader* nir, Kernel& k, uint32_t* highestSampler, std::string* why) {
    const std::string name = nir->info.name ? nir->info.name : "the kernel";
    *highestSampler = 0;
    bool anySampler = false;
    auto slot = [&](uint32_t index, const char* what, KernelTexture** out) -> bool {
        if (index >= kMaxTextureSlots) {
            return refuse(why, name + " addresses " + what + " " + std::to_string(index) + ": the tables hold " + std::to_string(kMaxTextureSlots) +
                                   " (0 to " + std::to_string(kMaxTextureSlots - 1) + ")");
        }
        *out = &k.textures[index];
        return true;
    };
    nir_foreach_function_impl(impl, nir) {
        nir_foreach_block(block, impl) {
            nir_foreach_instr(instr, block) {
                if (instr->type == nir_instr_type_tex) {
                    nir_tex_instr* tex = nir_instr_as_tex(instr);
                    if (nir_tex_instr_src_index(tex, nir_tex_src_texture_offset) >= 0 || nir_tex_instr_src_index(tex, nir_tex_src_sampler_offset) >= 0 ||
                        nir_tex_instr_src_index(tex, nir_tex_src_texture_handle) >= 0 || nir_tex_instr_src_index(tex, nir_tex_src_sampler_handle) >= 0 ||
                        nir_tex_instr_src_index(tex, nir_tex_src_texture_deref) >= 0 || nir_tex_instr_src_index(tex, nir_tex_src_sampler_deref) >= 0) {
                        return refuse(why, name + " samples a texture or sampler chosen at run time: only Metal's own [[texture(n)]] and [[sampler(m)]] indices are served");
                    }
                    KernelTexture* t = nullptr;
                    if (!slot(tex->texture_index, "texture", &t)) return false;
                    const char* dimName = nullptr;
                    uint8_t dim = 0;
                    if (!textureDim(tex->sampler_dim, &dim, &dimName)) {
                        return refuse(why, name + ": texture " + std::to_string(tex->texture_index) + " is " + dimName + ": not served yet");
                    }
                    if (t->kind == kTexImage) {
                        // the front end makes an index a TEXTURE or an IMAGE resource, never both (air_to_nir.c:2205-2223)
                        return refuse(why, name + " both samples and stores through texture " + std::to_string(tex->texture_index));
                    }
                    t->kind = kTexSampled;
                    t->dim = dim;
                    t->isArray = tex->is_array ? 1 : 0;
                    // a query's result is an integer whatever the texture holds (txs, query_levels...): the class comes
                    // from what reads its texels, as the fixture writer takes it
                    if (!nir_tex_instr_is_query(tex)) t->element = elementOf(tex->dest_type);
                    t->bits = 0;
                    t->read = 1;
                    if (nir_tex_instr_need_sampler(tex)) {
                        if (tex->sampler_index >= kMaxTextureSlots) {
                            return refuse(why, name + " addresses sampler " + std::to_string(tex->sampler_index) + ": the tables hold " +
                                                   std::to_string(kMaxTextureSlots) + " (0 to " + std::to_string(kMaxTextureSlots - 1) + ")");
                        }
                        k.samplerMask |= 1u << tex->sampler_index;
                        if (!anySampler || tex->sampler_index > *highestSampler) *highestSampler = tex->sampler_index;
                        anySampler = true;
                    }
                } else if (instr->type == nir_instr_type_intrinsic) {
                    nir_intrinsic_instr* in = nir_instr_as_intrinsic(instr);
                    bool load = in->intrinsic == nir_intrinsic_image_load, store = in->intrinsic == nir_intrinsic_image_store;
                    bool size = in->intrinsic == nir_intrinsic_image_size || in->intrinsic == nir_intrinsic_image_levels || in->intrinsic == nir_intrinsic_image_samples;
                    if (in->intrinsic == nir_intrinsic_image_atomic || in->intrinsic == nir_intrinsic_image_atomic_swap) {
                        return refuse(why, name + " uses an image atomic: not served yet");
                    }
                    if (!load && !store && !size) continue;
                    if (!nir_src_is_const(in->src[0])) {
                        return refuse(why, name + " stores or loads through an image chosen at run time: only Metal's own [[texture(n)]] indices are served");
                    }
                    uint32_t index = uint32_t(nir_src_as_uint(in->src[0]));
                    KernelTexture* t = nullptr;
                    if (!slot(index, "image", &t)) return false;
                    const char* dimName = nullptr;
                    uint8_t dim = 0;
                    if (!textureDim(nir_intrinsic_image_dim(in), &dim, &dimName)) {
                        return refuse(why, name + ": image " + std::to_string(index) + " is " + dimName + ": not served yet");
                    }
                    if (t->kind == kTexSampled) {
                        return refuse(why, name + " both samples and stores through texture " + std::to_string(index));
                    }
                    t->kind = kTexImage;
                    t->dim = dim;
                    t->isArray = nir_intrinsic_image_array(in) ? 1 : 0;
                    // the width is the value's own (the front end's src_type/dest_type carry the class without a size:
                    // "src_type=uint" in the listings); a half image stores a 16-bit value
                    if (store) {
                        t->element = elementOf(nir_intrinsic_src_type(in));
                        t->bits = uint8_t(nir_src_bit_size(in->src[3]));
                        t->write = 1;
                    } else if (load) {
                        t->element = elementOf(nir_intrinsic_dest_type(in));
                        t->bits = uint8_t(in->def.bit_size);
                        t->read = 1;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    k.numTextureSlots = 0;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < kMaxTextureSlots; i++) {
        if (k.textures[i].kind == kTexSampled) k.numTextureSlots = i + 1;
    }
    return true;
}

// --- the road from bitcode to an assembled variant, shared by compileAir and compileStage --------------------------------
// The front end's output and everything ir3 built on it, freed together when the compile is over (the Kernel and the
// Stage copy what they keep: the words, the immediates, the tables).
struct Translation {
    void* mem = nullptr;                  // ralloc context: the function constants, the NIR, the front end's info
    nir_shader* nir = nullptr;
    air_shader_info info{};
    ir3_shader* shader = nullptr;         // the hand-built shader; its variant hangs off it
    ir3_shader_variant* v = nullptr;
    uint32_t* bin = nullptr;              // the assembled binary (ralloc'd under the variant)
    uint8_t fbTargets[kMaxTextureSlots] = {};   // lowerFbRead's slots: n + 1 where colour attachment n is read
    Translation() = default;
    Translation(const Translation&) = delete;
    Translation& operator=(const Translation&) = delete;
    ~Translation() {
        if (shader != nullptr) ralloc_free(shader);
        if (mem != nullptr) ralloc_free(mem);
    }
    const char* name() const { return nir != nullptr && nir->info.name ? nir->info.name : "the function"; }
};

// AIR to NIR: the front end, with the module's function constants as the pipeline supplied them (the rest not
// supplied: the front end tells the module so, and reads them as zero)
// a load of the known buffer at a constant offset inside its bytes: those bytes, as the load's components
bool foldKnownLoad(nir_builder* b, nir_intrinsic_instr* intr, void* data) {
    const KnownBuffer* known = static_cast<const KnownBuffer*>(data);
    if (intr->intrinsic != nir_intrinsic_load_ubo || !nir_src_is_const(intr->src[0]) || !nir_src_is_const(intr->src[1])) return false;
    if (nir_src_as_uint(intr->src[0]) != known->binding) return false;
    const unsigned bits = intr->def.bit_size, comps = intr->def.num_components;
    const uint64_t at = nir_src_as_uint(intr->src[1]);
    if (bits % 8 != 0 || at + uint64_t(comps) * (bits / 8) > known->bytes.size()) return false;
    nir_const_value values[NIR_MAX_VEC_COMPONENTS];
    for (unsigned c = 0; c < comps; c++) {
        uint64_t v = 0;
        memcpy(&v, known->bytes.data() + at + c * (bits / 8), bits / 8);   // (little-endian, as the GPU reads it)
        values[c] = nir_const_value_for_raw_uint(v, bits);
    }
    b->cursor = nir_before_instr(&intr->instr);
    nir_def_replace(&intr->def, nir_build_imm(b, comps, bits, values));
    return true;
}

bool translate(const void* bitcode, size_t size, Translation& t, std::string* why, const FunctionConstants& supplied, const KnownBuffer* known = nullptr) {
    t.mem = ralloc_context(nullptr);
    air_constant_value* constants = nullptr;
    unsigned numConstants = air_module_function_constants(t.mem, bitcode, size, &constants);
    for (const FunctionConstant& f : supplied) {
        for (unsigned i = 0; i < numConstants; i++) {
            if (constants[i].index == f.index) {
                constants[i].bits = f.bits;
                constants[i].supplied = true;
            }
        }
    }
    air_to_nir_options options{};
    options.constants = constants;
    options.num_constants = numConstants;
    const char* error = nullptr;
    t.nir = air_to_nir(t.mem, bitcode, size, nullptr, &options, ir3_get_compiler_options(theCompiler()), &t.info, &error);
    if (t.nir == nullptr) return refuse(why, std::string("the front end refused it: ") + (error ? error : "no reason given"));
    // the known buffer's reads folded, its offsets folded first (a field's offset is the front end's arithmetic on the
    // pointer), until nothing more folds: a value read may decide the offset of another read
    // (called directly, not under NIR_PASS: a debug build validates the whole shader after each, and an uber shader
    // takes rounds of this. nir_copy_prop's own answer does not count: on CoreAnimation's uber shader it says it made
    // progress every time, 21 000 rounds and on)
    for (bool progress = known != nullptr; progress;) {
        nir_copy_prop(t.nir);
        progress = nir_opt_constant_folding(t.nir);
        progress = nir_shader_intrinsics_pass(t.nir, foldKnownLoad, nir_metadata_control_flow, const_cast<KnownBuffer*>(known)) || progress;
    }
    return true;
}

// IEEE half bits to float, for the lod clamps air_sampler_state keeps as halves
float floatOfHalf(uint16_t h) {
    const uint32_t sign = uint32_t(h & 0x8000u) << 16, exp = (h >> 10) & 0x1f, mant = h & 0x3ffu;
    uint32_t bits;
    if (exp == 0) {
        float v = float(mant) / 16777216.0f;   // subnormal: mant * 2^-24
        return (h & 0x8000u) ? -v : v;
    }
    bits = exp == 31 ? sign | 0x7f800000u | (mant << 13) : sign | ((exp + 112) << 23) | (mant << 13);
    float f;
    memcpy(&f, &bits, 4);
    return f;
}

// Each constexpr sampler the function declares, as Metal's descriptor (air_sampler_state's fields onto MTLSampler.h's
```
