`userland/src/m2v_test.m`:

```m
/*
 * Metal over Vulkan on the phone, the smallest whole round: UniXNU's AdrenoMetal frontend and its metal2vulkan runtime
 * (tools/mk-m2v.sh) over Turnip (tools/mk-turnip.sh), linked into this program and opened as the plug-in would open it
 * (native_bridge_metal_open), with no window server in between. A buffer filled by a blit, a texture cleared by a render
 * pass and read back, each checked; then the clear a hundred times, timed. RC_JOBS=rc.jobs.m2vtest runs it (an image
 * built with TURNIP=1 M2V=1).
 */
#import <Foundation/Foundation.h>
#import <Metal/Metal.h>
#import <IOSurface/IOSurfaceRef.h>
#include <mach/mach.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <dlfcn.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <sys/ucontext.h>
#include <time.h>
#include <unistd.h>

id native_bridge_metal_open(const char *loader, const char *cache, uint64_t registryID, void (*missing)(const char *, const char *));
size_t native_bridge_metal_status(char *out, size_t size);
uint64_t native_bridge_metal_first_problem(char *out, size_t size);

#define TURNIP "/redwood/lib/libvulkan_freedreno.dylib"
#define CACHE "/private/var/tmp/m2v"

static double
now_ms(void)
{
	struct timespec t;

	clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &t);
	return t.tv_sec * 1e3 + t.tv_nsec / 1e6;
}

static void
missing(const char *class, const char *selector)
{
	printf("m2v_test: missing -[%s %s]\n", class, selector);
}

static void
where(const char *what, uintptr_t a)
{
	Dl_info info;

	if (dladdr((void *)a, &info) && info.dli_fname != NULL)
		printf("m2v_test:   %s %#lx = %s+%#lx (%s)\n", what, (unsigned long)a, info.dli_fname,
		    (unsigned long)(a - (uintptr_t)info.dli_fbase), info.dli_sname ? info.dli_sname : "?");
	else
		printf("m2v_test:   %s %#lx\n", what, (unsigned long)a);
}

static void
crashed(int sig, siginfo_t *si, void *context)
{
	ucontext_t *uc = context;

	printf("m2v_test: signal %d at address %p\n", sig, si->si_addr);
	where("pc", (uintptr_t)uc->uc_mcontext->__ss.__pc);
	where("lr", (uintptr_t)uc->uc_mcontext->__ss.__lr);
	uintptr_t fp = (uintptr_t)uc->uc_mcontext->__ss.__fp;
	for (int i = 0; i < 16 && fp != 0 && (fp & 7) == 0; i++) {
		where("frame", ((uintptr_t *)fp)[1]);
		fp = ((uintptr_t *)fp)[0];
	}
	_exit(128 + sig);
}

static int
status(int failed)
{
	char line[512] = "", problem[256] = "";

	native_bridge_metal_status(line, sizeof line);
	printf("m2v_test: status %s\n", line);
	if (native_bridge_metal_first_problem(problem, sizeof problem))
		printf("m2v_test: first problem: %s\n", problem);
	printf("m2v_test: %s\n", failed ? "FAIL" : "PASS");
	return failed;
}

int
main(void)
{
	struct sigaction sa = { .sa_sigaction = crashed, .sa_flags = SA_SIGINFO };
	sigaction(SIGSEGV, &sa, NULL);
	sigaction(SIGBUS, &sa, NULL);
	sigaction(SIGILL, &sa, NULL);
	sigaction(SIGABRT, &sa, NULL);
	sigaction(SIGTRAP, &sa, NULL);
	setvbuf(stdout, NULL, _IONBF, 0);
	dup2(1, 2);                     /* the runtime's and Turnip's messages (stderr) beside ours */
	setenv("TU_DEBUG", "startup", 0);
	mkdir("/private/var/tmp", 0777);
	mkdir(CACHE, 0700);

	@autoreleasepool {
		double t0 = now_ms();
		id<MTLDevice> device = native_bridge_metal_open(TURNIP, CACHE, 0, missing);
		if (device == nil) {
			printf("m2v_test: no device\n");
			return status(1);
		}
		printf("m2v_test: device \"%s\" (class %s) in %.1f ms\n", device.name.UTF8String,
		    object_getClassName(device), now_ms() - t0);

		id<MTLCommandQueue> queue = [device newCommandQueue];
		const NSUInteger words = 1u << 20;
		id<MTLBuffer> buffer = [device newBufferWithLength:words * 4 options:MTLResourceStorageModeShared];
		memset(buffer.contents, 0, words * 4);
		id<MTLCommandBuffer> cb = [queue commandBuffer];
		id<MTLBlitCommandEncoder> blit = [cb blitCommandEncoder];
		[blit fillBuffer:buffer range:NSMakeRange(0, words * 4) value:0x5a];
		[blit endEncoding];
		t0 = now_ms();
		[cb commit];
		[cb waitUntilCompleted];
		const uint32_t *w = buffer.contents;
		NSUInteger right = 0;
		for (NSUInteger i = 0; i < words; i++)
			right += w[i] == 0x5a5a5a5a;
		printf("m2v_test: blit fill: %lu of %lu words right in %.2f ms (status %ld)%s\n", (unsigned long)right,
		    (unsigned long)words, now_ms() - t0, (long)cb.status, right == words ? "" : " -- WRONG");
		if (right != words)
			return status(1);

		const NSUInteger width = 1080, height = 2400;
		MTLTextureDescriptor *td = [MTLTextureDescriptor texture2DDescriptorWithPixelFormat:MTLPixelFormatBGRA8Unorm
		    width:width height:height mipmapped:NO];
		td.usage = MTLTextureUsageRenderTarget | MTLTextureUsageShaderRead;
		td.storageMode = MTLStorageModeShared;
		id<MTLTexture> texture = [device newTextureWithDescriptor:td];
		MTLRenderPassDescriptor *rp = [MTLRenderPassDescriptor renderPassDescriptor];
		rp.colorAttachments[0].texture = texture;
		rp.colorAttachments[0].loadAction = MTLLoadActionClear;
		rp.colorAttachments[0].storeAction = MTLStoreActionStore;
		rp.colorAttachments[0].clearColor = MTLClearColorMake(1.0, 0.5, 0.0, 1.0);
		cb = [queue commandBuffer];
		[[cb renderCommandEncoderWithDescriptor:rp] endEncoding];
		t0 = now_ms();
		[cb commit];
		[cb waitUntilCompleted];
		double first = now_ms() - t0;
		uint32_t *pixels = malloc(width * height * 4);
		[texture getBytes:pixels bytesPerRow:width * 4 fromRegion:MTLRegionMake2D(0, 0, width, height) mipmapLevel:0];
		NSUInteger good = 0;
		for (NSUInteger i = 0; i < width * height; i++)
			good += (pixels[i] & 0xffffff) == 0xff8000 || (pixels[i] & 0xffffff) == 0xff7f00;
		printf("m2v_test: clear of %lux%lu: %lu of %lu pixels orange in %.2f ms (first pixel %#x)%s\n", (unsigned long)width,
		    (unsigned long)height, (unsigned long)good, (unsigned long)(width * height), first, pixels[0],
		    good == width * height ? "" : " -- WRONG");

		double best = 1e9, sum = 0;
		for (int i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
			cb = [queue commandBuffer];
			[[cb renderCommandEncoderWithDescriptor:rp] endEncoding];
			double a = now_ms();
			[cb commit];
			[cb waitUntilCompleted];
			double d = now_ms() - a;
			sum += d;
			if (d < best)
				best = d;
		}
		printf("m2v_test: 100 full-screen clears, each committed and waited for: %.3f ms on average, %.3f at best\n",
		    sum / 100, best);
		int failed = good != width * height;

		/* what the window server reads: an IOSurface written by the CPU, and pages of a program's own (no-copy), as textures */
		const NSUInteger side = 256;
		MTLTextureDescriptor *small = [MTLTextureDescriptor texture2DDescriptorWithPixelFormat:MTLPixelFormatBGRA8Unorm
		    width:side height:side mipmapped:NO];
		small.usage = MTLTextureUsageShaderRead | MTLTextureUsageRenderTarget;
		small.storageMode = MTLStorageModeShared;
		id<MTLTexture> into = [device newTextureWithDescriptor:small];
		uint32_t *back = malloc(side * side * 4);
		uint32_t (^copied)(id<MTLTexture>, uint32_t) = ^uint32_t(id<MTLTexture> from, uint32_t want) {
			memset(back, 0, side * side * 4);
			id<MTLCommandBuffer> c = [queue commandBuffer];
			id<MTLBlitCommandEncoder> b = [c blitCommandEncoder];
			[b copyFromTexture:from sourceSlice:0 sourceLevel:0 sourceOrigin:MTLOriginMake(0, 0, 0)
			    sourceSize:MTLSizeMake(side, side, 1) toTexture:into destinationSlice:0 destinationLevel:0
			    destinationOrigin:MTLOriginMake(0, 0, 0)];
			[b endEncoding];
			[c commit];
			[c waitUntilCompleted];
			[into getBytes:back bytesPerRow:side * 4 fromRegion:MTLRegionMake2D(0, 0, side, side) mipmapLevel:0];
			uint32_t right = 0;
			for (NSUInteger i = 0; i < side * side; i++)
				right += back[i] == want;
			printf("m2v_test:   status %ld, first pixel %#x, last %#x\n", (long)c.status, back[0], back[side * side - 1]);
			return right;
		};

		NSDictionary *props = @{ (id)kIOSurfaceWidth: @(side), (id)kIOSurfaceHeight: @(side), (id)kIOSurfaceBytesPerElement: @4,
		    (id)kIOSurfacePixelFormat: @((uint32_t)'BGRA') };
		IOSurfaceRef surface = IOSurfaceCreate((__bridge CFDictionaryRef)props);
		IOSurfaceLock(surface, 0, NULL);
		size_t row = IOSurfaceGetBytesPerRow(surface);
		for (NSUInteger y = 0; y < side; y++)
			for (NSUInteger x = 0; x < side; x++)
				((uint32_t *)((uint8_t *)IOSurfaceGetBaseAddress(surface) + y * row))[x] = 0xff00ff00;
		IOSurfaceUnlock(surface, 0, NULL);
		id<MTLTexture> onSurface = [device newTextureWithDescriptor:small iosurface:surface plane:0];
		right = onSurface ? copied(onSurface, 0xff00ff00) : 0;
		printf("m2v_test: IOSurface written by the CPU, copied by the GPU: %lu of %lu pixels green%s\n", (unsigned long)right,
		    (unsigned long)(side * side), right == side * side ? "" : " -- WRONG");
		failed |= right != side * side;

		vm_address_t pages = 0;
		vm_allocate(mach_task_self(), &pages, side * side * 4, VM_FLAGS_ANYWHERE);
		for (NSUInteger i = 0; i < side * side; i++)
			((uint32_t *)pages)[i] = 0xffff0000;
		id<MTLBuffer> noCopy = [device newBufferWithBytesNoCopy:(void *)pages length:side * side * 4
		    options:MTLResourceStorageModeShared deallocator:nil];
		id<MTLTexture> onPages = [noCopy newTextureWithDescriptor:small offset:0 bytesPerRow:side * 4];
		right = onPages ? copied(onPages, 0xffff0000) : 0;
		printf("m2v_test: own pages (no-copy buffer %s, texture %s) copied by the GPU: %lu of %lu pixels red%s\n",
		    noCopy ? "made" : "REFUSED", onPages ? "made" : "REFUSED", right, (unsigned long)(side * side),
		    right == side * side ? "" : " -- WRONG");
		failed |= right != side * side;

		/* and the other way: the GPU clears the IOSurface, the CPU reads it */
		MTLRenderPassDescriptor *toSurface = [MTLRenderPassDescriptor renderPassDescriptor];
		toSurface.colorAttachments[0].texture = onSurface;
		toSurface.colorAttachments[0].loadAction = MTLLoadActionClear;
		toSurface.colorAttachments[0].storeAction = MTLStoreActionStore;
		toSurface.colorAttachments[0].clearColor = MTLClearColorMake(0, 0, 1, 1);
		cb = [queue commandBuffer];
		[[cb renderCommandEncoderWithDescriptor:toSurface] endEncoding];
		[cb commit];
		[cb waitUntilCompleted];
		IOSurfaceLock(surface, kIOSurfaceLockReadOnly, NULL);
		right = 0;
		for (NSUInteger y = 0; y < side; y++)
			for (NSUInteger x = 0; x < side; x++)
				right += ((uint32_t *)((uint8_t *)IOSurfaceGetBaseAddress(surface) + y * row))[x] == 0xff0000ff;
		printf("m2v_test: IOSurface cleared by the GPU, read by the CPU: %lu of %lu pixels blue (first %#x)%s\n", right,
		    (unsigned long)(side * side), *(uint32_t *)IOSurfaceGetBaseAddress(surface), right == side * side ? "" : " -- WRONG");
		IOSurfaceUnlock(surface, kIOSurfaceLockReadOnly, NULL);
		failed |= right != side * side;
		return status(failed);
	}
}

```

`userland/src/metal_test.m`:

```m
/*
 * metal_test: what Darwin here believes about Metal, and what it does with the answer.
 *
 * Nothing in Darwin says a word when Metal is missing. A program asks for the system's device with
 * MTLCreateSystemDefaultDevice(); if there is none it gets nil, with no log line, no error and no
 * reason, and whatever the caller does next -- fall back, draw nothing, or stop at an assertion --
 * is all that is ever seen. This prints the whole chain instead, so that a failure somewhere above
 * can be told from a failure here.
 *
 * The chain is short, and every step of it is checked below:
 *
 *   1. Metal's MTLRegisterDevices() asks IOKit for the services of class "IOAcceleratorES" --
 *      that name, and no other, is the whole of how a GPU is found;
 *   2. of each such service it reads two string properties, "MetalPluginName" and
 *      "MetalPluginClassName";
 *   3. it loads /System/Library/Extensions/<MetalPluginName>.bundle and takes the class named by
 *      MetalPluginClassName, or the bundle's principal class;
 *   4. the class must be a subclass of Metal's own private _MTLDevice, or it is dropped;
 *   5. it is sent -initWithAcceleratorPort: with the service, and that object is the device.
 *      MTLCreateSystemDefaultDevice() hands out the one device of that list, under a dispatch_once:
 *      an empty list is an answer given once and kept, silently, for the life of the process.
 *
 * So the question "is there Metal" has exactly one answer, and no capability bit anywhere stands
 * in for it. What Darwin publishes about graphics besides -- MobileGestalt's GraphicsFeatureSetClass
 * and GraphicsFeatureSetFallbacks, from the device tree's "graphics-featureset-class" and
 * "graphics-featureset-fallbacks" -- is read by CoreUI and CoreThemeDefinition to choose which
 * compiled artwork to take out of an asset catalog, not by anything that decides how to draw; it
 * is printed here to show that it says the iPhone X's "APPLE4" whether or not a device exists.
 *
 * The last part asks a framework that has a path without Metal whether that path works: CoreImage
 * runs a filter kernel over four pixels and the result is read back. It is the one thing here that
 * can answer "can this system process an image at all", which the camera and Photos both need.
 *
 *   usage: metal_test
 */
#import <CoreFoundation/CoreFoundation.h>
#import <CoreImage/CoreImage.h>
#import <Foundation/Foundation.h>
#import <IOKit/IOKitLib.h>
#import <Metal/Metal.h>
#import <OpenGLES/EAGL.h>
#import <objc/message.h>
#import <objc/runtime.h>
#import <dlfcn.h>
#import <signal.h>
#import <stdio.h>
#import <stdlib.h>
#import <spawn.h>
#import <sys/wait.h>
#import <time.h>
#import <unistd.h>

extern CFTypeRef MGCopyAnswer(CFStringRef key);

#define EXTENSIONS      "/System/Library/Extensions"

/*
 * Where a crash happened, in the addresses of the dyld shared cache as ipsw prints them.
 *
 * The cache is loaded at a sliding address, so a program counter means nothing by itself. The slide
 * is worked out from one symbol whose unslid address is known from the cache
 * (MTLCreateSystemDefaultDevice, 0x181a34b3c in 20F66 for iPhone10,3): slide = where it is now
 * minus where the cache says it is. Subtracting that from a program counter gives an address
 * `ipsw dyld a2s <cache> <address>` can name. The same trick is what src/inject.c does in reverse.
 */
#define MTL_CREATE_DEVICE_UNSLID 0x181a34b3cUL

static uintptr_t
cache_slide(void)
{
	return (uintptr_t)&MTLCreateSystemDefaultDevice - MTL_CREATE_DEVICE_UNSLID;
}

static void
fault(int sig, siginfo_t *info, void *uap)
{
	ucontext_t *uc = uap;
	uintptr_t slide = cache_slide();
	uintptr_t pc = 0, lr = 0, fp = 0;

	if (uc != NULL && uc->uc_mcontext != NULL) {
		pc = (uintptr_t)uc->uc_mcontext->__ss.__pc;
		lr = (uintptr_t)uc->uc_mcontext->__ss.__lr;
		fp = (uintptr_t)uc->uc_mcontext->__ss.__fp;
	}
	/* async-signal-safe enough for a diagnostic that is about to exit anyway */
	printf("metal_test:     signal %d at address %p\n", sig, info != NULL ? info->si_addr : NULL);
	printf("metal_test:     pc  %#lx unslid (cache slide %#lx)\n", pc - slide, slide);
	printf("metal_test:     lr  %#lx unslid\n", lr - slide);
	for (int i = 0; i < 8 && fp > 0x1000; i++) {
		uintptr_t next = ((uintptr_t *)fp)[0], ret = ((uintptr_t *)fp)[1];

		if (ret == 0) {
			break;
		}
		printf("metal_test:     #%d  %#lx unslid\n", i, ret - slide);
		if (next <= fp) {
			break;
		}
		fp = next;
	}
	_exit(99);
}

/*
 * Some of what is asked below can take the process down with it, so each such question is asked by
 * a fresh process: metal_test re-executes itself with the question as its argument (see main()).
 *
 * It must be a new process and not just a forked one. A forked child may not use Objective-C at
 * all when the parent had more than one thread, and metal_test does -- linking CoreImage and
 * OpenGLES is enough. A first attempt did fork, and every probe then died of SIGABRT inside the
 * runtime itself:
 *
 *   objc[98]: +[__NSCFNumber initialize] may have been in progress in another thread when fork()
 *   was called. We cannot safely call it or ignore it in the fork() child process. Crashing
 *   instead.
 *
 * -- objc_initializeAfterForkError, which says nothing whatever about CoreImage. exec() clears
 * that, because the runtime starts afresh.
 */
static void
in_a_new_process(const char *what, const char *argument, int secs)
{
	extern char **environ;
	char *const argv[] = { (char *)"/redwood/bin/metal_test", (char *)argument, NULL };
	pid_t pid;
	int status = 0, waited = 0;

	printf("metal_test: %s (asked by a process of its own)\n", what);
	if (posix_spawn(&pid, argv[0], NULL, NULL, argv, environ) != 0) {
		printf("metal_test:   cannot start %s %s\n", argv[0], argument);
		return;
	}
	while (waitpid(pid, &status, WNOHANG) == 0) {
		struct timespec ts = { .tv_sec = 0, .tv_nsec = 100 * 1000 * 1000 };

		nanosleep(&ts, NULL);
		if (++waited > secs * 10) {
			kill(pid, SIGKILL);
			waitpid(pid, &status, 0);
			printf("metal_test:   %s: still going after %d s, killed (it wedges here)\n", what, secs);
			return;
		}
	}
	if (WIFSIGNALED(status)) {
		printf("metal_test:   %s: died of signal %d\n", what, WTERMSIG(status));
	} else if (WEXITSTATUS(status) == 99) {
		printf("metal_test:   %s: it faulted, and said above where\n", what);
	} else if (WEXITSTATUS(status) != 0) {
		printf("metal_test:   %s: ended with status %d\n", what, WEXITSTATUS(status));
	}
}

/* A string property of an IOKit service, or NULL; the caller frees it. */
static char *
service_string(io_service_t service, const char *name)
{
	CFStringRef key = CFStringCreateWithCString(NULL, name, kCFStringEncodingUTF8);
	CFTypeRef value = IORegistryEntryCreateCFProperty(service, key, NULL, 0);
	char *text = NULL;

	CFRelease(key);
	if (value != NULL) {
		if (CFGetTypeID(value) == CFStringGetTypeID()) {
			text = calloc(1, 256);
			if (text != NULL && !CFStringGetCString(value, text, 256, kCFStringEncodingUTF8)) {
				free(text);
				text = NULL;
			}
		}
		CFRelease(value);
	}
	return text;
}

/* Step 1 and 2: the services Metal looks for, and the two properties it reads of each. */
static int
accelerators(void)
{
	io_iterator_t it = IO_OBJECT_NULL;
	CFMutableDictionaryRef matching = IOServiceMatching("IOAcceleratorES");
	kern_return_t kr;
	io_service_t service;
	int found = 0;

	if (matching == NULL) {
		printf("metal_test: IOServiceMatching(\"IOAcceleratorES\") failed\n");
		return 0;
	}
	/* IOServiceGetMatchingServices consumes the dictionary. */
	kr = IOServiceGetMatchingServices(MACH_PORT_NULL, matching, &it);
	if (kr != KERN_SUCCESS) {
		printf("metal_test: IOServiceGetMatchingServices failed, %#x\n", kr);
		return 0;
	}
	while ((service = IOIteratorNext(it)) != IO_OBJECT_NULL) {
		io_name_t name = { 0 };
		char *plugin = service_string(service, "MetalPluginName");
		char *class_name = service_string(service, "MetalPluginClassName");

		IORegistryEntryGetName(service, name);
		printf("metal_test:   IOAcceleratorES \"%s\": MetalPluginName %s, MetalPluginClassName %s\n",
		    name, plugin ? plugin : "(none)", class_name ? class_name : "(none)");
		free(plugin);
		free(class_name);
		IOObjectRelease(service);
		found++;
	}
	IOObjectRelease(it);
	if (found == 0) {
		printf("metal_test:   none: Metal will find no device at all\n");
	}
	return found;
}

/* What the registry does have that looks like a GPU, whatever its class is called. */
static void
gpu_services(void)
{
	static const char *const classes[] = { "HakiosGPU", "IOGPU", "AGXAccelerator", "IOAccelerator" };
	int found = 0;

	for (size_t i = 0; i < sizeof(classes) / sizeof(classes[0]); i++) {
		CFMutableDictionaryRef matching = IOServiceMatching(classes[i]);
		io_iterator_t it = IO_OBJECT_NULL;
		io_service_t service;

		if (matching == NULL || IOServiceGetMatchingServices(MACH_PORT_NULL, matching, &it) != KERN_SUCCESS) {
			continue;
		}
		while ((service = IOIteratorNext(it)) != IO_OBJECT_NULL) {
			io_name_t name = { 0 };
			char *client = service_string(service, "IOUserClientClass");

			IORegistryEntryGetName(service, name);
			printf("metal_test:   %s \"%s\": IOUserClientClass %s\n", classes[i], name,
			    client ? client : "(none)");
			free(client);
			IOObjectRelease(service);
			found++;
		}
		IOObjectRelease(it);
	}
	if (found == 0) {
		printf("metal_test:   none\n");
	}
}

/* Steps 3 and 4: could a plug-in bundle in this image be loaded and taken for a device at all. */
static void
plugins(void)
{
	NSFileManager *files = [NSFileManager defaultManager];
	NSArray<NSString *> *entries = [files contentsOfDirectoryAtPath:@EXTENSIONS error:NULL];
	Class device_class = objc_getClass("_MTLDevice");
	int bundles = 0;

	printf("metal_test:   Metal's own base class _MTLDevice: %s\n", device_class ? "there" : "not there");
	if (entries == nil) {
		printf("metal_test:   %s is not in this image: no plug-in could be loaded\n", EXTENSIONS);
		return;
	}
	for (NSString *entry in entries) {
		if (![entry hasSuffix:@".bundle"]) {
			continue;
		}
		NSString *path = [@EXTENSIONS stringByAppendingPathComponent:entry];
		NSBundle *bundle = [NSBundle bundleWithPath:path];
		NSString *executable = [bundle objectForInfoDictionaryKey:@"CFBundleExecutable"];
		NSString *principal = [bundle objectForInfoDictionaryKey:@"NSPrincipalClass"];
		Class loaded = Nil;
		const char *verdict;

		bundles++;
		/* Taking the class is what loads the bundle's code; it is the step that fails first. */
		loaded = principal != nil ? [bundle classNamed:principal] : [bundle principalClass];
		if (loaded == Nil) {
			verdict = "the class does not load";
		} else if (device_class == Nil) {
			verdict = "loaded, but there is no _MTLDevice to compare it with";
		} else if ([loaded isSubclassOfClass:device_class]) {
			verdict = "loaded, and a _MTLDevice: Metal would take it";
		} else {
			verdict = "loaded, but not a _MTLDevice: Metal would drop it";
		}
		printf("metal_test:   %s: executable %s, principal class %s -- %s\n", [entry UTF8String],
		    executable ? [executable UTF8String] : "(none)",
		    principal ? [principal UTF8String] : "(none)", verdict);
	}
	if (bundles == 0) {
		printf("metal_test:   no .bundle in %s\n", EXTENSIONS);
	}
}

/* Step 5, as a program sees it. */
static void
the_device(void)
{
	id<MTLDevice> device = MTLCreateSystemDefaultDevice();

	if (device == nil) {
		printf("metal_test:   MTLCreateSystemDefaultDevice() = nil (and says nothing about why)\n");
		return;
	}
	printf("metal_test:   MTLCreateSystemDefaultDevice() = \"%s\", class %s\n",
	    [[device name] UTF8String], class_getName([(id)device class]));
	printf("metal_test:   registry id %llu, unified memory %d, max threads per group %lu, "
	    "Apple family 1/4 %d/%d\n", (unsigned long long)[device registryID], (int)[device hasUnifiedMemory],
	    (unsigned long)[device maxThreadsPerThreadgroup].width,
	    (int)[device supportsFamily:MTLGPUFamilyApple1], (int)[device supportsFamily:MTLGPUFamilyApple4]);
}

/*
 * What the device can make (HakiosMetal's step two, docs/metal-plan.md): a buffer written and read back through -contents, a
 * copy, and the library of the OpenGL ES-on-Metal renderer the system carries, its functions by name. Run in a process of its
 * own: a device that cannot do something may end the process that asks.
 */
#define GL_RENDERER_LIBRARY "/System/Library/Extensions/AppleMetalGLRenderer.bundle/default.metallib"

static void
device_objects(void)
{
	id<MTLDevice> device = MTLCreateSystemDefaultDevice();
	NSError *error = nil;

	if (device == nil) {
		printf("metal_test:   no device: nothing to ask\n");
		return;
	}
	id<MTLBuffer> buffer = [device newBufferWithLength:65536 options:MTLResourceStorageModeShared];
	if (buffer == nil) {
		printf("metal_test:   newBufferWithLength:65536 = nil\n");
	} else {
		uint32_t *words = [buffer contents], bad = 0;

		for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 16384; i++) {
			words[i] = i * 2654435761u;
		}
		for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 16384; i++) {
			bad += words[i] != i * 2654435761u;
		}
		printf("metal_test:   a buffer of %lu bytes (class %s, storage mode %lu): written and read back, %u words wrong\n",
		    (unsigned long)[buffer length], class_getName([(id)buffer class]), (unsigned long)[buffer storageMode], bad);
	}
	static const char text[] = "the bytes of a buffer made with newBufferWithBytes:";
	id<MTLBuffer> copy = [device newBufferWithBytes:text length:sizeof(text) options:0];
	printf("metal_test:   newBufferWithBytes: %s\n", copy == nil ? "nil" :
	    memcmp([copy contents], text, sizeof(text)) == 0 ? "a copy of them" : "SOMETHING ELSE");

	id<MTLLibrary> library = [device newLibraryWithURL:[NSURL fileURLWithPath:@GL_RENDERER_LIBRARY] error:&error];
	if (library == nil) {
		printf("metal_test:   newLibraryWithURL:%s = nil (%s)\n", GL_RENDERER_LIBRARY, [[error localizedDescription] UTF8String]);
		return;
	}
	NSArray<NSString *> *names = [library functionNames];
	unsigned kinds[4] = { 0 };
	for (NSString *name in names) {
		id<MTLFunction> f = [library newFunctionWithName:name];
		unsigned long type = f != nil ? [f functionType] : 0;

		kinds[type == MTLFunctionTypeVertex ? 0 : type == MTLFunctionTypeFragment ? 1 : type == MTLFunctionTypeKernel ? 2 : 3]++;
	}
	printf("metal_test:   the GL renderer's library (class %s): %lu functions, %u vertex, %u fragment, %u kernel, %u other%s%s\n",
	    class_getName([(id)library class]), (unsigned long)[names count], kinds[0], kinds[1], kinds[2], kinds[3],
	    [names count] ? "; the first is " : "", [names count] ? [names[0] UTF8String] : "");
}

/* What Darwin publishes about graphics besides: artwork, not rendering (see the note above). */
static void
gestalt(void)
{
	static const char *const keys[] = {
		"GraphicsFeatureSetClass", "GraphicsFeatureSetFallbacks", "ArtworkDeviceSubType",
		"HasExtendedColorDisplay", "main-screen-class", "DeviceSupportsMetal",
	};

	for (size_t i = 0; i < sizeof(keys) / sizeof(keys[0]); i++) {
		CFStringRef key = CFStringCreateWithCString(NULL, keys[i], kCFStringEncodingUTF8);
		CFTypeRef answer = MGCopyAnswer(key);
		CFStringRef text = answer ? CFCopyDescription(answer) : NULL;
		char line[256] = "(none)";

		if (text != NULL) {
			CFStringGetCString(text, line, sizeof(line), kCFStringEncodingUTF8);
			CFRelease(text);
		}
		printf("metal_test:   %s = %s\n", keys[i], line);
		if (answer != NULL) {
			CFRelease(answer);
		}
		CFRelease(key);
	}
}

/*
 * A framework that has a path without Metal: CoreImage. A filter kernel is run over four pixels
 * and the result read back, which tells whether this system can process an image at all.
 */
/* `options` is nil for the default context, or a dictionary to ask for something else. */
static NSDictionary *coreimage_options;
/* ... or the context is made over an EAGLContext of ours instead (coreimage_eagl). */
static int coreimage_over_eagl;

/*
 * The way back for CoreImage, if there is one. Darwin 16.5's CoreImage carries a whole second back
 * end on OpenGL ES -- CI::GLContext, CI::GLMainProgram, CI::GLTextureManager beside the
 * CI::MetalContext family -- it is linked against OpenGLES, it compiles its shaders as GLSL (not
 * AIR), and CIGLIsUsable() is compiled to "return 1". The public way in is
 * +[CIContext contextWithEAGLContext:], and the one thing it wants of the library underneath,
 * CIEAGLContextTexImageIOSurface, is a call src/eagl.c already answers for CoreAnimation. So: make
 * an EAGLContext (which on an image built with GL=1, on a phone with gpu=1, is our Mesa behind
 * src/eagl.c) and hand it over.
 */
#define HAKIOS_GL      "/redwood/lib/libhakios.gl.dylib"

static EAGLContext *
make_eagl(void)
{
	EAGLContext *gl;

	/*
	 * Our OpenGL ES has to be put behind EAGLContext in THIS process first. libhakios.dylib does
	 * it only for backboardd (src/inject.c, opengl_es(), which is called for that name alone), and
	 * the way it does it -- replacing methods of EAGLContext through the ObjC runtime -- is local
	 * to a process. The library installs itself from a constructor, so loading it is enough; what
	 * it replaced it says itself in lines "hakios-gl:". Without this, EAGLContext here would be
	 * Darwin's own, which is AppleMetalGLRenderer over Metal -- the thing that is missing.
	 */
	if (access(HAKIOS_GL, R_OK) != 0) {
		printf("metal_test:   %s is not in this image: build it with GL=1\n", HAKIOS_GL);
		return nil;
	}
	/*
	 * coreimage_over_eagl == 2: Mesa's software driver instead of the phone's GPU. Worth asking
	 * separately, because the window server already holds the GPU while this runs: if freedreno
	 * cannot have it too, softpipe still answers the question that matters -- whether CoreImage's
	 * OpenGL ES back end works at all behind an EAGLContext of ours.
	 */
	if (coreimage_over_eagl == 2) {
		setenv("OSMESA_SOFTWARE", "1", 1);
		printf("metal_test:   OSMESA_SOFTWARE=1: Mesa's software driver, not the GPU\n");
	}
	if (dlopen(HAKIOS_GL, RTLD_NOW) == NULL) {
		printf("metal_test:   %s: %s\n", HAKIOS_GL, dlerror());
		return nil;
	}
	printf("metal_test:   %s loaded; EAGLContext is ours now\n", HAKIOS_GL);
	gl = [[EAGLContext alloc] initWithAPI:kEAGLRenderingAPIOpenGLES3];

	if (gl == nil) {
		printf("metal_test:   no OpenGL ES 3 context; trying 2\n");
		gl = [[EAGLContext alloc] initWithAPI:kEAGLRenderingAPIOpenGLES2];
	}
	if (gl == nil) {
		printf("metal_test:   no EAGLContext at all: this image has no OpenGL ES\n");
		return nil;
	}
	printf("metal_test:   EAGLContext: %s, API %d\n", class_getName([gl class]), (int)[gl API]);
	if (![EAGLContext setCurrentContext:gl]) {
		printf("metal_test:   the EAGLContext would not become current\n");
	}
	return gl;
}

static void
coreimage(void)
{
	@autoreleasepool {
		CIContext *context;
		CIImage *source, *result;
		CIFilter *filter;
		CGImageRef image;
		CGRect rect = CGRectMake(0, 0, 4, 4);
		unsigned char pixels[4 * 4 * 4];
		CGColorSpaceRef space;
		CGContextRef bitmap;

		/* said before the call, not after: this is the call that was dying */
		printf("metal_test:   asking for a CIContext (%s)...\n", coreimage_over_eagl ? "over an EAGLContext"
		    : coreimage_options == nil ? "the default one" : "software renderer");
		if (coreimage_over_eagl) {
			EAGLContext *gl = make_eagl();

			if (gl == nil) {
				return;
			}
			context = [CIContext contextWithEAGLContext:gl];
		} else {
			context = [CIContext contextWithOptions:coreimage_options];
		}
		if (context == nil) {
			printf("metal_test:   no CIContext: CoreImage cannot work here\n");
			return;
		}
		/*
		 * Which of CoreImage's two backends the default context took. Darwin userland 16.5 has both:
		 * CI::GLContext (with CI::GLMainProgram, CI::GLTextureManager) and CI::MetalContext
		 * (with CI::MetalDAG, CI::MetalKernel); -[CIContext initWithOptions:] chooses between
		 * them by CIGLIsUsable(). -isOpenGLBased and -device are private, so they are asked for
		 * only if they are there.
		 */
		printf("metal_test:   CIContext: %s\n", class_getName([context class]));
		/*
		 * Sent through a typed objc_msgSend, not -performSelector:, because -isOpenGLBased
		 * returns a BOOL and not an object: ARC would take the return value for one.
		 */
		SEL gl_sel = @selector(isOpenGLBased);
		if ([context respondsToSelector:gl_sel]) {
			BOOL (*ask)(id, SEL) = (BOOL (*)(id, SEL))objc_msgSend;
			printf("metal_test:   backend: %s\n", ask(context, gl_sel)
			    ? "OpenGL ES (CI::GLContext)" : "Metal (CI::MetalContext)");
		} else {
			printf("metal_test:   backend: -isOpenGLBased is not there to ask\n");
		}
		SEL dev_sel = @selector(device);
		if ([context respondsToSelector:dev_sel]) {
			id (*ask_device)(id, SEL) = (id (*)(id, SEL))objc_msgSend;
			id device = ask_device(context, dev_sel);
			printf("metal_test:   the context's Metal device: %s\n",
			    device ? class_getName([device class]) : "nil");
		}
		/* orange, inverted by a kernel: 1, 0.5, 0 -> 0, 0.5, 1 */
		source = [[CIImage imageWithColor:[CIColor colorWithRed:1.0 green:0.5 blue:0.0]]
		    imageByCroppingToRect:rect];
		filter = [CIFilter filterWithName:@"CIColorInvert"];
		if (filter == nil) {
			printf("metal_test:   no CIColorInvert filter\n");
			return;
		}
		[filter setValue:source forKey:kCIInputImageKey];
		result = [filter valueForKey:kCIOutputImageKey];
		if (result == nil) {
			printf("metal_test:   the filter gave no image\n");
			return;
		}
		printf("metal_test:   running the filter kernel...\n");
		image = [context createCGImage:result fromRect:rect];
		if (image == NULL) {
			printf("metal_test:   CoreImage did not render: a filter kernel cannot run here\n");
			return;
		}
		memset(pixels, 0, sizeof(pixels));
		space = CGColorSpaceCreateDeviceRGB();
		bitmap = CGBitmapContextCreate(pixels, 4, 4, 8, 4 * 4, space,
		    kCGImageAlphaPremultipliedLast | kCGBitmapByteOrder32Big);
		if (bitmap != NULL) {
			CGContextDrawImage(bitmap, rect, image);
			printf("metal_test:   CoreImage rendered: first pixel %u %u %u %u (inverted orange is about 0 128 255 255)\n",
			    pixels[0], pixels[1], pixels[2], pixels[3]);
			CGContextRelease(bitmap);
		} else {
			printf("metal_test:   CoreImage rendered, but the pixels could not be read back\n");
		}
		CGColorSpaceRelease(space);
		CGImageRelease(image);
	}
}

/*
 * Blits through Metal's own API, as any program would ask for them: a queue, a command buffer, a blit encoder, copy and
 * fill, commit, and the bytes checked when it is done. With hakios-metal and gpu=1 the GPU's command processor does the
 * work (HakiosMetal.m, hakios-metal's CP_MEMCPY and CP_MEM_WRITE); without, the queue makes no command buffers and this says so.
 */
static void
blits(void)
{
	id<MTLDevice> device = MTLCreateSystemDefaultDevice();
	const NSUInteger n = 1 << 20;

	if (device == nil) {
		printf("metal_test:   no device\n");
		return;
	}
	id<MTLCommandQueue> queue = [device newCommandQueue];
	id<MTLBuffer> a = [device newBufferWithLength:n options:MTLResourceStorageModeShared];
	id<MTLBuffer> b = [device newBufferWithLength:n options:MTLResourceStorageModeShared];
	id<MTLCommandBuffer> cb = [queue commandBuffer];

	printf("metal_test:   queue %s, buffers at GPU addresses 0x%llx and 0x%llx, command buffer %s\n", queue ? "made" : "nil",
	    (unsigned long long)a.gpuAddress, (unsigned long long)b.gpuAddress, cb ? object_getClassName(cb) : "nil");
	if (queue == nil || a == nil || b == nil || cb == nil) {
		printf("metal_test:   no blits: the device has no GPU queue (gpu=1, and the plug-in built with hakios-metal)\n");
		return;
	}
	uint32_t *pa = a.contents;
	for (NSUInteger i = 0; i < n / 4; i++) {
		pa[i] = (uint32_t)(i * 2654435761u);
	}
	memset(b.contents, 0, n);
	__block int handled = 0;
	id<MTLBlitCommandEncoder> blit = [cb blitCommandEncoder];
	[blit copyFromBuffer:a sourceOffset:4096 toBuffer:b destinationOffset:8192 size:500000];
	[blit fillBuffer:b range:NSMakeRange(600000, 4096) value:0xa5];
	[blit endEncoding];
	[cb addCompletedHandler:^(id<MTLCommandBuffer> done) { handled = done.status == MTLCommandBufferStatusCompleted ? 1 : -1; }];
	uint64_t t0 = clock_gettime_nsec_np(CLOCK_UPTIME_RAW);
	[cb commit];
	[cb waitUntilCompleted];
	uint64_t t1 = clock_gettime_nsec_np(CLOCK_UPTIME_RAW);
	uint8_t *pb = b.contents;
	int same = memcmp(pb + 8192, (uint8_t *)pa + 4096, 500000) == 0, filled = 1, edges = pb[8191] == 0 && pb[8192 + 500000] == 0;
	for (NSUInteger i = 600000; i < 604096; i++) {
		filled = filled && pb[i] == 0xa5;
	}
	printf("metal_test:   blits: status %lu%s, handler %s, copy %s, fill %s, edges %s, %llu us\n", (unsigned long)cb.status,
	    cb.error ? [[NSString stringWithFormat:@" (%@)", cb.error.localizedDescription] UTF8String] : "",
	    handled == 1 ? "ran" : handled ? "saw an error" : "DID NOT RUN", same ? "ok" : "WRONG", filled ? "ok" : "WRONG",
	    edges ? "untouched" : "CHANGED", (unsigned long long)((t1 - t0) / 1000));
	printf("metal_test:   blits %s\n", cb.status == MTLCommandBufferStatusCompleted && handled == 1 && same && filled && edges ? "WORK" : "FAILED");
}

int
main(int argc, char **argv)
{
	struct sigaction sa = { 0 };

	/* every line as it happens: a call that kills the process must not take the log with it */
	setvbuf(stdout, NULL, _IONBF, 0);
	/* and where it died, since the kernel's report never arrives here (see fault()) */
	sa.sa_sigaction = fault;
	sa.sa_flags = SA_SIGINFO;
	sigaction(SIGSEGV, &sa, NULL);
	sigaction(SIGBUS, &sa, NULL);
	sigaction(SIGILL, &sa, NULL);
	sigaction(SIGABRT, &sa, NULL);
	sigaction(SIGTRAP, &sa, NULL);

	/* one question, asked by a process of its own (see in_a_new_process) */
	if (argc > 1) {
		if (strcmp(argv[1], "ci-default") == 0) {
			coreimage();
		} else if (strcmp(argv[1], "ci-software") == 0) {
			coreimage_options = @{ @"kCIContextUseSoftwareRenderer": @YES };
			coreimage();
		} else if (strcmp(argv[1], "ci-eagl") == 0) {
			coreimage_over_eagl = 1;
			coreimage();
		} else if (strcmp(argv[1], "ci-eagl-software") == 0) {
			coreimage_over_eagl = 2;
			coreimage();
		} else if (strcmp(argv[1], "plugins") == 0) {
			plugins();
		} else if (strcmp(argv[1], "objects") == 0) {
			device_objects();
		} else if (strcmp(argv[1], "blits") == 0) {
			blits();
		} else {
			printf("metal_test: no such question: %s\n", argv[1]);
			return 2;
		}
		return 0;
	}

	printf("metal_test: the services Metal looks for (IOAcceleratorES)\n");
	accelerators();
	printf("metal_test: what the registry has that is a GPU\n");
	gpu_services();
	printf("metal_test: the device a program gets\n");
	the_device();
	in_a_new_process("what the device makes: buffers, a library", "objects", 60);
	in_a_new_process("blits through Metal: copy and fill, done by the GPU", "blits", 60);
	printf("metal_test: what Darwin publishes about graphics (artwork, not rendering)\n");
	gestalt();
	printf("metal_test: CoreImage, which has a path without Metal\n");
	/*
	 * The ones that matter go first: a session can run out before the end, and these are the
	 * answer everything else is waiting for. The default context is known to crash in
	 * CI::GLContext::init() with no GL context to work with (see docs/metal.md), so the question
	 * is whether giving it one -- ours, Mesa behind src/eagl.c -- is enough.
	 */
	in_a_new_process("a CIContext over an EAGLContext (the GPU)", "ci-eagl", 120);
	in_a_new_process("a CIContext over an EAGLContext (software Mesa)", "ci-eagl-software", 180);
	in_a_new_process("the default CIContext", "ci-default", 60);
	in_a_new_process("a software-renderer CIContext", "ci-software", 60);
	/*
	 * Last on purpose: taking a bundle's principal class loads that bundle's code and runs its
	 * initialisers -- for AGXMetalA11.bundle, Apple's own driver for the A11's GPU, which this
	 * image does carry.
	 */
	in_a_new_process("loading the plug-in bundles of " EXTENSIONS, "plugins", 90);
	return 0;
}
```

`userland/src/mg_test.c`:

```c
/*
 * mg_test: what MobileGestalt says about this device (the answers Darwin builds its idea of the
 * hardware from).   usage: mg_test [KEY...]
 * A key may also be one of the obfuscated names programs ask by; "MGGetProductType" gives the number
 * MGGetProductType() returns (what programs tell the models apart by).
 */
#include <CoreFoundation/CoreFoundation.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>

extern CFTypeRef MGCopyAnswer(CFStringRef key);
extern uint64_t MGGetProductType(void);

static const char *const keys[] = {
	"DeviceClass", "DeviceClassNumber", "DeviceName", "ProductType", "HWModelStr", "ModelNumber", "ProductName",
	"marketing-name", "UserAssignedDeviceName", "ComputerName", "SerialNumber", "UniqueDeviceID", "HasBaseband",
	"telephony", "cellular-data", "wifi", "bluetooth", "DeviceSupportsTelephonyOverUSB", "main-screen-scale",
	"main-screen-width", "main-screen-height", "main-screen-class", "ArtworkDeviceSubType", "DeviceColor", "CPUArchitecture",
	"BuildVersion", "ProductVersion", "RegionInfo", "front-facing-camera", "rear-facing-camera", "still-camera",
};

int
main(int argc, char **argv)
{
	int count = argc > 1 ? argc - 1 : (int)(sizeof(keys) / sizeof(keys[0]));

	for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {
		const char *name = argc > 1 ? argv[i + 1] : keys[i];
		if (strcmp(name, "MGGetProductType") == 0) {
			printf("mg_test: MGGetProductType() = %#llx\n", (unsigned long long)MGGetProductType());
			continue;
		}
		CFStringRef key = CFStringCreateWithCString(NULL, name, kCFStringEncodingUTF8);
		CFTypeRef answer = MGCopyAnswer(key);
		CFStringRef text = answer ? CFCopyDescription(answer) : NULL;
		char line[256] = "(none)";

		if (text) {
			CFStringGetCString(text, line, sizeof(line), kCFStringEncodingUTF8);
			CFRelease(text);
		}
		printf("mg_test: %s = %s\n", name, line);
		if (answer) {
			CFRelease(answer);
		}
		CFRelease(key);
	}
	return 0;
}
```

`userland/src/net_test.m`:

```m
/*
 * net_test: bring the network interface up the way Darwin itself would, and see whether Darwin can
 * use it. Each step is one layer of what a stock application needs:
 *
 * usage: net_test STEP...
 *   show                  the interfaces and their addresses, as the kernel has them
 *   store [PATTERN]       what configd has in its dynamic store (default: everything under
 *                         State:/Network and Setup:/Network)
 *   dhcp IF               ask configd's IPConfiguration plugin to configure IF by DHCP
 *   waitaddr IF SECONDS   wait until IF has an IPv4 address
 *   resolve NAME          getaddrinfo(): the question goes to mDNSResponder, which asks the
 *                         servers configd has told it about
 *   tcp HOST PORT         connect a socket, send an HTTP request, show the first line of the answer
 *   fetch URL             the same through CFNetwork (NSURLSession): for https this is TLS, the
 *                         system's trust store and trustd as well. The status, the length, an HTML
 *                         title if there is one, and the answer's own "x-" headers -- where Apple's
 *                         services say what they decided (X-Set-Apple-Store-Front; rc.jobs.store)
 *   reach NAME            what SCNetworkReachability says: the question applications ask first
 *   wait SECONDS
 *   wifi                  what the job com.hakios.wifi runs in every image: if the kernel was
 *                         started with wifi=1, wait for the radio's interface (en0) to appear,
 *                         and ask for it to be configured by DHCP ("dhcp en0") only if configd
 *                         has no network service of its own for it; else nothing
 *   watch SECONDS         for so long, say when configd's store changes what tells an interface's
 *                         state: State:/Network/Service/.../IPv4, State:/Network/Interface/en0/...,
 *                         State:/Network/Global/IPv4 (the key, whether it is there, the names in it;
 *                         no addresses)
 *   wrongjoin             ask the radio to join the network it is on with a passphrase that is
 *                         wrong on purpose, through the request wifid uses (Apple80211's
 *                         ASSOCIATE), and say what the kernel answers: Apple80211's result number
 *                         (21: a wrong passphrase) and how long it took. The network's name is
 *                         the kernel's (its SSID request) and is not printed.
 *
 * The interface QEMU's network gives (en0, drivers/net/hakios.net.c) has no IOKit object behind it,
 * and configd makes its network services out of those. (The phone's radio has one now:
 * drivers/wifi/hakios.wlan.cpp, and configd makes a "Wi-Fi" service of it by itself.) But the
 * plugin that does the configuring keeps its own list
 * of interfaces, straight from the kernel, and has a Mach interface of its own, the one the
 * "ipconfig" command of macOS uses ("ipconfig set en0 DHCP"; the command itself is not part of
 * Darwin). "dhcp" is one of its calls: the plugin makes a service for the interface that exists in
 * no preferences file, runs DHCP, and publishes what it learns; the rest of configd then treats
 * it like any other service.
 * (Not "ipconfig set", the first call one thinks of: the service that one makes is gone at
 * configd's next look at its configuration, half a second later at boot, and the protocol is
 * detached from the interface again. "ipconfig setservice" makes one that stays.)
 */
#import <Foundation/Foundation.h>
#include <SystemConfiguration/SCNetworkReachability.h>
#include <arpa/inet.h>
#include <errno.h>
#include <ifaddrs.h>
#include <mach/mach.h>
#include <sys/sysctl.h>
#include <mach/mach_time.h>
#include <net/if.h>
#include <net/if_dl.h>
#include <netdb.h>
#include <netinet/in.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <sys/socket.h>
#include <unistd.h>

/* not in the Darwin SDK's headers, in the libraries all the same */
extern mach_port_t bootstrap_port;
extern kern_return_t bootstrap_look_up(mach_port_t bootstrap, const char *name, mach_port_t *service);
typedef const struct __SCDynamicStore *SCDynamicStoreRef;
extern SCDynamicStoreRef SCDynamicStoreCreate(CFAllocatorRef allocator, CFStringRef name, void *callout, void *context);
extern CFArrayRef SCDynamicStoreCopyKeyList(SCDynamicStoreRef store, CFStringRef pattern);
extern CFPropertyListRef SCDynamicStoreCopyValue(SCDynamicStoreRef store, CFStringRef key);
extern Boolean SCDynamicStoreSetNotificationKeys(SCDynamicStoreRef store, CFArrayRef keys, CFArrayRef patterns);
extern CFRunLoopSourceRef SCDynamicStoreCreateRunLoopSource(CFAllocatorRef allocator, SCDynamicStoreRef store, CFIndex order);

static double
seconds(void)
{
	static mach_timebase_info_data_t base;

	if (base.denom == 0) {
		mach_timebase_info(&base);
	}
	return (double)mach_absolute_time() * base.numer / base.denom / 1e9;
}

/* ---- show ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ */

static bool
show(const char *only, bool quiet)
{
	struct ifaddrs *list, *a;
	bool has_ipv4 = false;
	char text[64];

	if (getifaddrs(&list) != 0) {
		perror("net_test: getifaddrs");
		return false;
	}
	for (a = list; a != NULL; a = a->ifa_next) {
		if (a->ifa_addr == NULL || (only != NULL && strcmp(a->ifa_name, only) != 0)) {
			continue;
		}
		if (a->ifa_addr->sa_family == AF_LINK) {
			struct sockaddr_dl *dl = (struct sockaddr_dl *)a->ifa_addr;
			const unsigned char *m = (const unsigned char *)LLADDR(dl);

			if (quiet) {
				continue;
			}
			printf("net_test: %s: flags %#x%s%s, type %#x", a->ifa_name, a->ifa_flags, (a->ifa_flags & IFF_UP) ? " up" : "",
			    (a->ifa_flags & IFF_RUNNING) ? " running" : "", dl->sdl_type);
			if (dl->sdl_alen == 6) {
				printf(", address %02x:%02x:%02x:%02x:%02x:%02x", m[0], m[1], m[2], m[3], m[4], m[5]);
			}
			printf("\n");
		} else if (a->ifa_addr->sa_family == AF_INET) {
			struct sockaddr_in *in = (struct sockaddr_in *)a->ifa_addr, *mask = (struct sockaddr_in *)a->ifa_netmask;

			has_ipv4 = true;
			if (!quiet) {
				printf("net_test: %s: inet %s", a->ifa_name, inet_ntop(AF_INET, &in->sin_addr, text, sizeof(text)));
				printf(" netmask %s\n", mask ? inet_ntop(AF_INET, &mask->sin_addr, text, sizeof(text)) : "?");
			}
		} else if (a->ifa_addr->sa_family == AF_INET6 && !quiet) {
			struct sockaddr_in6 *in6 = (struct sockaddr_in6 *)a->ifa_addr;

			printf("net_test: %s: inet6 %s\n", a->ifa_name, inet_ntop(AF_INET6, &in6->sin6_addr, text, sizeof(text)));
		}
	}
	freeifaddrs(list);
	return has_ipv4;
}

/* ---- store ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

static void
store(const char *pattern)
{
	SCDynamicStoreRef session = SCDynamicStoreCreate(NULL, CFSTR("net_test"), NULL, NULL);
	NSString *wanted = pattern ? @(pattern) : @"(State|Setup):/Network/.*";
	NSArray *keys;

	if (session == NULL) {
		printf("net_test: store: no session with configd\n");
		return;
	}
	keys = CFBridgingRelease(SCDynamicStoreCopyKeyList(session, (__bridge CFStringRef)wanted));
	printf("net_test: store: %lu keys match %s\n", (unsigned long)keys.count, wanted.UTF8String);
	for (NSString *key in [keys sortedArrayUsingSelector:@selector(compare:)]) {
		id value = CFBridgingRelease(SCDynamicStoreCopyValue(session, (__bridge CFStringRef)key));
		NSString *text = [[[value description] componentsSeparatedByCharactersInSet:NSCharacterSet.whitespaceAndNewlineCharacterSet]
		    componentsJoinedByString:@" "];

		while ([text containsString:@"  "]) {
			text = [text stringByReplacingOccurrencesOfString:@"  " withString:@" "];
		}
		printf("net_test:   %s = %s\n", key.UTF8String, text.length > 400 ? [text substringToIndex:400].UTF8String : text.UTF8String);
	}
	CFRelease(session);
}

/* ---- dhcp ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ */

/*
 * The one call of the plugin's interface that is needed, written out by hand (bootp's
 * ipconfig.defs, subsystem 20000, the twelfth routine):
 *   routine ipconfig_set_service(server; name : array[16] of char; method_data : ^array[] of byte;
 *                                out serviceID : array[128] of char; out status : int)
 * method_data is a property list, { ConfigMethod = DHCP }, sent out of line. Only root may ask.
 */
#pragma pack(push, 4)
struct set_request {
	mach_msg_header_t head;
	mach_msg_body_t body;
	mach_msg_ool_descriptor_t method;
	NDR_record_t ndr;
	char name[16];
	mach_msg_type_number_t method_length;
};
struct set_reply {
	mach_msg_header_t head;
	NDR_record_t ndr;
	kern_return_t result;
	char service[128];
	int status;
	mach_msg_max_trailer_t trailer;
};
#pragma pack(pop)

static void
dhcp(const char *interface)
{
	static const char *const statuses[] = { "done", "permission denied", "no such interface", "invalid parameter",
		                                "invalid operation", "allocation failed", "internal error", "not supported" };
	NSData *method = [NSPropertyListSerialization dataWithPropertyList:@{ @"ConfigMethod": @"DHCP" }
	    format:NSPropertyListBinaryFormat_v1_0 options:0 error:NULL];
	mach_port_t server = MACH_PORT_NULL, reply_port = mig_get_reply_port();
	union {
		struct set_request request;
		struct set_reply reply;
	} message;
	kern_return_t result;

	result = bootstrap_look_up(bootstrap_port, "com.apple.network.IPConfiguration", &server);
	if (result != KERN_SUCCESS) {
		printf("net_test: dhcp: configd's IPConfiguration is not there: %#x\n", result);
		return;
	}
	memset(&message, 0, sizeof(message));
	message.request.head.msgh_bits = MACH_MSGH_BITS_COMPLEX | MACH_MSGH_BITS(MACH_MSG_TYPE_COPY_SEND, MACH_MSG_TYPE_MAKE_SEND_ONCE);
	message.request.head.msgh_size = sizeof(message.request);
	message.request.head.msgh_remote_port = server;
	message.request.head.msgh_local_port = reply_port;
	message.request.head.msgh_id = 20011;
	message.request.body.msgh_descriptor_count = 1;
	message.request.method.address = (void *)method.bytes;
	message.request.method.size = (mach_msg_size_t)method.length;
	message.request.method.deallocate = FALSE;
	message.request.method.copy = MACH_MSG_VIRTUAL_COPY;
	message.request.method.type = MACH_MSG_OOL_DESCRIPTOR;
	message.request.ndr = NDR_record;
	strlcpy(message.request.name, interface, sizeof(message.request.name));
	message.request.method_length = (mach_msg_type_number_t)method.length;
	result = mach_msg(&message.request.head, MACH_SEND_MSG | MACH_RCV_MSG, sizeof(message.request), sizeof(message), reply_port,
	    MACH_MSG_TIMEOUT_NONE, MACH_PORT_NULL);
	if (result != KERN_SUCCESS) {
		printf("net_test: dhcp: the message did not go through: %#x\n", result);
	} else if (message.reply.result != KERN_SUCCESS) {
		printf("net_test: dhcp: IPConfiguration does not take the message: %d\n", message.reply.result);
	} else {
		int status = message.reply.status;

		message.reply.service[sizeof(message.reply.service) - 1] = 0;
		printf("net_test: dhcp: IPConfiguration says of \"setservice %s DHCP\": %d (%s), service %s\n", interface, status,
		    status >= 0 && status < 8 ? statuses[status] : "?", message.reply.service);
	}
}

/* ---- resolve, tcp ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

static bool
resolve(const char *name, char *first, size_t size)
{
	struct addrinfo hints = { .ai_socktype = SOCK_STREAM }, *list = NULL, *a;
	double start = seconds();
	int error = getaddrinfo(name, NULL, &hints, &list);
	char text[64];

	if (error != 0) {
		printf("net_test: resolve %s: %s (after %.2f s)\n", name, gai_strerror(error), seconds() - start);
		return false;
	}
	printf("net_test: resolve %s, %.2f s:", name, seconds() - start);
	for (a = list; a != NULL; a = a->ai_next) {
		void *address = a->ai_family == AF_INET ? (void *)&((struct sockaddr_in *)a->ai_addr)->sin_addr :
		    (void *)&((struct sockaddr_in6 *)a->ai_addr)->sin6_addr;

		printf(" %s", inet_ntop(a->ai_family, address, text, sizeof(text)));
		if (a->ai_family == AF_INET && first != NULL && first[0] == 0) {
			strlcpy(first, text, size);
		}
	}
	printf("\n");
	freeaddrinfo(list);
	return true;
}

static void
tcp(const char *host, const char *port)
{
	struct addrinfo hints = { .ai_family = AF_INET, .ai_socktype = SOCK_STREAM }, *list = NULL;
	char request[256], answer[2048], *end;
	double start = seconds();
	ssize_t n, total = 0;
	int s, error;

	error = getaddrinfo(host, port, &hints, &list);
	if (error != 0) {
		printf("net_test: tcp %s: %s\n", host, gai_strerror(error));
		return;
	}
	s = socket(AF_INET, SOCK_STREAM, 0);
	if (s < 0 || connect(s, list->ai_addr, list->ai_addrlen) != 0) {
		printf("net_test: tcp %s port %s: %s (after %.2f s)\n", host, port, strerror(errno), seconds() - start);
		freeaddrinfo(list);
		return;
	}
	printf("net_test: tcp %s port %s: connected in %.2f s\n", host, port, seconds() - start);
	snprintf(request, sizeof(request), "GET / HTTP/1.0\r\nHost: %s\r\nUser-Agent: net_test\r\n\r\n", host);
	write(s, request, strlen(request));
	answer[0] = 0;
	while ((n = read(s, total == 0 ? answer : request, total == 0 ? sizeof(answer) - 1 : sizeof(request))) > 0) {
		if (total == 0) {
			answer[n] = 0;
		}
		total += n;
	}
	if ((end = strpbrk(answer, "\r\n")) != NULL) {
		*end = 0;
	}
	printf("net_test: tcp %s: %zd bytes in %.2f s, the answer begins \"%s\"\n", host, total, seconds() - start, answer);
	close(s);
	freeaddrinfo(list);
}

/* ---- fetch, reach ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

static void
fetch(const char *address)
{
	NSURL *url = [NSURL URLWithString:@(address)];
	NSURLSessionConfiguration *configuration = NSURLSessionConfiguration.ephemeralSessionConfiguration;
	dispatch_semaphore_t done = dispatch_semaphore_create(0);
	double start = seconds();

	configuration.timeoutIntervalForRequest = 60;
	[[[NSURLSession sessionWithConfiguration:configuration] dataTaskWithURL:url
	    completionHandler:^(NSData *data, NSURLResponse *response, NSError *error) {
		if (error != nil) {
			printf("net_test: fetch %s: FAILED after %.2f s: %s (%s %ld)\n", address, seconds() - start,
			    error.localizedDescription.UTF8String, error.domain.UTF8String, (long)error.code);
		} else {
			NSString *text = [[NSString alloc] initWithData:data encoding:NSUTF8StringEncoding];
			NSRange title = [text rangeOfString:@"<title>"], close = [text rangeOfString:@"</title>"];

			NSDictionary *headers = [(NSHTTPURLResponse *)response allHeaderFields];

			printf("net_test: fetch %s: status %ld, %lu bytes in %.2f s", address,
			    (long)((NSHTTPURLResponse *)response).statusCode, (unsigned long)data.length, seconds() - start);
			if (title.location != NSNotFound && close.location != NSNotFound && close.location > title.location) {
				printf(", title \"%s\"", [text substringWithRange:NSMakeRange(NSMaxRange(title),
				    close.location - NSMaxRange(title))].UTF8String);
			}
			printf("\n");
			/* The answer's own "x-" headers, which are where Apple's services say what they decided: a bag
			   request made with no storefront comes back with X-Set-Apple-Store-Front, and that header is
			   the whole question for the App Store (see rc.jobs.store). Nothing else is printed: a header
			   of ours could carry a token. */
			for (NSString *name in headers) {
				if ([name rangeOfString:@"x-" options:NSCaseInsensitiveSearch | NSAnchoredSearch].location == 0) {
					printf("net_test: fetch %s: %s: %.200s\n", address, name.UTF8String,
					    [headers[name] description].UTF8String);
				}
			}
		}
		dispatch_semaphore_signal(done);
	}] resume];
	if (dispatch_semaphore_wait(done, dispatch_time(DISPATCH_TIME_NOW, 90 * NSEC_PER_SEC)) != 0) {
		printf("net_test: fetch %s: no answer and no error in 90 s\n", address);
	}
}

static void
reach(const char *name)
{
	SCNetworkReachabilityRef target = SCNetworkReachabilityCreateWithName(NULL, name);
	SCNetworkReachabilityFlags flags = 0;

	if (target == NULL || !SCNetworkReachabilityGetFlags(target, &flags)) {
		printf("net_test: reach %s: no answer\n", name);
	} else {
		printf("net_test: reach %s: flags %#x:%s%s%s%s\n", name, flags, (flags & kSCNetworkReachabilityFlagsReachable) ?
		    " reachable" : " NOT reachable", (flags & kSCNetworkReachabilityFlagsConnectionRequired) ? ", connection required" : "",
		    (flags & kSCNetworkReachabilityFlagsIsWWAN) ? ", cellular" : "",
		    (flags & kSCNetworkReachabilityFlagsIsDirect) ? ", direct" : "");
	}
	if (target != NULL) {
		CFRelease(target);
	}
}

/*
 * With wifi=1 among the kernel's arguments: wait for en0, and for configd's own network service for
 * it ("Wi-Fi", made of the radio's IOKit objects, drivers/wifi/hakios.wlan.cpp). That service runs
 * DHCP by itself, and it has to be the one that does: wifid takes the interface for usable only
 * when the address appears under a service whose settings name en0, and the service "dhcp en0"
 * makes has none (Settings then shows a spinner where the tick belongs). Only a kernel without
 * those IOKit objects gets the call.
 */
static void
wifi(void)
{
	char arguments[1024] = "";
	size_t size = sizeof(arguments) - 1;
	double start = seconds();
	bool wanted = false, there = false;

	if (sysctlbyname("kern.bootargs", arguments, &size, NULL, 0) != 0) {
		return;
	}
	for (const char *word = strtok(arguments, " "); word != NULL; word = strtok(NULL, " ")) {
		wanted |= strcmp(word, "wifi=1") == 0;
	}
	if (!wanted) {
		return;
	}
	while (!(there = if_nametoindex("en0") != 0) && seconds() - start < 120) {
		usleep(500000);
	}
	if (!there) {
		printf("net_test: wifi: no en0 after %.0f s: the radio has not come up\n", seconds() - start);
		return;
	}
	printf("net_test: wifi: en0 is there after %.1f s\n", seconds() - start);
	for (;;) {
		SCDynamicStoreRef session = SCDynamicStoreCreate(NULL, CFSTR("net_test"), NULL, NULL);
		NSArray *keys = session ? CFBridgingRelease(SCDynamicStoreCopyKeyList(session, CFSTR("Setup:/Network/Service/[^/]+/Interface"))) : nil;
		bool configd_has_it = false;

		for (NSString *key in keys) {
			NSDictionary *interface = CFBridgingRelease(SCDynamicStoreCopyValue(session, (__bridge CFStringRef)key));

			configd_has_it |= [interface isKindOfClass:NSDictionary.class] && [interface[@"DeviceName"] isEqual:@"en0"];
		}
		if (session != NULL) {
			CFRelease(session);
		}
		if (configd_has_it) {
			printf("net_test: wifi: configd has a network service for en0 after %.1f s: it configures it itself\n", seconds() - start);
			return;
		}
		if (seconds() - start > 30) {
			break;
		}
		usleep(500000);
	}
	printf("net_test: wifi: configd has no network service for en0 (a kernel without its IOKit objects): DHCP asked for\n");
	dhcp("en0");
}

/* ---- watch ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ */

static double watch_start;

static void
watch_changed(SCDynamicStoreRef session, CFArrayRef keys, void *info)
{
	for (CFIndex i = 0; i < CFArrayGetCount(keys); i++) {
		NSString *key = (__bridge NSString *)CFArrayGetValueAtIndex(keys, i);
		id value = CFBridgingRelease(SCDynamicStoreCopyValue(session, (__bridge CFStringRef)key));
		NSString *names = [value isKindOfClass:NSDictionary.class] ?
		    [[[(NSDictionary *)value allKeys] sortedArrayUsingSelector:@selector(compare:)] componentsJoinedByString:@" "] : @"";

		printf("net_test: watch +%.2f s: %s %s%s%s\n", seconds() - watch_start, key.UTF8String, value ? "set" : "REMOVED",
		    value ? ": " : "", names.UTF8String);
	}
}

static void
watch(double limit)
{
	SCDynamicStoreRef session = SCDynamicStoreCreate(NULL, CFSTR("net_test watch"), (void *)watch_changed, NULL);
	NSArray *patterns = @[ @"State:/Network/Service/[^/]+/IPv4", @"State:/Network/Interface/en0/.*", @"State:/Network/Global/IPv4" ];
	CFRunLoopSourceRef source;

	if (session == NULL || !SCDynamicStoreSetNotificationKeys(session, NULL, (__bridge CFArrayRef)patterns) ||
	    (source = SCDynamicStoreCreateRunLoopSource(NULL, session, 0)) == NULL) {
		printf("net_test: watch: no session with configd\n");
		return;
	}
	watch_start = seconds();
	printf("net_test: watch: for %.0f s\n", limit);
	CFRunLoopAddSource(CFRunLoopGetCurrent(), source, kCFRunLoopDefaultMode);
	CFRunLoopRunInMode(kCFRunLoopDefaultMode, limit, false);
	CFRunLoopRemoveSource(CFRunLoopGetCurrent(), source, kCFRunLoopDefaultMode);
	CFRelease(source);
	CFRelease(session);
}

/* ---- wrongjoin --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

struct apple80211req {
	char name[16];
	int32_t type, value;
	uint32_t length;
	void *data __attribute__((aligned(8)));
};

#define SIOCSA80211     0x802869c8u
#define SIOCGA80211     0xc02869c9u

static void
wrongjoin(void)
{
	static const char wrong[] = "not-the-passphrase-0";     /* (a passphrase nobody has: the test is that it fails) */
	uint8_t ssid[32], assoc[592];
	struct apple80211req request = { .name = "en0" };
	int s = socket(AF_INET, SOCK_DGRAM, 0);
	double start;
	uint32_t length;

	request.type = 1;
	request.length = sizeof(ssid);
	request.data = ssid;
	if (s < 0 || ioctl(s, SIOCGA80211, &request) != 0 || request.length == 0 || request.length > sizeof(ssid)) {
		printf("net_test: wrongjoin: no network is joined (or no radio): nothing to try\n");
		if (s >= 0) {
			close(s);
		}
		return;
	}
	length = request.length;
	/* the layout of Darwin userland 16.5 (drivers/wifi/hakios.apple80211.c of the kernel): version, mode, authentication lower and
	 * upper, the name's length and the name, the access point (none: any), the key's version, length and kind (10:
	 * a passphrase as typed), the key */
	memset(assoc, 0, sizeof(assoc));
	*(uint32_t *)(assoc + 0x00) = 1;
	*(uint16_t *)(assoc + 0x04) = 1;
	*(uint16_t *)(assoc + 0x06) = 1;
	*(uint16_t *)(assoc + 0x08) = 8;
	*(uint32_t *)(assoc + 0x0c) = length;
	memcpy(assoc + 0x10, ssid, length);
	*(uint32_t *)(assoc + 0x38) = 1;
	*(uint32_t *)(assoc + 0x3c) = sizeof(wrong) - 1;
	*(uint32_t *)(assoc + 0x40) = 10;
	memcpy(assoc + 0x48, wrong, sizeof(wrong) - 1);
	memset(&request, 0, sizeof(request));
	strlcpy(request.name, "en0", sizeof(request.name));
	request.type = 20;
	request.length = sizeof(assoc);
	request.data = assoc;
	start = seconds();
	if (ioctl(s, SIOCSA80211, &request) != 0) {
		printf("net_test: wrongjoin: the kernel refuses the request: %s\n", strerror(errno));
		close(s);
		return;
	}
	printf("net_test: wrongjoin: a join with a wrong passphrase is asked for (a name of %u bytes)\n", length);
	for (;;) {
		memset(&request, 0, sizeof(request));
		strlcpy(request.name, "en0", sizeof(request.name));
		request.type = 21;
		if (ioctl(s, SIOCGA80211, &request) != 0) {
			printf("net_test: wrongjoin: the result cannot be asked for: %s\n", strerror(errno));
			break;
		}
		if (request.value != 0 || seconds() - start > 60) {
			printf("net_test: wrongjoin: the result is %d after %.1f s%s\n", request.value, seconds() - start, request.value == 21 ?
			    " (Apple80211's \"invalid PMK\": a wrong passphrase)" : request.value == 0 ? " (NOT OVER)" : "");
			break;
		}
		usleep(200000);
	}
	close(s);
}

int
main(int argc, char **argv)
{
	setvbuf(stdout, NULL, _IOLBF, 0);
	@autoreleasepool {
		for (int i = 1; i < argc; i++) {
			const char *step = argv[i];

			if (strcmp(step, "show") == 0) {
				show(NULL, false);
			} else if (strcmp(step, "store") == 0) {
				store(i + 1 < argc && strchr(argv[i + 1], ':') != NULL ? argv[++i] : NULL);
			} else if (strcmp(step, "dhcp") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {
				dhcp(argv[++i]);
			} else if (strcmp(step, "waitaddr") == 0 && i + 2 < argc) {
				const char *interface = argv[++i];
				double start = seconds(), limit = atof(argv[++i]);

				while (!show(interface, true) && seconds() - start < limit) {
					usleep(250000);
				}
				printf("net_test: waitaddr %s: %s after %.1f s\n", interface, show(interface, true) ? "an address" :
				    "NO address", seconds() - start);
				show(interface, false);
			} else if (strcmp(step, "resolve") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {
				resolve(argv[++i], NULL, 0);
			} else if (strcmp(step, "tcp") == 0 && i + 2 < argc) {
				tcp(argv[i + 1], argv[i + 2]);
				i += 2;
			} else if (strcmp(step, "fetch") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {
				fetch(argv[++i]);
			} else if (strcmp(step, "reach") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {
				reach(argv[++i]);
			} else if (strcmp(step, "wait") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {
				usleep((useconds_t)(atof(argv[++i]) * 1e6));
			} else if (strcmp(step, "wifi") == 0) {
				wifi();
			} else if (strcmp(step, "watch") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {
				watch(atof(argv[++i]));
			} else if (strcmp(step, "wrongjoin") == 0) {
				wrongjoin();
			} else {
				fprintf(stderr, "net_test: bad step \"%s\"\n", step);
				return 1;
			}
		}
	}
	return 0;
}
```

`userland/src/record_test.c`:

```c
/*
 * record_test: record from the microphone the way an application does, and say what came.
 *
 * usage: record_test SECONDS [vibrate AT]
 *
 * An audio session for recording (AVAudioSession: play and record, haptics allowed while recording),
 * then AVAudioRecorder into a WAV file of 16-bit samples at 48 kHz, one channel, in /tmp (in memory
 * on this machine), its meters read every tenth of a second. With "vibrate AT", AT seconds into the
 * recording the phone's motor runs for one second (CoreHaptics, a continuous event at full strength):
 * something the microphone hears that nobody needs to say, at a frequency one can look for, the
 * motor's resonance (175.5 Hz on the POCO X5 Pro). Then the file is read back: how loud each tenth
 * of a second is, and how strong 175.5 Hz is before the vibration and while it lasts.
 *
 * On this machine the samples come from the kernel's /dev/hakios-mic (boot-arg mic=4), through
 * HakiosAudio.driver's device "Codec" (audio_plugin.c), of which the virtual audio device makes
 * the built-in microphone.
 */
#include <CoreFoundation/CoreFoundation.h>
#include <dlfcn.h>
#include <math.h>
#include <objc/message.h>
#include <objc/runtime.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <unistd.h>

#define PATH            "/tmp/record_test.wav"
#define RATE            48000
#define MOTOR_HZ        175.5

static id
send(id object, const char *selector)
{
	return object ? ((id (*)(id, SEL))objc_msgSend)(object, sel_registerName(selector)) : NULL;
}

static const char *
text(id object)
{
	id description = object ? send(object, "description") : NULL;
	const char *utf8 = description ? ((const char *(*)(id, SEL))objc_msgSend)(description, sel_registerName("UTF8String")) : NULL;

	return utf8 ? utf8 : "(none)";
}

static unsigned long
count_of(id array)
{
	return array ? ((unsigned long (*)(id, SEL))objc_msgSend)(array, sel_registerName("count")) : 0;
}

static id
item(id array, unsigned long i)
{
	return ((id (*)(id, SEL, unsigned long))objc_msgSend)(array, sel_registerName("objectAtIndex:"), i);
}

/* a constant (NSString *) of a framework, by name */
static id
constant(const char *framework_path, const char *name)
{
	void *framework = dlopen(framework_path, RTLD_NOW);
	id *value = framework ? dlsym(framework, name) : NULL;

	return value ? *value : NULL;
}

#define AVFAUDIO        "/System/Library/Frameworks/AVFAudio.framework/AVFAudio"
#define COREHAPTICS     "/System/Library/Frameworks/CoreHaptics.framework/CoreHaptics"

static void
ports(const char *what, id list)
{
	unsigned long n = count_of(list);

	printf("record_test: %s: %lu\n", what, n);
	for (unsigned long i = 0; i < n; i++) {
		id port = item(list, i);

		printf("record_test:   %s \"%s\" (%s)\n", text(send(port, "portType")), text(send(port, "portName")),
		    text(send(port, "UID")));
	}
}

/* The audio session, set up for recording; false if it will not be. */
static bool
session_up(void)
{
	id session = send((id)objc_getClass("AVAudioSession"), "sharedInstance"), error = NULL;
	id category = constant(AVFAUDIO, "AVAudioSessionCategoryPlayAndRecord");
	BOOL ok;

	if (session == NULL || category == NULL) {
		printf("record_test: no AVAudioSession\n");
		return false;
	}
	if (((BOOL (*)(id, SEL, SEL))objc_msgSend)(session, sel_registerName("respondsToSelector:"),
	    sel_registerName("recordPermission"))) {
		unsigned long permission = ((unsigned long (*)(id, SEL))objc_msgSend)(session, sel_registerName("recordPermission"));

		printf("record_test: the permission to record: %c%c%c%c\n", (int)(permission >> 24 & 0xff), (int)(permission >> 16 & 0xff),
		    (int)(permission >> 8 & 0xff), (int)(permission & 0xff));
	}
	ok = ((BOOL (*)(id, SEL, id, id *))objc_msgSend)(session, sel_registerName("setCategory:error:"), category, &error);
	printf("record_test: the category play-and-record: %s%s\n", ok ? "set" : "NOT SET: ", ok ? "" : text(error));
	if (!ok) {
		return false;
	}
	ok = ((BOOL (*)(id, SEL, BOOL, id *))objc_msgSend)(session, sel_registerName("setAllowHapticsAndSystemSoundsDuringRecording:error:"),
	    YES, &error);
	printf("record_test: haptics while recording: %s%s\n", ok ? "allowed" : "NOT ALLOWED: ", ok ? "" : text(error));
	ok = ((BOOL (*)(id, SEL, BOOL, id *))objc_msgSend)(session, sel_registerName("setActive:error:"), YES, &error);
	printf("record_test: the session: %s%s\n", ok ? "active" : "NOT ACTIVE: ", ok ? "" : text(error));
	if (!ok) {
		return false;
	}
	printf("record_test: input available: %s\n", ((BOOL (*)(id, SEL))objc_msgSend)(session,
	    sel_registerName("isInputAvailable")) ? "yes" : "NO");
	ports("available inputs", send(session, "availableInputs"));
	ports("the route's inputs", send(send(session, "currentRoute"), "inputs"));
	ports("the route's outputs", send(send(session, "currentRoute"), "outputs"));
	return true;
}

/* one second of the motor at full strength, started without waiting for it */
static id
vibrate(void)
{
	id error = NULL, engine, pattern, player, event;
	const void *parameters[2], *events[1];
	CFArrayRef list, none = CFArrayCreate(NULL, NULL, 0, &kCFTypeArrayCallBacks);

	if (constant(COREHAPTICS, "CHHapticEventTypeHapticContinuous") == NULL) {
		printf("record_test: no CoreHaptics\n");
		return NULL;
	}
	engine = ((id (*)(id, SEL, id *))objc_msgSend)(send((id)objc_getClass("CHHapticEngine"), "alloc"),
	    sel_registerName("initAndReturnError:"), &error);
	if (engine == NULL || !((BOOL (*)(id, SEL, id *))objc_msgSend)(engine, sel_registerName("startAndReturnError:"), &error)) {
		printf("record_test: the haptic engine does not start: %s\n", text(error));
		return NULL;
	}
	parameters[0] = ((id (*)(id, SEL, id, float))objc_msgSend)(send((id)objc_getClass("CHHapticEventParameter"), "alloc"),
	    sel_registerName("initWithParameterID:value:"), constant(COREHAPTICS, "CHHapticEventParameterIDHapticIntensity"), 1.0f);
	parameters[1] = ((id (*)(id, SEL, id, float))objc_msgSend)(send((id)objc_getClass("CHHapticEventParameter"), "alloc"),
	    sel_registerName("initWithParameterID:value:"), constant(COREHAPTICS, "CHHapticEventParameterIDHapticSharpness"), 0.3f);
	list = CFArrayCreate(NULL, parameters, 2, &kCFTypeArrayCallBacks);
	event = ((id (*)(id, SEL, id, id, double, double))objc_msgSend)(send((id)objc_getClass("CHHapticEvent"), "alloc"),
	    sel_registerName("initWithEventType:parameters:relativeTime:duration:"),
	    constant(COREHAPTICS, "CHHapticEventTypeHapticContinuous"), (id)list, 0.0, 1.0);
	events[0] = event;
	list = CFArrayCreate(NULL, events, 1, &kCFTypeArrayCallBacks);
	pattern = ((id (*)(id, SEL, id, id, id *))objc_msgSend)(send((id)objc_getClass("CHHapticPattern"), "alloc"),
	    sel_registerName("initWithEvents:parameters:error:"), (id)list, (id)none, &error);
	player = pattern ? ((id (*)(id, SEL, id, id *))objc_msgSend)(engine, sel_registerName("createPlayerWithPattern:error:"),
	    pattern, &error) : NULL;
	if (player == NULL ||
	    !((BOOL (*)(id, SEL, double, id *))objc_msgSend)(player, sel_registerName("startAtTime:error:"), 0.0, &error)) {
		printf("record_test: the vibration does not play: %s\n", text(error));
		return NULL;
	}
	printf("record_test: the motor runs for 1 s\n");
	return engine;
}

static CFNumberRef
number(int value)
{
	return CFNumberCreate(NULL, kCFNumberIntType, &value);
}

/* The power of one frequency in samples [from, to): Goertzel, as dB of full scale (a full-scale sine is 0). */
static double
tone_db(const int16_t *samples, long from, long to, double hz)
{
	double w = 2 * M_PI * hz / RATE, c = 2 * cos(w), s1 = 0, s2 = 0, power;
	long n = to - from;

	if (n <= 0) {
		return -200;
	}
	for (long i = from; i < to; i++) {
		double window = 0.5 - 0.5 * cos(2 * M_PI * (i - from) / (n - 1)), s0 = samples[i] / 32768.0 * window + c * s1 - s2;

		s2 = s1;
		s1 = s0;
	}
	power = s1 * s1 + s2 * s2 - c * s1 * s2;
	/* (a Hann window halves the amplitude: a full-scale sine gives (n/4)^2) */
	return 10 * log10(power / ((n / 4.0) * (n / 4.0)) + 1e-20);
}

static double
rms_db(const int16_t *samples, long from, long to)
{
	double sum = 0;

	for (long i = from; i < to; i++) {
		sum += (double)samples[i] * samples[i];
	}
	return to > from ? 10 * log10(sum / (to - from) / (32768.0 * 32768.0) + 1e-20) : -200;
}

/* The file read back: the samples of its data chunk. */
static int
analyse(double seconds, double vibrate_at)
{
	FILE *file = fopen(PATH, "rb");
	unsigned char header[12], chunk[8];
	int16_t *samples = NULL;
	long count = 0, peak = 0;

	if (file == NULL || fread(header, 1, 12, file) != 12 || memcmp(header, "RIFF", 4) != 0 || memcmp(header + 8, "WAVE", 4) != 0) {
		printf("record_test: %s is not a WAV file\n", PATH);
		return 1;
	}
	while (fread(chunk, 1, 8, file) == 8) {
		uint32_t size = chunk[4] | chunk[5] << 8 | chunk[6] << 16 | (uint32_t)chunk[7] << 24;

		if (memcmp(chunk, "data", 4) == 0) {
			samples = malloc(size + 2);
			count = (long)fread(samples, 1, size, file) / 2;
			break;
		}
		fseek(file, (long)(size + (size & 1)), SEEK_CUR);
	}
	fclose(file);
	if (samples == NULL || count == 0) {
		printf("record_test: %s has no samples\n", PATH);
		return 1;
	}
	for (long i = 0; i < count; i++) {
		long v = samples[i] < 0 ? -(long)samples[i] : samples[i];

		peak = v > peak ? v : peak;
	}
	printf("record_test: the file: %ld samples (%.2f s of %.2f), peak %ld of 32768, %.1f dBFS RMS over all\n", count,
	    (double)count / RATE, seconds, peak, rms_db(samples, 0, count));
	printf("record_test: dBFS RMS of each tenth of a second:");
	for (long at = 0; at + RATE / 10 <= count; at += RATE / 10) {
		printf(" %.0f", rms_db(samples, at, at + RATE / 10));
	}
	printf("\n");
	if (vibrate_at > 0) {
		long quiet_from = (long)(0.5 * RATE), quiet_to = (long)(vibrate_at * RATE) - RATE / 10;
		long loud_from = (long)((vibrate_at + 0.15) * RATE), loud_to = (long)((vibrate_at + 0.95) * RATE);

		loud_to = loud_to < count ? loud_to : count;
		printf("record_test: before the vibration %.1f dBFS RMS, %.1f dBFS at %.1f Hz; while it lasts %.1f dBFS RMS, %.1f dBFS at %.1f "
		    "Hz\n", rms_db(samples, quiet_from, quiet_to), tone_db(samples, quiet_from, quiet_to, MOTOR_HZ), MOTOR_HZ,
		    rms_db(samples, loud_from, loud_to), tone_db(samples, loud_from, loud_to, MOTOR_HZ), MOTOR_HZ);
	}
	free(samples);
	return 0;
}

int
main(int argc, char **argv)
{
	double seconds = argc > 1 ? atof(argv[1]) : 5, vibrate_at = 0;
	const void *keys[6], *values[6];
	CFDictionaryRef settings;
	CFURLRef url;
	id recorder, error = NULL;
	BOOL ok, vibrated = NO;
	int tenths;

	setvbuf(stdout, NULL, _IONBF, 0);
	if (argc > 3 && strcmp(argv[2], "vibrate") == 0) {
		vibrate_at = atof(argv[3]);
	}
	seconds = seconds < 1 ? 1 : seconds > 60 ? 60 : seconds;
	if (!session_up()) {
		return 1;
	}
	keys[0] = CFSTR("AVFormatIDKey");
	values[0] = number('lpcm');
	keys[1] = CFSTR("AVSampleRateKey");
	values[1] = number(RATE);
	keys[2] = CFSTR("AVNumberOfChannelsKey");
	values[2] = number(1);
	keys[3] = CFSTR("AVLinearPCMBitDepthKey");
	values[3] = number(16);
	keys[4] = CFSTR("AVLinearPCMIsFloatKey");
	values[4] = kCFBooleanFalse;
	keys[5] = CFSTR("AVLinearPCMIsBigEndianKey");
	values[5] = kCFBooleanFalse;
	settings = CFDictionaryCreate(NULL, keys, values, 6, &kCFTypeDictionaryKeyCallBacks, &kCFTypeDictionaryValueCallBacks);
	unlink(PATH);
	url = CFURLCreateFromFileSystemRepresentation(NULL, (const UInt8 *)PATH, (CFIndex)strlen(PATH), false);
	recorder = ((id (*)(id, SEL, id, id, id *))objc_msgSend)(send((id)objc_getClass("AVAudioRecorder"), "alloc"),
	    sel_registerName("initWithURL:settings:error:"), (id)url, (id)settings, &error);
	if (recorder == NULL) {
		printf("record_test: no AVAudioRecorder: %s\n", text(error));
		return 1;
	}
	((void (*)(id, SEL, BOOL))objc_msgSend)(recorder, sel_registerName("setMeteringEnabled:"), YES);
	ok = ((BOOL (*)(id, SEL))objc_msgSend)(recorder, sel_registerName("prepareToRecord")) &&
	    ((BOOL (*)(id, SEL, double))objc_msgSend)(recorder, sel_registerName("recordForDuration:"), seconds);
	printf("record_test: recording %.1f s into %s%s: %s\n", seconds, PATH, vibrate_at > 0 ? ", the motor at" : "",
	    ok ? "started" : "DOES NOT START");
	if (!ok) {
		return 1;
	}
	printf("record_test: meters (average/peak dB) every half second:");
	for (tenths = 0; tenths < (int)(seconds * 10) + 5 && ((BOOL (*)(id, SEL))objc_msgSend)(recorder, sel_registerName("isRecording"));
	    tenths++) {
		if (vibrate_at > 0 && !vibrated && tenths >= (int)(vibrate_at * 10)) {
			printf("\n");
			(void)vibrate();
			vibrated = YES;
		}
		usleep(100000);
		send(recorder, "updateMeters");
		if (tenths % 5 == 4) {
			printf(" %.0f/%.0f", ((float (*)(id, SEL, unsigned long))objc_msgSend)(recorder, sel_registerName("averagePowerForChannel:"), 0),
			    ((float (*)(id, SEL, unsigned long))objc_msgSend)(recorder, sel_registerName("peakPowerForChannel:"), 0));
		}
	}
	printf("\n");
	send(recorder, "stop");
	usleep(300000);
	return analyse(seconds, vibrate_at);
}
```
